evidence: §4 Table 4: identical configuration across three seeds yields means 76.2/68.7/76.4 (sd 4.4 pp, range 7.7 pp) while trace-Greek stays 1.00/1.00/1.00 and trace length varies only 132–152 words — the paper's central noise-floor/asymmetry result
§7: reasoning-only averages 73.6 (n=6) vs two-phase 66.7 (n=9), 52/54 pairwise comparisons, exact permutation p=0.0008, with disclosed stratification caveat (p=0.125 with 16 attainable permutations)

§5/§10: base models produce 0/1,000 Greek traces (median ratio 0.33), fine-tunes reach 97.4–98.7% fidelity across all three families; token cost changes sign by family (Qwen 3.0× fewer tokens, NemotronH parity, Gpt-OSS 1.6× more) due to 2.3–2.5× Greek token fertility

§15.1 Table 16: pre-registered RLVR round with frozen thresholds — fallback 24.1%→2.5%, leak 3.53%→0.00% vs random-reward control at 22.1%/3.61%; override compliance 44.8→53.9% reported as reward-responsive but short of the pre-registered ≥15pp/60% trainability bar

§8: six documented instrument failures, including 38.9% logic-axis contamination (175/450 items sharing 13-grams with training pool) and a 3.1σ translation-register artifact caught by a 250-item human-translated control

Limitations: all models are sparse MoE adapted with LoRA, no dense baseline tested, noise floor from n=3 on one arm with 95% CI [2.3, 27.7] pp, Greek is mid-resource, and trace auditability measured only as script identity plus small LLM-judge probes

Availability: five checkpoints (Sophea-Qwen3.6-v1, Sophea-OSS-v1, Sophea-Nemo-3-Nano-v1, Sophea-Nemo-3.5-Lightning-v1, Sophea-Qwen3.6-v1.1) released via HuggingFace KIEFERSA collection; training on one 8×B200 node with LoRA r=32, α=64, one epoch specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful LLM reasoning-fine-tuning study with strong alignment to high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training/LoRA, RL/RLVR, evaluation methodology, MoE efficiency), though the language is Greek, not Japanese, so the Japanese-LLM preference is unfulfilled. Core contributions: (1) seed-variance floor (7.7 pp) exceeding all data/recipe effects at MoE+LoRA scale, with the novel asymmetry that behavioral metrics (trace language, length) are seed-stable while accuracy is not; (2) six-dimension behavioral measurement showing SFT installs Greek reasoning (~98% fidelity from 0/1,000 base traces) with family-dependent token-cost signs; (3) a pre-registered RLVR round with random-reward control showing fallback 24.1%→2.5% and leak 3.53%→0.00% while accuracy-only gradients leave language fidelity intact. Novelty is solid but incremental over STaR, DeepSeek-R1 language-consistency rewards, spurious-rewards controls, and known seed-variance work; the transfer to MoE+LoRA+mid-resource scale and the measured asymmetry are the new parts. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registration with frozen decision rules, random-reward veto control, seed controls run before ablations, contamination and translation-register checks, locale-aware parser audit, 15-arm permutation test (p=0.0008) for the one surviving accuracy effect, and candid withdrawal of six instrument failures. Evidence is strong but partly rests on n=3 seed replicates, single-seed arms (disclosed), small judge probes (n=46/58, one annotator for switching), and a logic axis with class-prior instability. Generalizability is explicitly and appropriately bounded to LoRA-on-MoE and mid-resource Greek (no dense control, no truly low-resource test). Reproducibility is good: five released checkpoints, hyperparameters, library versions, and single-node compute specified; corpus is partly synthetic from commercial models with provenance fields but full corpus release is not clearly evidenced.

primary_link.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See

papers.summary: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reas
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討如何讓三個前沿混合專家模型（MoE）學會以希臘語進行推理。研究發現，翻譯基準上的準確率幾乎不具資訊量：僅改變隨機種子就能使分數波動 7.7 個百分點，蓋過所有資料與訓練配方效應；而行為維度卻非常穩定。基礎模型從不以希臘語思考（1,000 條推理軌跡中 0 條），即使用希臘語提問，導致模型答對卻無法讓使用者閱讀、稽核或修正其推理。SFT 後，各檢查點在約 98% 的題目上以問題語言推理，文法評判全面改善，通用能力與各自基礎模型相差無幾：什麼都沒忘記，還獲得流暢度。但 SFT 無法修正自身缺陷：四分之一答案跳過指定格式、答案洩漏進推理通道；經預註冊的 RLVR（可驗證獎勵強化學習）將格式回退從 24% 降至 2.5%、洩漏降至 0.0%，希臘語推理習慣則不受純準確率梯度侵蝕。論文另詳述六次儀器失誤，每個都由對照組揪出。限制：僅涵蓋 MoE 模型搭配 LoRA、希臘語屬中資源語言、軌跡可讀性未經人工驗證。對低資源語言部署而言，準確率表看不見的行為維度，才是部署真正在乎的東西。
papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.title_zh: 以低資源語言思考：SFT 建構什麼、RL 修正什麼、以及準確率看不見什麼

links.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite

evidence: Abstract: proposes TokEval intrinsic metrics beyond fertility/compression; reports Spearman |ρ| up to 0.80 for information-theoretic metrics predicting language modeling ability
Section 4: 'We train 1.27B-parameter language models under 46 tokenizer configurations' with architecture, data, and hyperparameters held constant; sole variable is the tokenizer
Table 2 (Section 5): Rényi efficiency ρ=-0.80 with FLORES(trained) BPB; digit boundary F1 ρ=-0.62 with Code BPB; AST alignment ρ=0.61 with MBPP, with BH-adjusted significance stars
Discussion 'Seed noise and table resolution': seed std dev 0.00109 val BPB across 5 retrained configurations; MBPP seed std 0.065; concludes tables should be used for screening not selection

Section F.2: family-mean permutation tests and leave-one-out checks confirm key correlations; AST-alignment/MBPP correlation reverses sign when restricted to GPT-4o pretokenizer group, attributed to line-break handling

Section F.4: per-example conditional logistic regressions on internal and 5 external code models find no within-model association between code metrics and problem success, supporting reading metrics as audits rather than predictors

Section 4 availability claim: 'Every model reported in this paper, the tokenizer each was trained with, and a per-run table of the metrics reported here are released at https://huggingface.co/cmeister/tokenizer-lm-ablations'; abstract lists cimeister/tokenizer-intrinsic-evals

Limitations: single architecture (nanochat, 1.27B), n=29 limits statistical power, benchmark suite omits long-context reasoning and instruction following; Section E.3 reports Kendall τ=0.752 between d16 and d24 scale rankings, cautioning scale transfer
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on tokenizer evaluation, validated via controlled pretraining of 46 tokenizer configurations at 1.27B parameters (Section 4), evaluating math reasoning (GSM8K), code generation (HumanEval/MBPP), and multilingual BPB — directly relevant to LLM, reasoning, code, and NLP preferences. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the structural intrinsic metrics for digit handling and code (AST alignment, identifier fragmentation, §3.5-3.6) and the controlled tokenizer-sweep design are new, but the intrinsic-evaluation premise builds heavily on prior tokenizer-impact work. Rigor is exceptional: family-grouped panels to avoid dependence (§A.3, §C.2), mixed-effects regressions with clustered SEs, BH-FDR correction, leave-one-out and design-axis robustness checks (§F.2), seed-noise quantification (Discussion), calibrated held-out prediction (§F.1), and candid negative results (§F.4 per-example analysis; BLiMP correlation attributed to algorithm confounder in §5). Evidence is strong and honestly caveated, though findings are correlational at n=29 and restricted to one architecture/scale, limiting generalizability as the authors themselves acknowledge in Limitations. Models, tokenizers, and per-run metrics are publicly released, supporting high reproducibility.

primary_link.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite

papers.summary: Language model tokenizers are typically selected with minimal evaluation, despite the fact that their design choices directly impact model capabilities. This can be partly attributed to a limited understanding of which tokenizer properties affect which aspects of downstream performance. We introduce TokEval, a framework of tokenizer evaluation metrics that goes beyond standard measures like fertility and compression rate to capture linguistically and structurally meaningful properties, e.g., UTF
papers.summary_zh: 分詞器的設計選擇直接影響模型能力，但實務上常僅以壓縮率或 fertility 等少數指標粗略挑選。本文提出 TokEval，一套超越標準度量的內在評測框架，涵蓋 UTF-8 字元邊界完整性、數字位值對齊、程式碼 AST 邊界對齊與多語言公平性（如 Tokenizer Fairness Gini）等結構敏感指標。為驗證這些指標能否預測下游表現，作者在架構與超參數固定的條件下，僅改變分詞器（演算法、前分詞策略、訓練資料混合）訓練 46 種配置的 1.27B 語言模型。結果顯示：資訊理論類指標最能預測語言建模能力（Spearman |ρ| 最高達 0.80），數字邊界 F1 與 AST 對齊等結構指標則與任務準確率相關；壓縮率本身並非可靠的品質目標。研究強調逐語言分析的重要性：聚合相關性可能掩蓋甚至反轉語言內關聯，且種子重訓實驗顯示結果表中相鄰列的差異多半小於一次重訓的波動，因此這些工具適合用作篩選而非最終選擇。限制包括單一架構、1.27B 規模，以及 n=29 的統計檢定力有限。此工作使分詞器選擇能在昂貴的預訓練掃描之前，先以低成本的內在測量完成初步把關。
papers.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite
papers.title_zh: TokEval：一套分詞器評測套件

links.title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment

evidence: Abstract: two deterministic optimal tracebacks disagree on temporal localization for 55.9% of 1,586 nonzero trajectory pairs; two frozen 800-rollout tool-use audits including a task-and-seed-disjoint replication expose exact-optimum reversals of turn-level credit.

Sec. 4.1 / Fig. 2: 47.5% of pairs are alignment-unidentified under pre-registered early/late rule; Spider Codex header_shuffle sharp range [.221,.799] vs published point near .217; frozen sweep spans 43.2-49.4% with same two aggregate reversals (App. B.1).

Sec. 4.2 / App. B.3-B.4: 93/495 (18.8%, row-clustered 95% CI [14.1,24.0]%) material trajectories, 14/20 sign reversals, disjoint replication 14/22 with zero false signs; pre-registered consequence verdict honestly 'Weak' (margin coverage 5/11=.455, AUC .589 vs required .70).

Sec. 4.3 / App. B.11: Earth-Agent Tool-Exact-Match awards one to 14.23% (CI [7.58,21.80]%) of non-exact cells across 1,532 cells; two-sided repair s2=ell/max{m,n} changes top configuration from DeepSeek-V3.1 IF to GPT-4o AP, surviving all 59 leave-one-task-out omissions.

Theorem 2 / App. A.7 & B.8: shared group standardization compiled over exact-tie fibers is shown NP-hard (lower support) / coNP-hard (threshold certification) via finite-bit MAX-CUT Karp reduction; conformance over 813 no-isolate graphs, 25,264 sign assignments, max error 1.61e-6; natural interaction graphs have treewidth at most 3 (Sec. 3.2).

Sec. 4.4 / App. B.10: pre-registered natural-response transport gate failed; corrected and pre-outcome held-out gates show destructive maps erase 8/8 harmful failures while call-site transport preserves them and reduces mean distance .1163->.0244; earlier invalid 8/8 claim withdrawn due to nonexistent pylint test IDs.

App. A.1-A.6: proofs of identification set, one-sided insufficiency, and linear feasibility boundary; A.6 explicitly attributes minimum-norm separation to classical multi-objective optimization (Fliege-Svaiter, Désidéri, Sener-Koltun), avoiding novelty overclaiming.

Appendix C: explicit scope limits—one agent family, one MatchTIR checkpoint, one compiler family; no final-policy degradation or deployment prevalence claims; provider outputs lack immutable digests and controllable seeds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-evaluation methodology paper squarely in scope: it audits LLM tool-use/code agent pipelines (SWE-bench, Spider2-DBT, MatchTIR tool-integrated reasoning, M3-Bench, Earth-Agent/MCPEval), process-reward credit assignment (Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, Code, Alignment/RL, Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences). Core claim—that cross-view correspondence (transport + tie completion) is a measurement intervention requiring two-sided validation and all-optima identification—is a genuinely new framing, though the formal machinery is openly composed from classical tools (principal angles, minimum-norm separation, MAX-CUT reduction). Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered and frozen protocols, exact-optimum enumeration, evidence-status separation (discovery/post-diagnostic/held-out/post-hoc never pooled), a withdrawn invalid claim, a failed prospective gate reported as such, and the MatchTIR pre-registered consequence gate honestly scored 'Weak'. Evidence is strong within scope (1,586 nonzero pairs with 47.5%/55.9% ambiguity; 14/20 and disjoint-replication 14/22 credit reversals; 14.23% false-perfect strictness cells with a top-ranking change surviving 59 leave-one-task-out omissions; 813-graph conformance ledger at 1.61e-6 max error), but demonstrations cover one checkpoint, one agent family, one compiler family, and no final-policy effect is established, tempering generalizability. Reproducibility is supported by exhaustive protocol detail and public third-party artifacts, though no explicit code-release statement for the auditors appears and provider outputs are not bitwise reproducible.

primary_link.title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment

papers.summary: Agent evaluations and trace-based learning often compare outputs across transformed views through a post-response correspondence treated as neutral preprocessing. We show that this correspondence is a measurement intervention: omitting it can manufacture sensitivity, an over-aggressive map can manufacture invariance, and multiple optimal correspondences can leave mechanism labels and signed learning credit unidentified. We develop a validity theory and audit with three components: two-sided vali
papers.summary_zh: 代理評估與軌跡式學習常在轉換後的視圖之間比較輸出，其跨視圖對應（correspondence）向來被視為中性前處理。本文證明這其實是一種測量介入：省略適當的傳輸會殘留雜訊、製造虛假敏感性；僅以良性樣本校準的過度激進映射會抹除回應差異、製造虛假不變性；而多個恰好最佳（exact-optimal）的對應則使機制標籤與帶符號的學習信用無法識別。作者提出「對應契約」，包含三要素：對雜訊去除與回應保留的雙側驗證、對所有精確最佳解之下游結論的識別，以及驗證通過後的不確定性傳播，並刻劃線性可行邊界與由編譯器決定的複雜度前沿。實證方面：在 1,586 對公開程式與 SQL 軌跡中，兩個確定性最佳回溯對 55.9% 的配對給出不同的時間定位；對 MatchTIR 的兩次凍結 800 次 rollout 稽核顯示回合級學習信用會翻轉；Earth-Agent 嚴格指標的精確修復更改變公開排行榜的領先者。限制：自然案例稽核屬事後分析、僅涵蓋一種代理家族、未測量最終政策層級的效應。核心訊息是：跨視圖對應必須被宣告、驗證並傳播為不確定性，點結論才具正當性。
papers.title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment
papers.title_zh: 跨視圖對應是一種測量介入：代理評估與信用分配的雙側驗證

links.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL

evidence: Abstract: claims 'average gains of 3.0–8.6% across seven text-only benchmarks for LLMs and 2.3–7.2% across four multimodal benchmarks' without ground-truth labels.
Section 4.1/Eq. 3-6: reward r_n^k = 1[a_n^k = â_{-n}(x)] where the pseudo-label comes from a peer agent's majority vote; agents share no parameters or gradients.
Section 5, Theorem 1: for symmetric two-agent dynamics, separatrix is p_A+p_B=1, enlarging the correct-convergence basin relative to self-rewarding; proofs in Appendix B.1–B.3.
Section 5 caveat: analysis assumes odd K ('Our experiments use an even K, where a tie is resolved deterministically').
Section 6.1 Baselines: TTRL, Intuitor, RENT, Co-rewarding-II, MM-UPT, GT-Reward reference, MAPoRL, CoMAS.
Table 1: Co-RL (Different family+) avg 49.3 on Qwen2.5-3B vs TTRL 47.3 and GT-Reward 47.4; Llama-3.2-3B 43.9 vs TTRL 43.1, GT 43.0.
Table 2: under CoMAS protocol, Co-RL avg 62.97 vs CoMAS 58.94 with 'half as many agents'; results for prior methods reported from Xue et al. (2026).
Appendix D.5 CoMAS comparison: authors disclose replacing the coding-benchmark aggregation ('a model that quotes many candidates is effectively scored at pass@5'), worth 7.3% to baseline.
Appendix A, Table 6: different-family pairs κ≤0.42, complementarity c≥29.4 vs same-family/seed-only κ≥0.51, c≤24.6; authors note κ and c 'correlate at r=-0.98' as two readings of one measurement.
Appendix D.4, Tables 10-11: matched two-model training and maj@8 inference budget—Co-RL ensemble 66.9 text avg vs TTRL ensemble 64.9; 50.88/52.30 vs 48.80/49.19 multimodal.
Section 6.1 Training details: AdamW, lr 3e-6 (LM) / 1e-6 (VLM), K=12 (LM) / 8 (VLM), single node of eight H100 GPUs.

Appendix D.5 Engineering notes: fixes for Gemma-3 ZeRO-3 init, tokenization, log-prob drift, and Qwen2.5-VL attention backend 'ship with the released code'; code link given in Abstract (github.com/DrStranded/Co-RL).

Table 4 (MMR1 block, InternVL-3.5-2B): Co-RL 45.15 vs TTRL 45.30—a case where Co-RL trails TTRL, showing non-uniform margins; authors note MMR1 and open-r1 blocks use different graders and 'are not compared'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A label-free multi-agent RL method for LLM/VLM reasoning in which decoupled agents are rewarded against peers' majority-vote pseudo-labels instead of their own (GRPO-based), with a diversity study and simplified dynamics theory. Highly on-topic: LLM reasoning, RL/GRPO, multi-agent training, math/code reasoning. The core mechanism is an increment over known ideas—co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998) and Co-rewarding's paraphrase/slow-copy views—so novelty is moderate despite clean execution. Rigor is strong: formal setup, proved propositions/theorem, broad baselines (TTRL, RENT, Intuitor, Co-rewarding-II, MM-UPT, MAPoRL, CoMAS, GT-Reward), matched training+inference-budget control (Appendix D.4), and disclosed protocol deviations (CoMAS coding-aggregation loophole, grader differences between MMR1/open-r1 blocks). Evidence is broad and mostly consistent but main tables appear single-run without variance; some margins are small (e.g., InternVL-3.5-2B MMR1: 45.15 vs TTRL 45.30 in Table 4). Theory assumes odd K and independence of peer pseudo-labels, while experiments use even K (disclosed) and independence holds only as far as error decorrelation, which Appendix A supports empirically (different-family κ≤0.42 vs same-family κ≥0.51). Generalizes across families (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, InternVL, Phi in Appendix A), sizes 1.7B–12B, and text/multimodal math-code-science suites, though the framework doubles training compute and is math-reasoning-centric. Reproducibility is good: released code, full hyperparameters (lr 3e-6, K=12, batch 128, 8×H100), detailed evaluation protocol (D.5), and engineering fixes shipped with code.

primary_link.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for improving reasoning in language and vision-language models, yet its strongest successes still depend heavily on ground-truth supervision (e.g., verifiable reward). Such annotations are costly to obtain and become increasingly scarce as reasoning capabilities advance beyond what humans can reliably evaluate. Self-rewarding RL reduces this dependence by enabling models to derive reward signals from their own completions. However, t
papers.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）強力提升推理能力，但依賴昂貴且日漸稀缺的真值標籤；自獎勵方法則可能強化既有偏誤、降低回應多樣性，甚至導致訓練崩潰。本文提出 Co-RL：多個不共享參數的模型在單次訓練中同時以 RL 優化，各代理的獎勵來自同儕對多數決偽標籤的比對，形成相互去相關的監督訊號。透過異質的模型家族、規模與改寫過的訓練樣本提升群體多樣性，可降低相關錯誤、阻斷自我強化的回饋迴路。理論分析證明：自我獎勵是自我確認的動態（正確機率低於 1/2 時會趨近 0），而跨代理監督把正確收斂盆地擴大為 p_A+p_B>1，能利用代理間的互補強項修正自我獎勵會強化的錯誤。實驗顯示，Co-RL 在七個純文字基準為四個 LLM 帶來 3.0–8.6% 的平均增益，在四個多模態數學基準為五個 VLM 帶來 2.3–7.2% 增益，全程未使用任何真值標籤即匹配或超越監督式訓練，並以一半的代理數量勝過多代理 RL 方法 CoMAS。限制：代理數量、多樣性與互動拓撲如何塑造跨代理學習，仍是待解的未來方向。

links.title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract: SWE-bench Verified gains of 64.0%→70.4% (OpenHands SDK), 62.4%→68.2% (Claude Code), 57.2%→66.6% (OpenCode) training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with GSPO across three native harnesses
§4.4/Table 3: rollout–training Pearson correlation ≥0.998 median per scaffold (never below 0.989 per step); routing replay raises correlation 0.9946→0.9993 and mean |Δlog p| 0.0062→0.0025
Appendix B/Table 7: negative control — deliberately misaligned replay degrades Pearson r to 0.7503 and expert overlap to 0.083, demonstrating the failure mode is detectable only via direct comparison
§4.3: pool filtered from 36,884 to 2,699 tasks; Figure 6 ablation over four 951-task pools shows full difficulty band reaches 0.671 post-warmup vs 0.640 (lower half) and no gain for unscreened pool

§4.6/Table 4: agent execution is 91.3% of mean wall-clock (840.5s of 920.4s) over 3,699 trials; sync-vs-async comparison yields 2.5× raw step-time reduction, corrected to ~1.9× after optimizer-throughput difference

Limitations section: all experiments use one model, each harness trained separately, single run per main configuration leaving run-to-run variance unquantified, binary reward, defenses not guaranteed against all exploit strategies

Abstract footnote + §4.1: framework, trained models, and 2,699-task index released (github.com/LegoX/Lego-RL, huggingface.co/datasets/LegoX/Lego-RL-2699); Appendix I/Table 10 lists resolved hyperparameters; Appendix J documents task data formats
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-profile: harness-native RL training infrastructure for coding agents (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, GSPO/verl, vLLM), squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Reinforcement Learning, Training, and Scaling/Serving preferences. Novelty is integration-level: in-process token capture under history rewriting, MoE routing replay (adopted from R3), stage-wise reward-hack defenses, and Live-UI observability are combined rather than algorithmically new, though the negative-control analysis of replay misalignment is a genuine contribution. Rigor and evidence are strong: matched configurations across three harnesses, a four-pool task-selection ablation, routing-replay negative controls, stage-wise timing over 3,699 trials, and unusually honest caveats (sync/async comparison confounded by differing optimizer throughput and explicitly corrected; observational analyses explicitly not claimed as causal). Main deductions: single model, single run per configuration with no variance quantification, binary terminal reward, and unverified generalization beyond OpenSWE-style coding tasks. Reproducibility claims are detailed (released code/models/task index, resolved hyperparameters, documented data formats) but link functionality cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges nati
papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理的強化學習日益依賴長時運行的代理執行框架（harness）來管理工具整合、儲存庫情境與執行回饋，但其原生執行環境與策略梯度訓練天然錯位：環境崩潰與獎勵駭取會污染結果訊號，訓練—推論差異則使 rollout 行為與策略更新脫鉤。本文提出 Lego-RL，在不修改代理內部控制流的前提下，銜接原生 harness 與可擴充的策略梯度最佳化，三大支柱為：(1) 透過行程內 LLM 代理擷取原始生成流，實現 token 級對齊與穩健的訓練端 log-prob 重算，即使 harness 端有歷史壓縮或重新序列化亦然，對稀疏 MoE 另有路由重放（R3）；(2) 以可擴充沙箱編排、映像快取與分段防禦維護獎勵完整性；(3) 以自動驗證外掛與 Live UI 提供軌跡級診斷與失敗監控。作者以 GSPO 訓練 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，橫跨 OpenHands SDK、Claude Code 與 OpenCode 三個原生 harness：SWE-bench Verified 解題率分別從 64.0% 升至 70.4%、62.4% 至 68.2%、57.2% 至 66.6%，rollout—訓練機率相關性維持在 0.99 以上。限制：單一模型、每配置僅一次運行、終端二元獎勵無法給予中間行為信用。

links.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'The correct reference does not provide a consistent performance benefit across teacher generation modes, model sizes, and training datasets. Students can improve without the correct reference, and a solution from another problem can outperform the correct solution on several mathematical reasoning benchmarks.'

Section 4.2, Table 1: On NuminaMath with a non-thinking teacher, mismatched reference averages 67.6 vs 59.5 for the correct reference; paired intervals in Table 10 show +12.5 [6.4,18.9] on AIME 2025 and +11.7 [6.1,17.5] on HMMT 2025.

Section 4.4, Figure 4(b): cosine similarity of student change with D_ref exceeds its control by only 0.05 on NuminaMath and 0.10 on MegaScience; Table 2 shows control R_c^2 (0.94-0.98) matches or exceeds evaluated-problem values (0.88-0.97).
Section 3.2-3.6: formal decomposition D_tot = D_ref + D_rec, projection/cosine metrics, controls from other problems, bootstrap uncertainty, and three control pairings (Appendix B.1, Table 15).
Section 5 Limitations: 'We train each condition once, so our results do not measure variation across repeated training runs'; experiments limited to Qwen3 models and math/science datasets.
Section 2: acknowledges concurrent work Ichihara et al. (arXiv:2608.09228) finding that a solution from another problem can preserve or improve OPSD performance.

Appendix A.3/A.6, Tables 6, 7, 14: complete hyperparameters (LoRA rank 64/alpha 128, lr 5e-6, 300 steps, seed 42), dataset quotas (Table 3), prompts (Appendix A.2), and software versions, but no code or artifact availability claim.

Appendix A.4, Table 11: checkpoint selection uses MATH-500/AIME24 (NuminaMath) and MATH-500/GPQA-D (MegaScience), which are also reported benchmarks, though the procedure is disclosed and paired tests are limited to pre-specified comparisons (A.4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology research squarely within preferred topics: on-policy self-distillation of LLMs (Qwen3 1.7B-8B) for mathematical/scientific reasoning, with LoRA fine-tuning and a careful analysis of how privileged reference conditioning shapes token-level teacher supervision. The paper asks a sharp methodological question (does the student actually learn from the reference, or recover base-model thinking behavior?) and answers it with a well-defined decomposition framework (reference-dependent vs reference-free directions), matched controls from other problems, three control pairings, paired bootstrap uncertainty, checkpoint-selection disclosure, benchmark decontamination, and reference-type ablations (answer-only, hints, canonical solutions, 8B/32B traces). Claims are appropriately hedged and supported by quantitative tables (mismatched reference beating correct reference on AIME/HMMT under non-thinking teachers; control directions reproducing most distributional alignment). Limitations are honestly stated: single run per condition, only Qwen3 models, math/science only. Novelty is moderate because the decomposition builds on Purified OPSD and concurrent work (Ichihara et al., Nguyen et al.) already reported mismatched-reference findings, though the control-based alignment analysis and alignment-performance dissociation are distinctive. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters/prompts/software versions but no code or artifact release is stated; checkpoint selection on reported benchmarks is a minor concern.

primary_link.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own responses using token-level supervision from the same model conditioned on privileged reference information. We investigate whether performance gains from OPSD show that the student learned the information in the reference or instead reflect recovery of reasoning behavior already present in the base model. We perform OPSD experiments on science and mathematics datasets using Qwen3 models ranging from 1.7B to 8B. Our analysis framewor
papers.summary_zh: On-policy self-distillation（OPSD）讓學生在自己生成的回應上，接受同一模型在獲得特權參考資訊條件下提供的 token 級監督。本文追問：效能增益究竟是顯示學生學到了參考中的資訊，還是只是恢復基礎模型已有的推理行為？作者以 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 在 NuminaMath 與 MegaScience 上進行 OPSD，提出分析框架將教師監督分解為「由參考引發」與「無參考」兩個方向，並以其他題目的參考構建對照組，測量兩者與學生預測變化的對齊程度。結果顯示：正確參考在不同教師生成模式、模型規模與訓練資料間沒有一致的效能優勢；學生在沒有正確參考時仍能進步，且來自其他題目的解答在多個數學競賽基準上可勝過正確解答；學生預測變化與基礎模型思考行為的對齊，強於與參考引發監督的對齊，但對照組重現了兩者的大部分對齊；更強的對齊並不必然伴隨更大的效能效益。限制：僅涵蓋 Qwen3 模型與數理科學領域，每個條件只訓練一次，無法衡量重複訓練的變異。此研究的核心警示是：單憑效能增益與分布對齊，無法判定特權資訊在 OPSD 中的實際貢獻。
papers.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.title_zh: 重新思考 On-Policy Self-Distillation 中的特權資訊

links.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation

evidence: Abstract: 'Across five open-source gateways connected to OpenAI and Anthropic, none bound customers to upstream credentials by default; under a shared credential, all five exposed cross-customer cache reads for both providers.'
Section V-A: 'On OpenAI, the observer saw exactly four upstream requests in P/P/P/P' order... every gateway produced [0,1408,1408,0]' with native Anthropic cells [0,h,h,0], h from 1,066 to 1,074.
Section V-B: 'One principal with one namespace crossed 5/5, splitting the namespace under one principal crossed 0/5... whose exact two sided value is p=0.008'; pool partition contrast 3/3 vs 0/3.
Section VI-A: 'All eight dependent commits were correct with no abstention... The target space contained 4^8 = 65,536 sequences, which represents 16 bits of committed target'; 258 total requests.

Section IX-B: 'We found no stable production setting for general extraction of arbitrary content. The strongest evidence is one chain with eight steps over four known words of equal token length... in one favorable cell carrying 16 bits.'

Section VII-C and Table XIII: 'Shared paths crossed in 5/5 gateways. Exclusive paths crossed in 0/5 and retained all five owner hot repeats'; HMAC-derived namespace arm removed the edge against a real OpenAI upstream.
Section VII-D: 'the split increased modeled cost by 1.7 to 2.5% and exposed zero cached tokens from private regions across customers' over 5,713 replayed request events.

Appendix B-A: frozen revisions listed (NewAPI e0d515611588, uni-api 20da7a7cc6f7, MetaAPI 41767a65ec8e, LiteLLM 7e66f00fca08, Sub2API b8b72e1b1831) with observer-verified runtime records; Appendix B-L notes anonymized relays and machine-readable analyses.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems-security measurement paper on prompt-cache isolation across LLM API relays/gateways, directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, AI safety (side channels, vulnerabilities, defenses), inference/serving (caching, KV cache, deployment), and red-teaming/evaluation. Not a domain-application or vision/audio/diffusion paper. Novelty is incremental over prior cache side-channel work (CacheProbe, Gu et al., Early Bird, InputSnatch) but the component-level localization of which relay transformation (credential, pool, adapter, nested hop) collapses cache identity, plus the HMAC-derived namespace defense contract and public/private split, are genuine contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: formal threat model (Sec. II), matched interventions with exact p=0.008 and Clopper-Pearson intervals (Sec. V-B, App. B-D), shadow-history attribution with full replay control (Sec. IV-F, VI-A), preregistered target commitment, frozen revisions, E0-E3 evidence tiers, and an abstaining protocol. Evidence is strong but carefully scoped: 10 real-upstream gateway cells ([0,1408,1408,0] across five gateways, Sec. V-A), 12/28 positive OpenRouter labels covering 33.7% of eligible volume, and one live 16-bit extraction chain; however, intervention arms have tiny denominators (5/5, 3/3), the OpenRouter frame uses one account pair (Sec. IX-A), and extraction is limited to a controlled four-word alphabet (Sec. IX-B candidly states no stable general-extraction setting was found). Defense validation is mostly local-fixture with one real-upstream namespace prototype (Sec. VII-C/D). Reproducibility is aided by frozen commits, request ledgers, and machine-readable analyses, but production relays are anonymized ('coded relay names protect ongoing disclosure') and provider cache behavior is time-varying.

primary_link.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) API relays authenticate customers separately but often forward requests through shared provider credentials. Providers scope prompt caches to upstream principals and namespaces, so relay customers mapped to one cache identity can observe each other's cache state. Prior work showed cache sharing at selected endpoints but did not identify which credential, pool, adapter, or nested hop controls the finalidentity. We present KeyPooling, a measurement method that traces cus
papers.summary_zh: LLM API 中繼服務對客戶分別驗證身分，卻常以共享的供應商憑證轉發請求；供應商的提示快取以上游主體界定範圍，被映射到同一快取身分的中繼客戶因此能觀察彼此的快取狀態，進而洩露提示成員資訊甚至逐 token 復原內容。本文提出 KeyPooling 測量方法：沿憑證、命名空間、轉接器、憑證池與巢狀中繼追蹤客戶身分至最終快取查詢與寫入，以執行期觀察者驗證實際轉換，並一次只改變一個預測的身分元件做對照實驗。跨五個開源閘道器連接 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的測試顯示：預設皆未將客戶綁定至上游憑證，共享憑證下五者全部出現跨客戶快取讀取；主體與命名空間分割、池分割、轉接器對照與巢狀覆寫等介入則定位出控制轉換。在與結果無關的 OpenRouter 週期抽樣框架中，測試涵蓋 80.5% 的合格 token 量，28 個標籤中有 12 個（占 33.7% 流量）出現跨帳號讀取；一條生產路由更支援在無法存取目標的情況下連續復原八個位置的受控目標。作者據此提出防禦契約：每位客戶必須落入供應商強制的網域，或由驗證身分衍生的命名空間必須在每次最終查詢與寫入存活；在公共前綴之後分割可保留大部分重用，成本僅增 1.7–2.5%。

links.title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents

evidence: Abstract: Wuying-Browser-Agent-27B achieves 80.6% on WebVoyager, 66.7% on Online-Mind2Web, and 65.1% on BrowserBench, claimed as new open-source state of the art

Section 7.6.1, Table 4: RUIC-SFT curriculum (variant #5) raises BrowserBench SR from 32.0% (Base SFT) to 38.0% and recovery SR from 8.5% to 18.5% while reducing average steps to 22.4; early-reflection variant (#6) degrades to 35.1%

Section 7.6.2, Table 5: DAO-GRPO ablation improves SR from 39.4% (vanilla online GRPO) to 42.9% and hard-task SR from 23.8% to 30.5%, with PBRS, divergence credit, and response-level objective each contributing

Section 7.6.3: LLM divergence estimator localizes t* exactly in 61% of 100 labeled groups and agrees with humans on branch partition in 94%; +/-2-step perturbation costs only 0.9 points (42.9% to 42.0%), random placement drops to 40.3%
Section 7.6.4: progress estimator Phi reaches Spearman rho=0.81 and MAE 0.11 against human ratings on 150 prefixes (IAA rho=0.89)
Section 7.2: LLM judge audited on 500 trajectories with 96.4% agreement to independent human annotation; same judge family also used for online-RL reward estimation
Section 5: BrowserBench contains 350 real-web tasks across 254 websites, 54.6% Chinese / 45.4% English, average 37.9 steps (max 100), difficulty calibrated by three non-Qwen reference agents
Section 7.1: disclosed training settings - LoRA rank 16 alpha=64 (SFT) and rank 8 alpha=16 (RL), peak lr 5e-5, 10% warmup, two epochs, 50-step rollout cap vs 100-step eval budget
Section 4.3.3: 'The specific values of these hyperparameters are tuned on the validation set and omitted here' - explicit reproducibility gap for step-credit weights
Section 7.5, Table 3: transfer results - Tau2-Bench 91.6, Claw-Eval avg 74.1, BFCL-v4 76.5 (average 73.8), improving over Qwen3.5-27B on all benchmarks
Section 6: flywheel bootstraps ~3000 trajectories yielding ~420 verified reflection examples and 130 UI-component scenes folded into released models
Section 3.2: all interactions run in Wuying AgentBay, a cloud-native sandbox service accessed via MCP - proprietary infrastructure dependency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research squarely inside preferred scope: browser agents with a structured tool space, MCP interface, curriculum SFT, and online GRPO RL, plus a new bilingual benchmark. Relevance is high but not Japanese-focused (Chinese-English). Novelty is a well-motivated but incremental combination of known techniques (PBRS from Ng et al. 1999, GRPO, curriculum learning), with the divergence-aware step-credit weighting and response-level objective over reconstructed contexts as the freshest parts. Rigor is above average: component-wise ablations (Tables 4-5), reliability audits of both LLM-based components (Sections 7.6.3-7.6.4), judge-human agreement audit (96.4%, Section 7.2), difficulty/length slice analysis, and training-dynamics figures; weaknesses include Pass@1 results without variance/seeds across noisy live-web tasks, ablations confined to the 9B backbone, and a judge family shared with reward estimation (audited but not eliminated). Evidence within the document is extensive and internally consistent, though the 'open-source state of the art' margin over Qwen3.8-Max is narrow (70.8 vs 70.3) and no release links are verifiable. Generalizability is supported by transfer to Tau2-Bench/Claw-Eval/BFCL-v4 and three model scales, but the pipeline is harness- and browser-specific. Reproducibility is the weakest component: key step-weight hyperparameters are explicitly omitted (Section 4.3.3), the divergence/progress estimators and data-annotation pipelines are under-specified, and training depends on the proprietary AgentBay sandbox, despite disclosed LoRA/optimizer settings and action-space definitions.

primary_link.title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents

papers.summary: Browser agents perform well on short, clean demonstrations, but real deployment is fundamentally different: agents must sustain dozens of decisions on live websites while recovering from mistakes and navigating complex UIs. We argue that closing this gap requires alignment at every level of the pipeline, including execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation, rather than scale alone. We present Wuying-Browser-Agent, a unified framework that addresses each of these levels. A structured br
papers.summary_zh: 瀏覽器代理在短而乾淨的示範上表現良好，但真實部署要求代理在動態網站上維持數十個決策、從錯誤中復原並應對複雜 UI。本文指出三個相互交織的結構性挑戰：訓練資料由成功軌跡主導、缺乏復原與複雜 UI 的監督；長軌跡中少數關鍵分支步驟的學習訊號被均勻稀釋；現有基準低估雙語長時程真實網站任務。對應方案為統一管線：結構化瀏覽器 harness 提供穩定的執行原語與決策導向的情境管理；RUIC-SFT 以反思豐富的復原軌跡與 UI 專門資料進行三階段課程式微調；DAO-GRPO 透過基於勢函數的獎勵塑形、分歧感知的步驟信用加權與回應級最佳化，改善長時程信用分配。另建構 BrowserBench：350 個中英雙語真實網站任務，平均 37.9 步、橫跨 254 個網站。Wuying-Browser-Agent-27B 在 WebVoyager 達 80.6%、Online-Mind2Web 達 66.7%、BrowserBench 達 65.1%，刷新開源瀏覽器代理的最好成績，並在 Tau2-Bench、Claw-Eval 與 BFCL-v4 達平均 73.8，展現通用代理能力。消融實驗確認各元件貢獻：RL 增益隨任務難度與軌跡長度遞增，符合長時程設計動機。

links.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: o3 falls from 96% on atomic queries to 82% on the most compositional while the 4B program-synthesis model holds at 93%, 'matching or exceeding the frontier on the hardest tasks at a fraction of the token cost'.
Section 2.5: 'we additionally cross-check every released instance against a second, independently written Python+NetworkX implementation of each category' — programmatically verified ground truth.

Table 6 / Section 4.5: within-model comparison on Qwen3-4B — answer SFT reaches 59.2% held-out with a 19.3pp seen/held-out gap, while Ein SFT reaches 94.3% held-out with a 3.7pp gap; 61 of 74 remaining errors are graph-parsing (edge misreading), only 8 incorrect program logic.
Section 3.3 and Table 10: strict and lenient scoring reported for every configuration; method ordering preserved, program-synthesis gap 0.0-0.3pp vs 4.5-6.3pp for direct small models.
Section 4.4: error taxonomy over the 89 L3 errors of GPT-4.1 CoT — direction confusion 24%, depth truncation 26%, accumulation drift 19% — with worked examples in Appendix L.

Table 7 / Section 4.6: compositional penalty survives JSON edge-list and adjacency-matrix encodings; encoding preference is capacity-dependent (adjacency matrix worst for open models, best for Gemini 2.5 Flash).

Limitations (Section 5): program-synthesis result uses one 4B base model and two targets; no 30B+ open models tested; memorisation probe is a single model/configuration diagnostic that does not address pretraining contamination.

Appendix G: repository releases the 1,300-instance split, raw JSONL responses with reasoning traces, generator producing fresh instances 'in under one minute', and training scripts with adapter weights promised on Hugging Face.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-evaluation paper squarely within scope: it benchmarks frontier (o3, GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5) and open-weight Qwen models on compositional graph reasoning, contrasts direct vs chain-of-thought prompting, and fine-tunes via LoRA to emit verified programs. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, evaluation benchmarks, prompting, program synthesis) though not Japanese-NLP related. Novelty is moderate: constructive/procedural benchmarks (DyVal, LiveBench) and program-synthesis-for-graph-reasoning (Zhu et al. 2025, Guo et al. 2025) already exist; the contributions are the primitive-decomposed taxonomy with three independent difficulty axes, dual-implementation verified ground truth, and a seen-vs-held-out memorisation probe. Rigor is strong: temperature-0 decoding, pinned model commits, strict-vs-lenient scoring reported side-by-side (Table 10), format-error decomposition (Table 11), encoding ablation (Table 7), 3-seed memorisation probe, and an honest limitations section. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (e.g., 1,226/1,300 held-out correct, 74-error taxonomy), though key SFT results rest on a single base model and essentially single runs; the headline 'matches or exceeds frontier' claim is appropriately hedged by the authors themselves. Generalizability is limited by small graphs (n=4-20), purely synthetic tasks, and one 4B SFT model, as acknowledged. Reproducibility is excellent: generator, harness, raw responses, seeds, hyperparameters, datasheet, and licensing all released.

primary_link.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning

papers.summary: We introduce ClosureBench, a constructive benchmark for compositional graph-relational reasoning with programmatically verified ground truth. Unlike fixed-test-set benchmarks vulnerable to data contamination, ClosureBench generates instances on demand: each task's reference answer is computed by executing a program in the Ein tensor-logic language, ensuring machine-verified correctness. The benchmark spans 26 task categories at three compositional levels (L1-L3), with difficulty controlled along
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在多步驟組合式推理上常被認為表現不佳，但既有圖形推理基準多為固定題組，容易受資料污染，且只能沿單一粗略軸變化難度。本文提出 ClosureBench，一個建構式基準：每個任務由明確的邏輯基元（可達性、度數、集合運算、強連通元件、聚合）組合而成，參考答案透過執行 Ein 張量邏輯程式（並以 Python+NetworkX 交叉驗證）計算，可程式化驗證且能無限產生新實例。基準涵蓋 26 個類別、三個組合層級，並提供圖形大小、邊密度與查詢深度三個獨立難度軸。實驗顯示，從 1.5B 開源模型到 o3、GPT-4.1、Gemini 2.5、Claude Sonnet 4 等前沿模型，準確率隨圖形變大與查詢變深而下降；失敗不在表面形式（改以 JSON 邊列表或鄰接矩陣呈現仍持續）或規則本身，而在跨多步驟於圖上執行計算。一個微調為輸出已驗證程式的 4B 模型在各層級間幾乎持平（整體 94.3%），而 o3 從原子查詢的 96% 掉到最組合查詢的 82%；程式合成每個正確答案約 212 tokens，遠低於前沿 CoT。記憶化探針顯示以答案監督微調會產生 19.3 個百分點的已見/留存集落差。限制包括僅涵蓋圖論任務、程式合成只在單一 4B 模型上驗證。此基準對防堵資料污染、精確定位推理失敗點，以及展示低成本的程式合成路線具重要意義。
papers.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ClosureBench：組合式圖形推理的建構式基準

Section 3.3: trajectories scored by GPT-5.4 with four binary labels (Utility, ASR, Persistence, Detection); pooled metrics defined over 3 seeds with seed-level standard deviations (Eqs. 3.4-3.7)

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent safety benchmark directly matching top-weighted preferences (agents/tool use, AI safety, red-team evaluation, LLMs). Main contribution is a six-phase lifecycle taxonomy (including Incident Recovery, uncovered by prior benchmarks per Table 1) and a 128-case sandboxed suite evaluated across 3 harnesses and 14 model-harness configurations. Rigor is above average: formal threat model, validated GPT-5.4 judge against deterministic predicates and adjudicated human labels (Cohen's kappa 0.65-0.83, Table 3), three sampling seeds with deviations, bootstrap CIs, and an unusually candid limitations section (Appendix G) acknowledging that cross-harness contrasts are confounded and that the detection-ASR association loses significance after adjustment (Appendix E, p=0.101). Evidence is internally consistent (ASR range 12.6%-80.9% matches Table 2), but findings rest on mock-service sandboxes, a proprietary judge, and one-time snapshots of fast-drifting proprietary models. Reproducibility claim is credible (Appendix H releases cases, adapters, evaluator prompts, scripts) yet conditional on archived trajectories and proprietary APIs. Solid, honest benchmark paper rather than a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed through agent harnesses that manage tools, extensions, persistent state, permissions, and external actions. Existing safety benchmarks mainly target individual attack mechanisms or a limited subset of operational settings, making it difficult to compare how safety failures emerge across different harness responsibilities. We present HarnessRisk, a lifecycle oriented benchmark that organizes agent harness safety into six operational phases including
papers.summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型透過 agent harness（管理工具、擴充、持久狀態、權限與外部動作的執行框架）部署，其安全不再只取決於模型本身。既有安全基準多聚焦個別攻擊機制或執行期行為，難以比較不同 harness 職責下的安全失效。本文提出 HarnessRisk，以生命週期六大階段（harness 設定、能力擴充、執行期操作、狀態持久化、動作控制、事件復原）組織風險，包含 128 個沙盒案例：每個案例將良性使用者目標與藏在不可信工作流程產物中的對抗指令配對，以三輪 owner 訊息驅動，每次執行皆從全新環境開始並關閉真實對外網路。評估採 Utility、攻擊成功率（ASR）、Persistence、Detection 四項指標，由 GPT-5.4 軌跡評估器判定，並以確定性謂詞與人工標註驗證其可靠性。在 OpenClaw、Nanobot、Hermes 三種 harness 與六個模型共 14 種組合上，ASR 介於 12.6% 至 80.9%，但 Utility 仍達 75.0% 至 97.6%，顯示高任務完成率可能掩蓋不安全行為。Harness 設定是最脆弱的階段；同一模型在不同 harness 下 ASR 可相差逾四倍；而偵測到風險未必帶來安全行動。限制包括以部署原貌評估、各 harness 可觀測性不同。此基準凸顯安全須以「模型＋harness」配置層級評估。
papers.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
papers.title_zh: HarnessRisk：以生命週期為導向的 Agent Harness 安全基準

Table 3: P2 residual CIs exclude zero for 41.7-87.5% of 48 comparisons per model; supported preference reversals in 2.1-12.5% of comparisons.
Table 1 (Section 4.2): 300 queries across 3 domains, 15 completions each, 4,500 calls per model; Appendix B.4 reports 27,000 recorded completions for the main audit.
Appendix A.2, Proposition 1 with proof: P1 path-sum and P2 item-vs-offer-pair equivalences are derived as implications of the self-consistency hypothesis.

Appendix B.4 Table 5: exact model strings, providers, seeds 10000-10014, temperature settings, token limits, collection dates July 27-28, 2026; paper notes no immutable snapshot identifier was retained.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM evaluation/alignment-adjacent work: audits whether numerical LLM preference judgments (item WTP and offer-pair tradeoffs) admit one quasi-linear dollar utility, directly relevant to reward/preference-learning pipelines and LLM-as-judge reliability. Novelty is solid but incremental: prior audits tested ordinal/logical judge consistency; this paper adds a cardinal, numeraire-anchored self-consistency test with formal P1/P2 diagnostics. Rigor is high (prespecified design, Bonferroni correction, within-query bootstrap, OLS utility fit with leverage analysis, effect sizes separated from p-values, proved propositions), though 15 completions/query, Wald intervals, and acknowledged residual dependence temper it. Evidence is strong for the audited claim (all six models reject the joint hypothesis; P2 CIs exclude zero in 41.7-87.5% of comparisons) but rests on three artificial domains, hand-written utterances, stateless calls, and no human-fidelity baseline. Generalizability is deliberately scoped and limited; reproducibility is good (exact prompts, seeds, API configs, parse diagnostics) but no explicit code/data URL and provider-version drift are acknowledged.

primary_link.title: LLM-Derived Preference Judgments Are Not Self-Consistent

papers.summary: Agents increasingly interpret a person's natural-language preferences by querying an LLM for numerical preference judgments, e.g., by asking how much the person would be willing to pay for an item. A growing body of work estimates a utility function from these judgments and then chooses actions based on their estimated utility. This pipeline assumes the judgments are approximately self-consistent: that a single utility function can reproduce them. But are they? To study this question, we measure
papers.summary_zh: 越來越多系統請大型語言模型把使用者的自然語言偏好轉成數值判斷（例如願付價格），再據此估計效用函數並做決策；這條流程隱含假設：各種提問方式得到的判斷可由同一個效用函數重現。本文檢驗此「自我一致性」假設：對每個項目查詢最高願付價格，並對報價對（offer pair）查詢使使用者無差異的帶號價格調整量，在貨幣擬線性假設下，兩者應可由單一效用函數同時解釋。作者發展全域 bootstrap 檢定（配適最適效用後的 RMSE 是否可由取樣雜訊解釋）與兩個局部檢定：P1 比較直接報價對估計與沿路徑加總，P2 比較報價對估計與兩個項目查詢的價差調整差值。在航班、公寓、旅館三個受控領域、三種偏好語句與六個模型（含 Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 3.6 27B，各 4,500 次呼叫）上，六個模型在 Bonferroni 修正後皆拒絕九組全部自洽的聯合主張；P2 殘差的信賴區間有 41.7%–87.5% 不含零，2.1%–12.5% 的比較甚至出現偏好反轉，旅館領域的 RMSE 為標價的 18.9%–44.9%。此審計只檢驗內部一致性而非對人類偏好的忠實度，且使用受控項目與固定提示。結論提醒演算法設計者：LLM 偏好判斷依提問形式與模型而異，部署前應先審計一致性，並儘可能與真人判斷互相印證。

Section 5.1: seed-matched gains of 4.67/6.33/6.75 points at 8B and 8.62/10.14/11.91 at 14B, so the ordering holds in all runs at both scales

Table 4 (Section 5.3): Shifted (33.92) and Randomized (32.66) conditions fall below Outcome-only (34.70), indicating reaction semantics and temporal alignment, not token-level variation, drive the gain
Section 5.1/Appendix D.3: each step-120 checkpoint is evaluated once, so run-level standard deviations 'do not separately identify' training variation from evaluation stochasticity
Appendix F: paired Telecom audits with McNemar p=5.80e-15 (τ2) and p=1.24e-6 (τ3), while noting a τ3 Service reversal (20/29 vs 24/29) showing non-uniform gains
Limitations: results rely on a frozen DeepSeek-V4-Flash simulator emitting private strategy metadata; recovery from observable utterances or real users remains open
Appendix C: full frozen user-simulator prompt with JSON strategy schema disclosed; Appendix G lists hardware (8×B200), VERL/SGLang stack, K=8, lr 1e-6, λ=0.5, step-120 checkpoint
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper (agentic RL, tool use, credit assignment, GRPO) that squarely matches top-weighted preferences; not a domain application. The mechanism — mapping the simulator's private next-user reaction strategy to ternary credit, locally z-normalized per U2U anchor and added to terminal GRPO advantage without a critic or extra rollouts — is a sensible but incremental variant of existing turn-level/process-reward and user-follow-up reward work (FLR, RLUF, GiGPO, SWEET-RL), which the paper itself positions narrowly. Rigor is strong: matched outcome-only Interactive GRPO controls sharing simulator, SFT init, rollouts, and optimizer; three independent seeds per scale with seed-matched orderings; shifted/randomized-polarity ablations; λ sweep; zero-shot transfer; honest limitation discussion. Evidence is weakened by single one-shot evaluation per checkpoint (dispersion conflates training and evaluation noise), single-run ablations, gains concentrated in Telecom, and low absolute OOD rates (Pare-Bench Pass@1 10.49–13.29%). Generalizability is conditional on an instrumented simulator emitting private strategy metadata; utterance-only extraction and real users remain open. Reproducibility is aided by disclosed hyperparameters, the full simulator prompt, raw counts, and public SFT data, but depends on a frozen commercial DeepSeek-V4-Flash service endpoint and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Towards Better Agents for Multi-Turn User Interaction: The Next User Turn Is More Than Context

papers.summary: User-facing tool agents must coordinate dialogue and tool use as user goals unfold over multiple turns. Yet interactive reinforcement learning typically reduces each rollout to a terminal reward, assigning the same credit to effective elicitation, errors, and later repair. The next user turn is more than context: it also provides noisy, temporally local evidence about the preceding user-to-user segment. We introduce \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{C}redit \textbf{A}ssignment (\textsc{FA
papers.summary_zh: 多輪使用者互動 agent 須在目標逐步展開時協調對話與工具使用，但互動式強化學習通常只把整條 rollout 化約為終端獎勵，讓有效引導、犯錯與後續修復得到相同優勢。本文的核心觀察是：下一個使用者輪次不只是上下文，也為其前一個「使用者到使用者（U2U）片段」提供帶雜訊、時間上局部的證據。作者提出 Feedback-Aware Credit Assignment（Faca）：將模擬使用者的私有反應策略對齊到前一個 U2U 片段，映射為正（進展）、負（摩擦）、零（中性）三元極性，於局部 rollout 群組內正規化得到反應優勢，再以 λ=0.5 加到已驗證的終端結果優勢上；全程不需額外 critic 或 rollout，反應標籤也不進入 agent 可見上下文。在與 outcome-only Interactive GRPO 嚴格匹配的控制組（共享凍結的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模擬器與全部訓練設定）比較下，Faca 於 τ-bench 家族九個領域平均在 8B 提升 5.91 個百分點、14B 提升 10.22 個百分點（各三次獨立訓練），增益集中在回饋豐富的 Telecom；隨機化反應極性或錯位對齊會抹除增益。在 Pare-Bench 與 Co-Gym 的零樣本轉移中排序維持，但 Co-Gym Travel 略有退步。限制包括依賴凍結模擬器的私有策略標註、僅驗證 Qwen3 8B/14B。此研究顯示隱含使用者回饋可作為多輪 agent 的實用局部監督訊號。

links.title: The IOL-AI Challenge: An Open Challenge towards Advancing Linguistic Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: challenge drew 731 submissions from 46 teams under a strict compute budget (one T4, 30 mins); Claude Opus 4.8 earned a jury score equivalent to a gold medal while resource-constrained systems scored in the bottom 5% range.

Section 5.1.1: within-team technique effects — self-consistency voting adds +2.08 (n=21), retry/reformat loops +1.40 (n=14), chain-of-thought prompting -1.55 (n=25), JSON-structured output -4.66 (n=10); none of the top ten used CoT.
Section 5.2.1: jury and automatic metrics show near-perfect rank agreement (Spearman rho=1.00, Pearson r=0.99, n=5) but compressed scale, with weak systems upscored by roughly 13 points.
Section 4.1: submissions run as isolated HF Jobs on a single NVIDIA T4 (16 GB VRAM) under a 30-minute wall-clock limit with offline sandboxing to prevent data leakage.

Limitations: authors acknowledge small test set (5 problems, 14 sub-assignments) with low statistical power, oracle selection in the BoN ensemble, unequal generation budgets (DeepSeek R1 32B at 32,768 vs 64,000 tokens), and possible copying among public submission repositories.

Section 5.3 and Tables 7-8: removing language meta-information yields non-significant changes across three seeded runs (95% CIs) except for Yelî Dnye (-5.8, 6/7 models), supporting the claim that prior knowledge does not determine success.

Conclusion footnote 8: jury evaluations, model outputs, and scores released at github.com/Cohere-Labs-Community/iol-ai-2026-results; Appendix H details archived submission repositories and backbone identification from shipped weights.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-reasoning evaluation paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences: benchmarks 15+ LLMs (Qwen, DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Gemini) on linguistic reasoning, with explicit chain-of-thought, self-consistency, prompting, and decoding experiments under quantization/compute constraints. Novelty is moderate-to-good rather than high: linguistic-olympiad benchmarks (PuzzLing Machines, LingOly, Linguini, LOBSTER) already exist, and the contribution is the genuinely unseen IOL 2026 test set plus first jury grading of AI solutions under human-contestant rubrics. Rigor is solid: controlled T4/30-min sandbox, organizer baselines, within-team technique-effect measurement (self-consistency +2.08 n=21; CoT -1.55 n=25), 3-seed anonymization ablation with 95% CIs, and honest limitations (small 14-task test set, low statistical power, oracle BoN ensemble, submission copying). Evidence is well-grounded in tables but rests on a single contest year and n=5 for the jury-correlation headline claim; knowledge-probing findings are correctly framed as correlational. Generalizability is limited by the one-contest, five-language scope, though findings on decoding-vs-capacity and automatic-vs-jury score compression likely transfer. Reproducibility is strong: public archived HF submission repositories, full prompts/hyperparameters in appendices, and released jury scores/outputs on GitHub.

primary_link.title: The IOL-AI Challenge: An Open Challenge towards Advancing Linguistic Reasoning

papers.summary: Reasoning in LLMs is overwhelmingly studied in domains that provide a model with rules: mathematics and code. Linguistic puzzles invert this: the solver must first discover the system before reasoning within it. We present the IOL-AI Challenge, an open-science competition run on the unseen problems of the International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) 2026 Individual Contest, evaluated both automatically and, for the first time, by members of the official IOL Jury under the same rubrics applied to hum
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的推理研究多集中於數學與程式等規則明確的領域，而語言學謎題則要求解題者先從有限語料中發掘未知的語言系統，再據此推理。本文提出 IOL-AI 挑戰賽，以國際語言學奧林匹亞（IOL）2026 個人賽的全新未公開題目作為測試集，從根本杜絕資料外洩疑慮。挑戰賽吸引46個團隊提交731份作品，在單張 T4 GPU、30分鐘的嚴格運算限制下競賽；作者另對15個前沿與開源模型進行基準測試，並首度由 IOL 官方評審團以人類選手相同的評分標準進行人工評分。結果顯示 Claude Opus 4.8 獲得相當於金牌的評審分數，Gemini 3.6 Flash 達銀牌水準；而受限於運算資源的參賽系統則落入後5%，即使14B模型經解碼與輸出處理最佳化可超越兩倍大小的模型，仍與前沿差距甚大。自動指標與評審排名完全一致（Spearman ρ=1.00），但會壓縮分數範圍，高估弱系統約13分並低估強系統。知識探測實驗顯示模型對題目語言的既有知識並不能決定解題成敗，印證語言學推理是可泛化推理能力的有效基準。限制包括測試集規模小、提交之間可能互相抄襲等。此研究凸顯開源與閉源模型在泛化推理上的鴻溝，極具指標意義。

Section 4 Datasets: training on RealtimeQA Jan 2024-Dec 2025; evaluation on temporal OOD RealtimeQA Jan-Jun 2026 (365 questions) plus SQuAD, TruthfulQA, NQ-Open, FreshQA (200 each)
Section 4.2/Appendix F.4, Table 14: InnerExpert adds ~3x vanilla inference time and ~3% peak GPU memory vs multi-pass sampling baselines; HaluNet cheaper but lower AUROC
Limitations: human validation small scale and English-only evaluation; Appendix G lists threshold calibration and cross-model transfer as open problems

Section 1/Appendix D: public code link (github.com/joaopfonseca/InnerExpert-Hallucination-Detection); HaluNet re-implemented from paper description due to no open-source implementation; Algorithms 1-2 and prompt templates provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: per-token hallucination detection for LLMs using MoE-specific routing signals, evaluated across five QA datasets and two open-weight MoE hosts with sampling-based, internal-signal, and trainable baselines. Novelty is solid but bounded: the six MoE signals (router entropy, expert similarity, usage Gini/Herfindahl, etc.) are new for hallucination detection, yet the detector is a standard lightweight classifier over compact features and the underlying idea closely extends LLM-Check-style internal-signal probing. Rigor is generally good (temporal OOD split, grouped splits to prevent leakage, signal ablations, cost benchmarks) but is undercut by LLM-as-judge ground truth validated against only one annotator on 200 samples (86.5% agreement), notable AUROC-vs-F1 inconsistencies (XGBoost threshold collapse to 0.276 token F1 on Gemma), classifier instability across host models, and minor internal inconsistencies (Appendix D vs F for hyperparameter grids; a listed 'five classifiers' grid that enumerates four in Section 4). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent with the headline claims, but all metrics rest on judge-produced labels with acknowledged noise and extreme OLMoE label imbalance (83-95% hallucinated). Generalizability is limited by design to MoE architectures, English-only data, and untested cross-model transfer. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link, detailed algorithms, prompts, hyperparameter grids, and hardware/cost reporting, though it depends on a proprietary judge API (GLM-5.1) and ~1.7 TB of data artifacts.

primary_link.title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals

papers.summary: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass act
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常生成貌似合理卻錯誤的內容，即所謂幻覺。現有偵測方法多在答案或句子層級運作，難以精確定位幻覺片段。本文提出 InnerExpert，首個利用混合專家（MoE）架構專屬內部訊號進行逐 token 幻覺偵測的方法。MoE 模型在單次前向傳播中會透過路由機制啟用稀疏專家，產生路由熵、專家分歧度、專家使用分佈等密集架構所沒有的訊號。InnerExpert 將這些路由層級訊號與傳統隱藏狀態、注意力分數整合為精簡的逐 token 特徵向量，再以輕量分類器判定；訓練標籤由 LLM-as-a-judge 管線依參考證據自動產生，無需人工標註，可持續更新。在兩個開源 MoE 模型（OLMoE-1B-7B 與 Gemma-4-26B）與五個資料集上，InnerExpert 達到最高 0.91 的答案層級與 0.76 的 token 層級 AUROC，超越 SelfCheckGPT、Semantic Uncertainty、LLM-Check 與 HaluNet 等基線，且只需單次前向傳播，運算負擔僅約原生成成本的3倍。訊號分析顯示單一 MoE 訊號在不同架構上表現不一致，但組合使用可穩定提升效能。限制包括僅評估英文、人工驗證規模小、分類器門檻敏感等。此方法為高效且細粒度的幻覺偵測提供可行路徑。

links.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps

evidence: Abstract: 'a benchmark of 142 risk tasks built on real Android applications' with attack success rates 'ranging from 40.4% to 66.9%' across six agents.

Section 3.3: two-stage pipeline where 'rule-based verification handles unambiguous cases, while an LLM judge adjudicates ambiguous ones' and five-level labels (Executed, Partial, Defended, Stalled, Run Failed).
Section 3.3 / Appendix L: '92.1% exact agreement over 76 adjudicated cases' between a human expert and the Stage-2 LLM judge for Gemini-3-Pro and Claude-Sonnet-4.5.
Section 4.2: specialized GUI agents' lower ASR 'largely reflects insufficient task execution capability' given Run Failed counts of 53 and 36 vs 12-24 for general agents.
Section 4.4: system-prompt defense reduces ASR from 51.6% to 37.0% (Qwen3.5) and 57.9% to 41.5% (Gemini-3-Flash) but Stalled samples surge from 2 to 20 and 5 to 19.
Appendix H: multi-stage runtime defense yields only '35.7%' ASR vs 37.0% for system prompt, with TCR dropping from 47.2% to 45.2%.
Appendix I: Mobile-Agent-v3.5-style scaffold achieves ASR 52.3% vs 51.6% for general-e2e, showing vulnerability 'is not solely an artifact of the lightweight general-e2e scaffold'.
Appendix K: Qwen3.5 completes 89 tasks clean vs 58 attacked, with degradation concentrated in GUI-only (59→35) and Agent-User (15→9) tasks.
Appendix G: anonymous repository 'contains the task definitions, evaluation pipeline, verification scripts'; temperature=0, 50-round limit, and vLLM deployment details specified.
NeurIPS Checklist Q7: 'we do not conduct multiple runs for the same experimental setting' — no error bars or significance tests.
Appendix A: limitations acknowledged — only two preliminary defenses and exclusion of overlay-style vectors (notifications, pop-ups, UI overlays).
Table 5 (Appendix D): positions against AgentDojo, InjecAgent, WASP, MobileSafetyBench, GhostEI-Bench, claiming unique 'Native Workflow' injections and final-state verification on Android.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly aligned with top-weighted preferences: an LLM-agent safety benchmark centered on GUI agents, indirect prompt injection, MCP tool responses, and LLM-as-judge evaluation (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8, LLMs 2.5). Rigor is solid: clear benign-user/malicious-environment threat model (Section 3.1), five-level outcome labeling that separates safety from capability failures (Section 3.4), exclusion of Run Failed cases, human-LLM judge validation at 92.1% over 76 cases (Appendix L), defense ablations (Section 4.4, Appendix H), scaffold-robustness check (Appendix I), and a clean-baseline utility comparison (Appendix K). Novelty is moderate: indirect prompt injection benchmarks are crowded (AgentDojo, InjecAgent, WASP, MobileSafetyBench per Table 5); the delta is injections embedded in native Android app content rather than overlays/notifications, which is real but incremental. Evidence is extensive but single-run with no error bars (checklist Q7), and judge/adjudication relies on one expert. Generalizability is bounded by the Android/MobileWorld environment, though cross-model consistency (6 agents) supports the core claim. Reproducibility is good: anonymous repo with task definitions and verifiers (Appendix G), decoding parameters, model versions (Table 9), and the full judge prompt (Appendix M); API model preview versions add fragility.

primary_link.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps

papers.summary: LLM-powered GUI agents that autonomously operate smartphones are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to early real-world deployment. However, because these agents routinely process untrusted environmental content, they are highly vulnerable to environmental injection attacks, which include indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions. Such attacks can manipulate the behavior of agents without user awareness through diverse channels encountered in everyday mobile use. Despit
papers.summary_zh: 具備 LLM 能力的 GUI 代理正從研究原型邁向實際部署，但這些代理在操作智慧型手機時必須持續處理不受信任的環境內容，極易遭受環境注入攻擊，例如隱藏在電子郵件、網頁或社群貼文中的間接提示注入。現有基準多聚焦非行動場景，或僅涉及視覺擾動，缺乏對原生 Android 應用中環境注入的系統性評估。本文提出 MobileWorldSafety，建構142個風險任務，涵蓋13個真實 Android 應用程式與5個 MCP 伺服器，並以攻擊向量與危害類別兩個維度組織分類。每個任務定義可程式化驗證的風險指標，採兩階段評估管線：規則驗證處理明確案例，LLM 評審則裁決模糊案例，藉此區分安全失敗與能力失敗。對六個代理（包含 Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-4.5 等通用代理與兩個專用 GUI 代理）的評估顯示，所有代理的攻擊成功率介於40.4%至66.9%，且通用代理的 ASR 普遍高於任務完成率；專用代理較低的 ASR 部分源自執行失敗而非真正穩健。附加安全提示可降低 ASR 但導致任務停滯，推理模式反而增加部分執行的比例，顯示執行能力越強攻擊面越大。限制包括防禦實驗僅屬初步、未涵蓋懸浮視窗類攻擊向量。此基準量化了行動 GUI 代理的安全弱點，為後續防禦研究奠定基礎。
papers.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
papers.title_zh: MobileWorldSafety：針對 Android 應用程式環境注入攻擊的 GUI 代理安全性基準

links.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL

evidence: Abstract: 'Using only 6K training examples and modest compute, RL improves Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified from 41.8% to 56.4%, an absolute 14.6% gain' with release of complete workflow and scripts claimed.

Introduction/Challenges: identifies retokenization, sample merging, advantage calculation, loss normalization, and training backend scheduling as challenges of harnessed agentic RL; claims 'first comprehensive elaboration'.

Challenges (Retokenization): documents three drift mechanisms - chat-template non-compositionality (Eq. 10), decode-retokenize drift (Eq. 11, 'having' example in Figure 3), and inference-time output transformation - and notes buffered token replacement 'introduces an off-policy discrepancy' (Eq. 12-13).

Experiments §4.3.3 and Figure 9: ablation shows Rollout-level Advantage + Rollout-level Norm reaches 38.2% validation reward at step 128 vs 35.0% (baseline) and 33.1% (rollout-advantage-only), with more stable policy entropy; SWE-bench Verified 41.8% to 56.4% at step 208.
Figure 10: on average only 36% of rollouts remain a single training sample and each rollout yields 2.41 training samples, motivating the dynamic-sample analysis.

§4.3.2 Preventing Reward Hacking: concrete safeguards (disabling Git/.git access, Kubernetes network policy blocking outbound access except whitelisted services) against four observed hacking behaviors.
§4.1/§4.2: search-agent validation reward 25.1% to 41.7% (EM, HotpotQA setting) and instruction-following 51.9% to 70.2%; both reported as training dynamics without external baseline comparison.
Collocated Async RL section: 'achieves roughly a 2x end-to-end speedup over synchronous RL while also using fewer GPUs' - claim stated without detailed experimental reporting.

System Design/Appendix A: framework implemented in ~3,500 lines of code built on VERL, with API Gateway/Rollout Controller/Customized Trainer described in detail and github.com/microsoft/agent-lightning given as project page; data pipeline reduces SWE-smith 59,136 tasks to ~6,000 training / 400 test examples with stated filtering criteria.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent training methodology paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (agents/tool use, LLMs, coding agents, RL/alignment). Its main conceptual contribution - a systematic characterization of 'harnessed agentic RL' challenges (retokenization/token-prefix breakage, rollout- vs sample-level advantage, loss normalization under dynamic sample counts) with formal loss definitions and a supporting ablation - is genuinely useful and clearly articulated. However, rigor and evidence are limited: the design-choice ablation is a single-run comparison in one domain (38.2% vs 35.0% vs 33.1% validation reward, no seeds/variance), search and instruction-following experiments report only internal training dynamics without head-to-head baselines against competing frameworks the paper critiques, and the claimed ~2x collocated-async speedup is stated without detail. The SWE-bench Verified gain (41.8% to 56.4% with 6K examples) is concrete and the data-cleaning/reward-hacking-safeguard pipeline is well specified, supporting reproducibility via a claimed full code/script release.

primary_link.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL

papers.summary: Modern agents operate inside agent harnesses that manage tools, context, and control flow, making the harness a critical part of the agent system. Our original Agent Lightning introduced a disaggregated architecture that connects arbitrary agents to RL training through an LLM endpoint proxy, an approach later adopted by frameworks such as verl Uni-Agent, AReaL 2.0, slime, and Polar. We refer to this paradigm as harnessed agentic RL, where the deploy-time harness directly participates in model po
papers.summary_zh: 現代代理並非獨立的 LLM，而是運行於管理工具、上下文與控制流程的代理框架之中。本文將「以部署時同一框架進行的強化學習」稱為 harnessed agentic RL：框架擁有環境互動迴圈，訓練引擎只能觀察到一連串 LLM 請求—回應對，與傳統由訓練引擎掌控互動迴圈的代理式 RL 有本質差異。作者首次系統性剖析此新典範的挑戰：重新分詞導致 token 前綴連續性斷裂、一個 rollout 可能動態產生多個訓練樣本、優勢計算與損失正規化的層級選擇，以及固定 GPU 資源與動態樣本數之間的排程問題；若處理不當會造成訓練不穩或無效。他們進一步提出 Agent Lightning v1.0，一個僅約3,500行程式碼的輕量框架，由 API Gateway、Rollout Controller（基於 Kubernetes）與客製化訓練器組成，採用 rollout 層級的優勢計算與損失正規化，並支援 colocated 非同步 RL 以節省 GPU。實驗涵蓋搜尋代理（驗證獎勵提升16.6%）、通用指令遵循代理（提升18.3%）與程式代理：僅用6K訓練範例，Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上從41.8%提升至56.4%。作者並提供完整的資料清理管線與防範 reward hacking 的措施，全部開源釋出，對可重現的代理式 RL 研究極具價值。
papers.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
papers.title_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0：邁向可駕馭的代理式強化學習

links.title: Judge, Retrieve, or Abstain: Uncertainty-Guarded LLM Judging with Provable Risk Guarantees

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: reference-free LLM-as-a-judge with uncertainty-calibrated routing to web retrieval (RAG) and abstention. Preference relevance is high — it directly targets LLM evaluation (Red Teaming & Evaluation), retrieval-augmented judging (RAG & Knowledge), and tool use for judges (Agents & Tool Use), with experiments on Qwen3/LLaMA-3.1 judges and candidates (§4). Novelty is moderate: the core machinery is Clopper–Pearson FDR control borrowed from COIN/SConU (§2), and the main new elements — two-threshold routing to a retrieval mode and Lemma 1 showing the Bernoulli structure survives deterministic routing (§3.5, App. A.2) — are sensible but incremental extensions. Rigor is strong: formal problem setup with admission functions (§3.1), proofs for the UCB and routing cases (App. A), 100 random 50/50 splits across 32 configurations (§5.1, Fig. 1), and ablations covering admission functions (Table 7), retrieval depth (Table 8), δ and calibration size (Tables 9–10), alternative UQ scores (Table 11), no-retrieval baselines including Self-eval and Empty controls (Table 12), and a conservative Bonferroni variant (App. D.4). Evidence strength is solid but not maximal: FDR ≤ α holds empirically in all settings (Fig. 1, Table 6), and drift robustness is tested with Jaccard overlap figures (§5.5, Table 3); however, the deployed threshold pair is selected by coverage-maximizing search whose guarantee is acknowledged as uncorrected (App. D.4), and ground-truth admission partly relies on a Qwen2.5-7B LLM evaluator (§4), introducing possible label noise/circularity. Generalizability is moderate: framework is judge-agnostic in principle but assumes white-box logit access (PE, §3.2), binary factual QA only, with subjective/graded tasks and black-box judges deferred to future work (§6). Reproducibility is decent: public datasets/models, seed 42, prompts in App. B.3, Serper API specified, though no explicit code release is stated. Not a pure domain application; clearly rewardable.

primary_link.title: Judge, Retrieve, or Abstain: Uncertainty-Guarded LLM Judging with Provable Risk Guarantees

papers.summary: Using LLMs as judges has become standard practice for evaluating model outputs at scale. This is particularly common for subjective, open-ended tasks such as assessing helpfulness or alignment, where no single reference answer exists. However, objective tasks introduce a distinct reliability challenge for reference-free LLM judging. In the absence of a reference answer, the judge evaluates factual correctness either through its parametric knowledge or through tool augmentation. Although the form
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM-as-a-judge 在客觀事實問答任務上的可靠性問題，提出具風險控制的選擇性評估框架。在缺乏參考答案時，評審模型可能因參數知識不足或幻覺而產生自信但錯誤的判定。作者在保留的校準集上，利用 Clopper–Pearson 精確區間校準不確定性門檻，使被接受判定中的偽發現率（FDR）以高機率低於使用者指定的風險水準 α。框架採雙模式路由：模式一僅以參數知識評判；若不確定性過高，則進入模式二，檢索網路證據後以第二個校準門檻重新評估；仍不確定時棄權並標記供人工審查。理論上，作者證明有限樣本 FDR 保證可延伸至雙門檻路由，無需額外分布假設。實驗涵蓋 TriviaQA、NQ-Open、PopQA、HotpotQA 與四種規模的評審模型，所有設定下 FDR 均受控制，且自適應檢索大幅提升覆蓋率，例如 NQ-Open 由 7% 升至 82%，HotpotQA 上 Llama-8B 由 40% 升至 85%。限制包括保證綁定於校準時的檢索快照，網路索引漂移可能影響有效性，所幸約三個月後重測仍維持控制；且檢索對 14–29% 實例反而提高不確定性，由第二門檻將其導向棄權。此工作讓參考答案闕如的 LLM 評審首次獲得可驗證的統計保證，對大規模自動評估的部署深具價值。
papers.title: Judge, Retrieve, or Abstain: Uncertainty-Guarded LLM Judging with Provable Risk Guarantees
papers.title_zh: 評判、檢索或棄權：具可證明風險保證的不確定性把關 LLM 評審

links.title: Selection, Recombination, or a Fresh Solve? A Candidate-Free Control for Single-Pass Test-Time Aggregation

evidence: Abstract: candidate conditioning improves accuracy when multiple candidates are correct (Delta_cand(c2+)=+0.290) and lowers accuracy when every candidate is wrong (Delta_cand(c0)=-0.123) on AIME-2025/HMMT-2025 with Qwen3-4B.

Section 2 Method: five arms (AGGREGATE, NO-CANDIDATE, ANSWER-ONLY, VOTING, ORACLE) share a 16,384-token maximum output allowance; primary analysis is problem-level exact two-sided sign tests with Holm correction within each Delta family.
Appendix E: analysis plan fixed before confirmatory HMMT collection; observed AIME c0 problem-level p=0.109 fell in the pre-committed gray zone (0.05, 0.15], triggering the single planned extension.

Appendix L: retrospective conservative two-stage correction rejects c2+ (Holm-adj p=0.0133) and narrowly rejects c0 (0.0236 vs family alpha=0.025); global-null FWER calibration via sign-flip simulation (B=200,000) reported.

Appendix H: pre-registered dual-scoring process rerun (1,416 generations); c0 deficit strengthens under final-answer scoring (-0.159, p<0.0001), while the c2+ Delta_reas increment (+0.177) fails and is restated as descriptive.
Appendix I: length-matched off-topic placebo reproduces much of the c0 deficit (Placebo-NoCand=-0.164, 95% CI [-0.241,-0.091]); AGGREGATE-Placebo CI includes zero, so mechanism remains unresolved.

Section 5 Limitations: scope limited to one Qwen3-4B family, two 30-problem math benchmarks, first-answer-truncated candidate fragments, acknowledged contamination risk, and no non-Qwen replication yet.

Appendix G/H: all tables regenerate from committed logs via make_numbers.sh; prompt_sha256 verified on 1,636 rerun rows, but original arm texts were not retained and some audit materials are excluded from the workshop code supplement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM test-time reasoning methodology paper: it introduces a candidate-free control arm for evaluating single-pass aggregation of reasoning candidates, stratified by candidate-correctness, on math reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-4B. The core contribution (a missing counterfactual control and the resulting sign reversal for all-wrong 'recovery') is a genuine, if modest, methodological novelty relative to GSR/SSA/GenSelect. Rigor is unusually high: pre-registered analysis plan, adaptive-collection correction with union-bound and global-null simulation, dual-scoring sensitivity rerun, length-matched placebo, planted-recombination validation, and honest identification/limitation discussion. Evidence is strong within its stated scope but rests on ~30 problems per benchmark, ~20 informative c0 problems, and a narrowly passing corrected p-value (0.0236 vs 0.025). Generalizability is explicitly limited to one model family, two math benchmarks, truncated candidate fragments, and single-pass prompted aggregation, with no cross-family replication. Reproducibility is aided by committed logs and regeneration scripts, though original arm texts were not retained and no explicit public release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Selection, Recombination, or a Fresh Solve? A Candidate-Free Control for Single-Pass Test-Time Aggregation

papers.summary: When every candidate is wrong, correct-candidate selection is unavailable, yet the aggregation call can still solve the problem afresh. A correct aggregate answer may therefore reflect recombination, fresh solving, or both. For efficient test-time reasoning, the relevant question is whether candidate context adds value beyond the additional generation pass. We introduce the missing candidate-free control under the same maximum output-token allowance and stratify by the number of correct candidat
papers.summary_zh: 在測試時聚合中，當所有候選皆錯誤時，正確答案可能來自重組候選或全新求解，但過去研究多以候選依賴基線比較，無法釐清候選上下文的淨價值。本文引入缺失的「無候選對照」：在相同最大輸出 token 額度下，比較 AGGREGATE（讀取候選）、NO-CANDIDATE（全新求解）、ANSWER-ONLY、VOTING 與 ORACLE 五個組別，並依正確候選數分層（c0、c1、c2+）。以 Qwen3-4B 在 AIME-2025 與 HMMT-2025 上實驗發現，當多個候選正確時，條件化顯著提升準確率（Δ=+0.290）；當所有候選皆錯時，閱讀候選反而降低準確率（Δ=−0.123，Holm 校正後 0.0236）；c1 區間則未定論。在 c0 情境，模型錯誤答案與提示中顯示的候選答案吻合率遠高於巧合（AIME 上 0.845 對 0.371），離題候選的安慰劑對照亦重現大部分損失；結構化介入顯示明確的答案欄位會因果地引導輸出，但遮罩答案欄位無法改善準確率。此結果翻轉「全錯回收」的解讀：在該規模下，單趟聚合並未帶來淨增益。限制包括僅涵蓋單一 Qwen3-4B 家族、兩個數學基準、首答案截斷的候選片段，以及潛在基準污染。對高效推理評估而言，本文主張此類研究應納入無候選生成的對照。
