links.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification

evidence: §3.2/Table 1: variance across runs increases in 17 of 24 cases (~71%) when self-improvement is applied; best-worst pass@1 gaps widen to 8.26% (Map) and 7.78% (GitLab) for RBank vs 4.44% baseline in GitLab.
§3.3/Figure 3: performance degrades in 6 of 8 cases under shuffled task orders; on WebArena Shuffle-1, AWM drops from 54.8% to 49.1% and RBank to 49.8%.
Table 3 and §3.2: RBank's +1.5% average gain over the GPT-5-mini baseline has p=0.23 via unpaired t-test over three runs, reported by the authors as statistically limited.

§4.2/Figure 5: adding rubrics, environment feedback, and prompt modification improves RBank from 49.8% to 52.7% under Shuffle-1, closing 31% of the degradation while still underperforming the no-memory baseline.

§4.1/Figure 4 and Tables 7-9: manual memory inspection documents unsupported 'API'/'user confirmation' memories, evaluator-bug-induced false memories, and the Haversine formula strategy propagating through memory.
Appendix A (Limitations): scope restricted to memory-based self-improvement on web browsing; manual memory analysis is qualitative on a subset.

Appendix B and NeurIPS Checklist Q4-Q5: code and data released (SalesforceAIResearch/self-improve-fragility), per-run costs ($25 WebArena, $29 SCUBA), benchmark licenses stated; backbone GPT-5-mini is API-dependent.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agent-reliability research with direct alignment to the highest-weighted preference (agents/tool use, plus LLM backbones and evaluation methodology). The paper is a careful re-evaluation rather than a new method: it quantifies run-to-run variance amplification (17/24 cases, Table 1), exposes an implicit easy-to-hard curriculum in default task orderings with -4.5% degradation under shuffling, and provides qualitative case studies (Tables 7-9) of underspecification-driven failure modes like the 'contagious' Haversine fallback. Rigor is solid for an empirical study: 3 runs per setting, two shuffled orders, three benchmarks, ablations of three remediation types, and honest reporting of a non-significant 1.5% gain (p=0.23). Evidence strength is good but the underspecification hypothesis is only partially validated (31% of degradation closed), and manual memory inspection is a qualitative subset. Novelty is moderate since reliability critiques of agent evaluation exist (Rabanser et al.) and this extends them to self-improving agents. Generalizability is limited by the single web-browsing domain and two methods, acknowledged in Appendix A. Reproducibility is strong: released code/data, full prompts (Appendix E), costs, and licenses, though GPT-5-mini API dependence and potentially shifting benchmark sites (SCUBA task exclusions) temper exact replication.

primary_link.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification

papers.summary: Memory-based self-improving agents--those that learn from an online stream of tasks and improve over time by maintaining a textual memory bank--have shown great promise in recent literature. However, the reliability aspects of these methods have been critically overlooked. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive re-evaluation of two memory-based methods, broadening the scope of evaluation along two axes: (1) including multiple runs to quantify variance, and (2) randomly shuffling the tasks to i
papers.summary_zh: 記憶式自我改進代理透過線上任務流學習並維護文字記憶庫，近年展現潛力，但其可靠性長期被忽視。本文對 Agent Workflow Memory（AWM）與 ReasoningBank（RBank）兩種代表性方法，在 WebArena、VisualWebArena 與 SCUBA 三個網頁瀏覽基準上進行全面再評估，並以 GPT-5-mini 建立更強的基線。研究沿兩個軸線擴大評估：重複執行三次以量化變異數，以及隨機洗牌任務順序。兩大發現：其一，代理評估本身雜訊很大，疊加自我改進迴圈會進一步放大變異——71% 的案例跨執行變異數增加，同一實驗最佳與最差執行的差距可達 10 個百分點，凸顯單次執行評估的疑慮。其二，改進高度依賴任務順序：預設順序隱含由易到難的課程，成為成功的隱藏前提；洗牌順序下表現退化 4.5%，而非預期的 +1.5%。透過人工檢視記憶，作者提出任務與環境規格不足是脆弱性的潛在原因，例如在不支援程式執行的瀏覽器環境中建議使用 API、要求使用者確認，或 Haversine 公式等意外策略在記憶中「傳染」並放大。加入評分規則、環境回饋與提示修改等資訊後，僅彌補 31% 的退化，顯示仍有未明因素。本文呼籲更嚴謹的評估協定（多次執行、隨機順序、壓力測試），以及能及時修正錯誤記憶的人工監督介面。
papers.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
papers.title_zh: 論自我改進代理的脆弱性：變異數、任務順序與規格不足

links.title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations

evidence: Abstract/Sec.7 Table 1: Map-ESC raises Liquid accuracy from 0.652 (Full-K5) to 0.715 at 1.15x tokens, while Grid Full-K5 remains accuracy-optimal (0.806)
Sec.7.4/Table 2: Map-ESC matches Reflexion accuracy (0.715 vs 0.711) with 48% fewer tokens; ExpeL reaches 0.731 at 1.44x token cost
App.E.5: paired bootstrap shows Exec-Lookup vs Full-K5 on Liquid is Δ=+0.018, 95% CI [-0.022,+0.061] (statistically indistinguishable), while Grid Exec-Lookup is genuinely below Full-K5
Sec.5.2/App.A: 1,220-paper corpus annotated by three LLM annotators with majority vote and adjudication; agreement κ 0.49-0.84 per task axis and exact 73-84% / QWK 0.61-0.78 for harness level
App.B/App.D: 240 tasks with deterministic simulator-backed oracles, programmatic plus human verification, construction/test splits, three repetitions, Gemini-3.1-Pro judge blind to harness level
Sec.7.5/Table 3: GPT-5.4-derived map transfers to Qwen3.5-27B (0.726 vs 0.706 on Liquid) while a Qwen-estimated map performs worse (0.626/0.762)
App.I.2: liquid-cooling digital twin is proprietary; only frozen trajectories and tool I/O will be released; Grid2Op/pandapower environment is fully open-source
Limitations section: map is calibrated to evaluated executor, harness implementation, and tolerance; 240 tasks in two simulated environments do not capture live conditions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agents systems paper (task-to-harness mapping, tool/toolset provisioning, ReAct executors, Reflexion/ExpeL baselines) that directly matches the highest-weight agent and LLM preferences; it is a general agent-provisioning methodology applied to MCI rather than a pure domain application, so it stays in scope. Novelty is solid: reframing harness selection as measuring minimum sufficient provision, a taxonomy derived from system equations, and dual literature/execution maps are fresh relative to relevance-based tool retrieval and model routing. Rigor is above average: 240 oracle-verified tasks, 5/5 construction/test splits, 3 runs, paired-bootstrap CIs, tolerance and stability sensitivity, and honest reporting that some gains are statistically indistinguishable (App. E.5). Evidence is strong and nuanced (Grid shows Full-K5 optimal), though the headline 0.652→0.715 gain rests on one proprietary domain with LLM-judge-assisted scoring. Generalizability is constrained by two simulated domains, 5 tasks/class map estimation, and calibration to one executor; cross-executor transfer to Qwen3.5-27B is only partially convincing (Qwen-sourced map degrades to 0.626/0.762). Reproducibility is moderate: extensive promised artifacts and an open Grid environment, but the proprietary liquid-cooling twin and closed frontier executors limit full independent replication.

primary_link.title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations

papers.summary: LLM agents have been widely adopted to operate mission-critical infrastructure (MCI). These agents normally rely on a harness that determines what information they can access, which tools they can use, and what actions they can take. Existing systems often expose the same comprehensive harness to every task, which may not be necessary and cause resource wastes. In this paper, we focus on the identification of optimal harness configurations, and view it as a resource-matching problem between what
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理已廣泛用於營運關鍵基礎設施（MCI），其仰賴的 harness 決定代理可存取的資訊、工具與行動。現有系統常對每個任務提供相同的完整配置，造成資源浪費與不必要的資訊暴露。本文將 harness 供給視為任務需求與供給間的資源匹配問題：以底層物理系統的數學表示建立任務分類（輸出模式、時間視野、目標元素三軸共 12 類），並定義 K1–K5 的累進 harness 層級（純模型推理、靜態知識、時間觀測、結構與物理、前向模擬）。作者分析 1,200 多篇 MCI 研究文獻，並在液冷散熱數位孿生與電網兩個模擬環境中，以 240 個經驗證的任務進行受控執行，分別建立文獻導向與執行導向的任務—harness 映射。所提出的 map-guided escalation 以映射層級為初始供給，僅在自我檢查失敗時升級至完整配置。實驗顯示，液冷情境中準確率由 0.652 提升至 0.715，並以少 48% 的 token 達到與 Reflexion 相當的表現；電網情境中完整供給仍最準確，映射查找則提供更低成本的操作點。結果指出 harness 供給呈領域相依的準確率—成本 Pareto 前沿，而非通用最佳解。限制包括映射與執行器、實作及容差綁定，且模擬環境未能涵蓋感測不確定性、分布漂移與人工審批等現場條件。
papers.title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations
papers.title_zh: 關鍵基礎設施營運中 LLM 代理的任務感知 Harness 供給

links.title: Effects of Answer Format Variation on Gender Bias in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: evaluates three instruction-tuned models on BBQ and OpinionQA across closed-ended, Likert-scaled and open-ended formats, finding 'answer format does substantially alter measured outcomes, including reversals in order rankings'.

Section 4.2 (Cross-format synthesis): 'Mistral7B shifts from the most biased overall of the three tested models in the closed-ended format to the least biased in open-ended', and the inversion is larger than within-format answer-ordering effects.

Appendix E, Table 2: per-model s_DIS/s_AMB and accuracy with 95% bootstrap CIs (e.g., Mistral7B combined closed s_AMB +16.4* vs open +1.4*), plus answer-order effects (Mistral7B s_AMB UMF +7.4% vs MUF +30.7%).

Section 5.2 and Appendix G, Table 3: distributional alignment (Wasserstein, Jensen-Shannon, composite) with bootstrap CIs showing ranking inversions across formats (e.g., Gemma12B lowest Likert composite 0.157 but highest closed composite 0.371).
Section 4.1/4.2: introduces a polarisation index showing near-zero s_AMB coexists with ~24.4% extreme stereotype-consistent Likert responses for Gemma12B, revealing masked polarisation.

Limitations: 'We evaluate three small-sized open-weight models', gender-only and binary categories, 'English-language prompts grounded in a U.S. socio-cultural context', and open-ended scores rely on LLM annotation so lower scores 'should be interpreted cautiously'.

Section 3 footnote 1: 'The data and code are available at https://github.com/xenia-mer/answer-format'; Appendix C specifies temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9, MAX_NEW_TOKENS, and NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada (48GB) for all models.
Section 3: subsets of 360 BBQ and 158 OpinionQA gender-related items; Likert variants generated with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct at temperature 0 with manual validation of random subsets.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM evaluation-methodology paper on how answer format (closed/Likert/open) changes measured gender bias and human-opinion alignment; directly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, bias/fairness, evaluation, prompting-adjacent). Novelty is moderate: format sensitivity, position bias, and closed-vs-open discrepancies are established (Zheng 2024, Jin 2025, Tjuatja 2024), but the systematic three-format x two-dataset design with human reference distributions and rank-reversal findings is a genuine incremental contribution. Rigor is strong: controlled permutations, multiple scale lengths/polarities, bootstrapped CIs, complementary metrics (s_DIS/s_AMB plus polarisation index; Wasserstein/JS/composite), and manual validation of LLM-generated variants. Evidence is quantitatively supported (e.g., Mistral7B s_AMB +16.4% closed vs +1.4% open; Table 2/3 with CIs), though limited to three 7-12B open-weight models, gender-only bias, binary categories, dataset subsets, and Qwen-based open-ended annotation that the authors admit may deflate open-ended bias. Generalizability is explicitly constrained (model size, language, culture). Reproducibility is high: public code/data repository, full prompts, decoding parameters, and hardware in Appendices B-C.

primary_link.title: Effects of Answer Format Variation on Gender Bias in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Gender bias or other social biases in large language models (LLMs) are frequently evaluated with question answering or survey benchmarks where the LLM needs to give a response in a predefined answer format. It is well known in survey science that the answer format has a substantial impact on answers, just as LLMs are sensitive to the prompt wording. However, to our knowledge it has not been studied yet how changes in answer format impact the measurement of gender bias in LLMs and their alignment
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討答案格式如何影響大型語言模型性別偏誤的測量。作者自 BBQ 基準選取 360 題、自 OpinionQA 民意調查選取 158 題性別相關題目,改寫為封閉式選擇、Likert 量表與開放式三種格式,在 Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Gemma-3-12B 三個指令微調模型上,以相同條件重複取樣,比較偏誤分數及與人類回答分布的對齊程度。結果顯示格式會大幅改變測量結果,甚至逆轉模型排名:Mistral 在封閉式格式偏誤最高,開放式格式卻最低;Likert 格式中對立極端回答相互抵銷,平均偏誤接近零但極化指標仍高;開放式格式則因拒答與棄答而降低可測偏誤。以 Wasserstein 與 Jensen-Shannon 距離衡量與人類分布的對齊時,指標同樣不具格式不變性,排名亦見逆轉。作者主張答案格式並非周邊設計細節,而是評估結論的核心決定因素,偏誤與對齊應視為依賴格式的行為表現;穩健評估須採多格式設計與互補指標。限制包括僅涵蓋三個中小型模型、僅探討性別偏誤、採二元性別分類,且開放式回答依賴模型標註,可能低估實際偏誤。

links.title: PTXBench: Benchmark and Adapt LLMs for GPU Kernel Optimization with Architecture-specific PTX

evidence: Abstract: PTXBench measures functional correctness, whether target instructions execute at runtime, and speedup over frontier libraries across GEMM and attention workloads on H100 and B200.
Section 2.2: target instruction correctness defined as functional correctness plus runtime execution, verified via SASS inspection followed by NCU predicate-enabled thread counts.
Section 4.2/Table 1: Claude Opus 4.8 reaches 1.012x cuBLAS on Blackwell GEMM while target instruction success falls substantially on MHA-Bwd; Qwen3.6-27B produces no correct Hopper kernel.
Section 5.1: s3 (Fixit) improves correctness on GEMM, MHA-Fwd-Causal, and MHA-Bwd but trails s0 (KernelGen) on MHA-Fwd and MHA-Bwd-Causal, showing non-uniform gains.
Table 3: knowledge ablation shows architecture parameters alone yield no target instruction successes, while the full pack reaches 38.5% target instruction correctness at 8 turns.
Section 7 Limitations: adaptation uses modest LoRA datasets and a single 27B base model; benchmark covers only BF16 GEMM and attention on H100 and B200.
Appendix A.1: SFT details (LoRA rank 32, five epochs, batch size 2, lr 4.65e-4, seed 0, no validation split) support reproducibility but reveal single-run evaluation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: benchmarking and adapting LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GLM, Qwen) for agentic, multi-turn GPU kernel code generation with execution-feedback repair, SFT/LoRA adaptation, and a novel runtime verification of architecture-specific instruction execution. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, code, evaluation, training). Novelty is solid but incremental over KernelBench-style suites: the controlled target-instruction-execution probe (SASS + NCU dynamic check) and repair-conditioned SFT (Fixit) are the genuinely new elements. Rigor is high: detailed metrics, knowledge-pack ablation, data-recipe/teacher ablations, conservative handling of unclassifiable turns, and acknowledged limitations (Section 7: single 27B model, modest LoRA datasets, BF16 GEMM/attention only). Evidence is extensive and quantitative but adaptation gains are mixed and datasets are small (158-494 records), with no validation split and a single seed. Generalizability is limited to two NVIDIA GPUs and two operator families; reproducibility is aided by released code, hyperparameters, prompt token counts, and dataset recipes (Tables 5, 6, 10), though frontier-model APIs and expert-validated knowledge packs partially constrain replication.

links.title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch

evidence: Abstract: SkillOpt raises benign utility 0.741->0.837 while exposure rises 0.820->0.943 and unauthorized state change reaches 0.685, establishing the capability-security decoupling claim.

Sec 3.1: pre-model audit found 4/16 official utility predicates invalid (fixture-shadowed, recipient-insensitive, vacuous); repairs were frozen before any model execution, with an untouched-checker sensitivity subset in Sec 4.6.

Sec 3.3: three independently evolved lineages with a byte-identical 22-trajectory acquisition record shared across methods (hash equality asserted) and sealed v3-v5 endpoints until all artifacts froze.
Sec 4.3 Table 5: SkillOpt utility/exposure/unauthorized-state deltas agree 3/3 across lineages while total ASR agrees only 2/3 (-7.4 to +10.4 pp), supporting the paper's own hedging of the ASR claim.

Sec 4.5 Table 8: removing only four literal tag strings from frozen AWM workflows moves utility 0.319->0.756 and textual-action rate 0.704->0.000, with 30 content-equivalence assertions, isolating the execution-interface confound.

Sec 4.7: an independent replay implementation recomputed all metrics over 2,965 + 540 + 360 rollouts with zero semantic mismatches; five provider-side guardrail exclusions are accounted for (ASR 0.530->0.523).

Sec 6 Limitations: one primary executor, one simulated banking environment, one offline benign evolution pass, three lineages with no significance claim, and explicitly post-hoc/ceiling-limited auxiliary checks.
Sec 7: 'Code and audit artifacts will be released upon publication' — availability is claimed but not verifiable from the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong fit to high-weight preferences (LLM agents & tool use, AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation): the paper audits three self-evolving LLM agent systems (SkillOpt, AWM, ReasoningBank) under indirect prompt injection in AgentDojo Banking. It is not a pure financial-domain application; the contribution is an agent-security audit methodology. Rigor is high for an audit paper: a pre-model checker audit repaired/excluded 4 of 16 benchmark predicates (frozen before execution), evaluation endpoints were sealed until artifacts froze, acquisition trajectories were byte-identical across methods, three independent lineages were run with directional-agreement reporting instead of overstated significance, and an independent replay pipeline verified zero semantic mismatches. Claims are appropriately hedged (post-hoc arms, ceiling-limited second-executor check, imperfect placebos). Novelty is solid: decomposing ASR into exposure vs. conditional susceptibility, adding execution-grounded unauthorized-state harm, and identifying execution-interface mismatch as an evaluation confound are useful, distinct contributions. Weaknesses: single primary executor and single simulated environment, one offline evolution pass, n=3 lineages without significance testing, and code/artifact release only promised ('upon publication'), limiting reproducibility and generalizability.

primary_link.title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch

We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 w
papers.summary_zh: 本文審計三種自我演化系統——SkillOpt、Agent Workflow Memory(AWM)與 ReasoningBank——在模擬電子銀行環境中的能力與安全變化。作者以修正後的 AgentDojo Banking 15 個任務家族為場域,使用 Qwen 3.7 Flash 執行者,三個獨立演化譜系取得逐位元組相同的良性學習軌跡,評估端點在所有演化產物凍結前保持封存。結果顯示能力與安全可能脫鉤:SkillOpt 將良性效用由 0.741 提升至 0.837,但對注入內容的暴露率由 0.820 升至 0.943,未經授權的金融狀態變更升至 0.685,總攻擊成功率僅在三個譜系中的兩個上升;ReasoningBank 效用升至 0.859 而總攻擊成功率未增。AWM 的原始移植則暴露執行介面失配:WebArena 文字動作封套與原生函式呼叫不相容,使效用崩落至 0.319;事後移除標籤即恢復至 0.756,但暴露與攻擊成功率同步上升,顯示低攻擊成功率可能只是功能停擺的假象。作者主張審計自我演化金融代理人必須追蹤回歸、攻擊面接觸、未授權狀態變更與產物—執行器相容性,而非僅看準確率。限制包括單一執行者與環境、僅三次演化,且部分檢驗為事後敏感性分析。

links.title: Recirculation

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: perplexity reductions across ten LM datasets for Gemma3 1B/4B/12B PT (e.g., pg19 14.41%/15.72%/35.40%; arxiv 13.99%/11.26%/25.20%; lambada is the reported anomaly).
Section 4.4.2: temperature control shows temp=1.2 alone reduces perplexity 8.48% vs. recirculation 14.21% and combined 19.55%, ruling out a token-independent sharpening artifact.
Section 4.4.3 and Figure 8: training-free looping comparison on Gemma3 shows looping does not produce robust benefits, unlike recirculation, supporting a mechanistic distinction (Figures 3-4).

Section 4.4.1 and Figure 7: Ministral3, Pythia, Qwen3, and Phi2 show qualitative benefits but percentage reductions <0.5% vs. ~5% for Gemma3; authors admit magnitude may be architecture/training-specific (Section 5.2, Appendix C.1).

Section 4.6 and Figure 13: adaptive recirculation (learned token-conditional vector alpha/beta via MLP) yields mean 23.0% perplexity reduction vs. 8.5% fixed, beating full fine-tuning (21.6%); Sections 4.5.3/Table 2 show single-token gains are modest and training-set dependent.

Section 4.6 and Figure 12: GSM8k gains appear only as figure bars; text reports 8.8%/20.9% error-rate reductions (pass@1/pass@128), whereas the abstract claims a '21% increase in accuracy' — an imprecise claim.

Appendix B and D: extensive implementation detail (normalization schemes in Table B.2, source/destination pairs in Table B.1, AdamW lr 3e-4, 100 steps, batch 32, MLP architecture in D.5), but no code or artifact availability is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM/transformer-methodology paper: it proposes recirculation, a training-free inference-time recurrence that leaks deep-layer activations to shallow layers across both depth and time steps, targeting state tracking and reasoning in off-the-shelf LLMs (Gemma3 1B/4B/12B, plus Qwen3, Pythia, Phi2, Ministral3). This directly hits high-weight preferences (LLMs, transformer architecture, reasoning, inference-time compute). Novelty is solid but bounded: the idea is a careful reorganization of looped-transformer recurrence, motivated by prior activation-patching (Lepori et al., 2025) and adjacent to training-free looping and activation steering, though the depth+step recurrence framing and 'model-design affordances' angle are fresh. Rigor is above average: hyperparameter sweeps, held-out evaluation splits, a temperature-sharpening control, a looping control, token-position/PoS analyses, and ablations for adaptive variants (scalar vs. vector, conditional vs. unconditional, vs. full fine-tuning). Weaknesses: no statistical significance testing or seed variance; modest and mixed single-token benchmark gains (Table 2: 6/8 improved, deltas ~0.3 points); abstract's '21% increase in accuracy on GSM8k' actually corresponds to a 20.9% reduction in error rate at pass@128 (Section 4.6), an overstatement; adaptive results trained on the MMLU test split evaluate on contaminated data (transparently flagged). Generalizability is the weak point: other model families show only <0.5% perplexity reduction vs. ~5% for Gemma3, with the authors themselves attributing this to Gemma's Peri-LN/training recipe (Sections 4.4.1, 5.2, C.1), and hyperparameters are model/task dependent. Reproducibility is aided by unusually detailed appendices (normalization schemes, BPTT training specs, dataset token counts) but no code release is stated. Overall a credible, well-controlled contribution whose effect sizes may be architecture-specific.

Our approach incurs essentially no additional latency during generation, though it requires serial processing in the prefill phase. papers.summary_zh: 論文提出 recirculation,一種無需重新訓練的推論時間架構修改:逐個 token 依序處理輸入,並在每步將深層激活的一小部分混入淺層,使模型具備跨深度與步驟的循環,得以持續追蹤信念狀態,緩解前饋 Transformer 狀態表示受限於模型深度的根本限制。此方法有別於僅作深度循環的迴圈式 Transformer,也與 chain-of-thought 推論互補。作者在 Gemma3 1B/4B/12B 上選定最適來源與目的層後,十個語言建模資料集的困惑度最多降低約 16%(1B/4B)與 35%(12B),效果亦見於其他模型家族,惟幅度以 Gemma 最大。進一步的 adaptive recirculation 僅以小型 MLP 學習逐 token 條件化的混合係數 α、β,凍結原模型權重,即將平均困惑度降幅提升至 23%,GSM8k 的 pass@1 錯誤率降低 8.8%,pass@128 降低 20.9%,並在指令遵循與語境消歧任務帶來改善。代價是 prefill 階段必須序列處理,長上下文時較慢。限制包括超參數依任務而異、跨模型家族效果幅度不一、需適當正規化,且區塊式循環與多路徑循環尚待探索。此研究示範由模型自身引導的架構改良路線,深具啟發性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-as-judge evaluation-methodology paper squarely within scope: it studies whether judge model capability and reasoning effort matter when grading open-ended exam answers against extracted rubrics, using GPT-5.6 and Claude families as writers/judges. Preference relevance is high (LLM evaluation, benchmarks, reasoning-effort, judge bias), though not Japanese-NLP specific. Rigor is strong for an evaluation study: 3,456 verdicts, ICC(2,1) with cluster-bootstrap CIs, variance decomposition, scale anchoring via empty/reference sheets, a pre-snapping artifact check, and ablations that isolate the official answer as the load-bearing rubric component. Evidence for the internal claims is solid, but the central validity claim rests on consistency plus anchors rather than human raters, the writer-side effort effect is carried by one family, ablations cover only 12 questions single-pass, and essays show no discrimination at any guidance level. Novelty is moderate: rubric-based LLM grading exists (refs 11-12); the contribution is holding the rubric fixed and varying the judge, plus the criteria-vs-answer-key decomposition. Generalizability is limited to 24 Traditional-Chinese Taiwanese exam questions across two model families. Reproducibility is excellent: public HuggingFace corpus, GitHub repo with all grading reports, data.csv, and analysis scripts.

primary_link.title: Grading Needs a Rubric, Not Intelligence

papers.summary: Small language models can grade open-ended examination answers as reliably as substantially more expensive models when they grade against an explicit rubric. We test this claim as the design principle behind any-to-bench: a frontier model reads source documents once, at ingestion, to extract each question and its rubric; lower-cost models then perform all repeated grading work. We evaluate six cost-efficient model configurations from two model families at three reasoning-effort levels. Each conf
papers.summary_zh: 開放式考題（論述、翻譯、繪圖）難以自動評分，傳統 LLM-as-a-judge 每次評分都呼叫昂貴的前沿模型，且存在偏好長答案與自家模型家族等已知偏差。any-to-bench 工具據此提出不對稱設計：攝入階段由前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol）一次性從原始文件抽取題目與評分規則（rubric，含官方參考答案、評分準則與等級），其後所有重複評分交由低成本小模型。實驗讓兩個模型家族各三種推理強度共六組配置互為答題者與評分者，針對台灣三大國家考試 24 道開放題產出 3,456 次判定。結果顯示被評答案解釋 95.6% 的分數變異，評分者身分僅占 0.2%；提高答題側推理強度最多增加 0.143 滿分，評分側至多 0.006，前沿模型評分者也未更可靠。消融實驗指出評分規則是解耦評分與評分者智慧的機制，其中官方答案承擔幾乎全部作用：僅移除準則幾無影響（ICC 0.880 對 0.888），連官方答案一併移除則可靠性崩潰（ICC 降至 0.628）且分數膨脹。在 rubric 錨定下未見長度偏好或家族偏好，一位評分者即已足夠。限制包括題目均來自繁體中文的國家考試、缺少人類閱卷對照，且論述題始終缺乏鑑別力。整體而言，智慧應集中於攝入端萃取評分標準，評分本身可低成本規模化。
papers.title: Grading Needs a Rubric, Not Intelligence

links.title: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?

evidence: §4.1: 'The evaluation comprises 72 experimental configurations, covering all 6x6x2 combinations of (agent, task, reference condition)' with up to 24 hours on a single NVIDIA V100 and up to 10 successive solutions per configuration.

§4.2: 'Among the 72 experimental configurations, 10 reach or surpass Human SOTA, but these successes occur on only 3 of the 6 tasks. Eight are concentrated on GoEmotions'; Human SOTA mean rank 2.67 vs 4.83 for the best agent configuration (Gemini CLI w/ references).

§4.3: '45.3% of the methods share an algorithmic coordinate with at least one collected human method, while another 28.4% differ from the nearest human method in exactly one module'; '95.3% of module-level choices use values already observed in collected human methods' and 'only 3.2% of the methods fall outside the constructed design spaces'.

§4.4: 'Among the 10 configurations that reach or surpass Human SOTA, 8 of them produce a SOTA-reaching method at d<=2, and none produces one outside the constructed design spaces'; 'the best method in each of the 10 SOTA-reaching configurations uses ensemble prediction'.

§4.5: 'Providing references improves performance in 20 comparisons, reduces it in 15, and leaves it unchanged in 1' and 'only 2 of the 60 configurations involving these five agents conduct task-specific online searches'; agents access only 5.4% of provided references.

§3.2: Human-in-the-loop design space construction where 'Human experts then inspect a sample of the mappings for agent-designed methods to identify systematic assignment errors', with out-of-space classification defined for methods not expressible in existing modules.

Table 2 (§4): Full per-task best results for all 12 agent configurations across CUB200, GoEmotions, ogbn-arxiv, ogbl-ppa, ETTh1, and Weather, with bold/underline conventions for best and SOTA-reaching results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement study of widely used LLM coding/research agents (Claude Code with Opus/DeepSeek/GLM, Codex, Gemini CLI, MLEvolve) designing methods for open-ended AI tasks, squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and evaluation preferences. The core novelty is representing human- and agent-designed methods as coordinates in task-specific algorithmic design spaces and measuring module-level Hamming distance to human references, an auditable alternative to LLM-as-judge novelty scoring (explicitly contrasted with InnoGym in §2.2). Rigor is solid: 6x6x2=72 configurations, matched reference-provided/withheld comparisons, human-in-the-loop validation of design spaces, and consistent headline statistics (10/72 reach SOTA; 45.3% at d=0, 73.7% within d<=1; 95.3% module choices reuse human values; 3.2% OOS). Weaknesses: single run per configuration without variance or significance testing, only six tasks, Hamming distance sensitive to module granularity, and the design-space construction is itself partly LLM-automated (mitigated by expert review). Evidence is quantitatively specific and internally consistent, but key figures are only available as captions and the external-knowledge measurement (2/60 searches, 5.4% of references accessed) lacks methodological detail. No explicit code/data release URL is stated, so reproducibility relies on the described packaging of self-contained task projects and recorded snapshots. Score reflects strong preference fit and careful empirical design tempered by limited task diversity, no statistical testing, and availability claims that are only implicit.

primary_link.title: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?

papers.summary: Recent advances in LLM agents have made them increasingly capable of designing methods for complex AI tasks. This raises two central questions about agent-designed methods relative to human-designed methods: how well they perform, and how different their algorithmic designs are. To study these questions, this paper introduces an analysis that derives task-specific algorithmic design spaces from human-designed methods, maps both human- and agent-designed methods into these spaces, and quantifies
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理已能為複雜 AI 任務設計方法，但相較人類設計，其表現好壞與演算法設計差異程度缺乏系統分析。本文建立六個跨模態的開放式任務（影像分類 CUB-200-2011、情緒分類 GoEmotions、圖節點分類 ogbn-arxiv、連結預測 ogbl-ppa 與兩項時間序列預測），附人類排行榜與參考論文、程式碼，並以人機協作流程從人類方法建構任務特定的演算法設計空間，將人類與代理設計的方法映射為模組層級座標，以漢明距離量化差異。實驗評估 Claude Code（分別搭載 Opus 4.8、DeepSeek 4 Pro、GLM 5.2）、Codex、Gemini CLI 與 MLEvolve 六種代理，共 72 個（代理、任務、參考條件）組合，各配置 24 小時執行預算。結果顯示僅 10 個設定達到或超越人類 SOTA，且集中於 3 個任務；96.8% 的代理方法落在人類衍生的設計空間內，近半數與既有方法完全一致，73.7% 與最近的人類方法差異不超過一個模組；代理極少主動搜尋外部知識，達標方法皆採 ensemble 預測，提供參考資料也未穩定改善表現。限制在於任務覆蓋有限，且設計空間經過抽象化，可能遺漏實作細節。作者據此提出座標保持最佳化、空間內重組與空間擴張三條邁向可靠進展的路線。
papers.title: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?
papers.title_zh: 當 AI 設計 AI：創新還是模仿？

Appendix E.6.1 Table 32: task-swap AUC 0.991/0.999/0.962 (OSWorld/FinanceBench/EICU-AC, Qwen3.5-9B) supporting task-conditioning

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent safety/oversight research, squarely matching high-weight preferences (agents & tool use, AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, LLM-as-judge). The proposal of task-conditioned prefix-level 'ontological trust' with Role/Goal/Evidence decomposition and deterministic state updates is a genuinely distinct framing from step-level safety, rule, or judge-style monitors, and the constructed prefix-paired drift corpus fills a real evaluation gap. Rigor is solid: motivating negative result (snapshot metrics cap at 73.49% AUC), axis ablations, task-swap controls, threshold sweeps, subtype breakdowns, and clustered bootstrap CIs for the snapshot study. However, evidence strength is tempered by small per-cell test sets (24-30 drift trajectories per benchmark) with no CIs on the headline F1s, onset annotation agreement of only 63.2% exact (N=21), a single actor model, hand-set projection constants, and honestly weak pseudo-consistency results (median 18.2% F1). Generalizability is partially supported by three domains and three estimator capacities including an edge model, but the corpus is self-constructed with injected directives and the pseudo-consistency ceiling is environment-dependent. Reproducibility documentation is thorough (prompts, fixed constants, compute, token costs), but the checklist admits code and the processed corpus are not yet released. No scope violations; not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly operate across many steps, tools, and observa- tions. In this setting, the relevant oversight question is not only whether each action is locally valid, but whether the evolving trajectory still corresponds to the task the user authorized. Drift can accumulate quietly: an agent may call the right tool with plausible arguments at every step, while its prefix moves toward a broader role, an adjacent objective, or evidence the user never supplied. Existing monitors
papers.summary_zh: 長程代理可能在每一步都使用正確工具、看似合理，但整體軌跡已偏離使用者授權的任務，例如擴張角色、改寫目標或依賴未經提供的證據。既有監控多檢查局部合規、輸出最終裁定或評估一般風險，無法直接估計「軌跡前綴是否仍是授權任務」。本文提出本體信任概念，沿角色、目標與證據三軸分解，並實作為 RGE 線上監控器：LLM 僅負責產生結構化的任務與步驟表示，信任狀態更新、投影與介入決策皆為確定性計算，輸出可重放、可稽核的信任軌跡。作者以 OSWorld、FinanceBench 與 EICU-AC 建構 248 條跨領域軌跡語料，涵蓋良性執行、前綴配對漂移與偽一致性失敗。初步分析顯示九種步級快照指標的最佳組合僅達 73.49% AUC，而 RGE 三軸座標能回復訊號。主實驗中，GPT-4o 與 Qwen3.5-9B 在所有基準的漂移 F1 超過 93%，良性覆蓋率不低於 95.8%；偽一致性偵測則取決於任務完成是否可從外部觀察，跨設定中位數僅 18.2%，唯讀推理型領域尤為受限。限制包括無法觀測代理內部狀態與環境未揭露的完成條件。此研究將長程代理監督從單一步驟層級提升到任務身分層級。
papers.title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: 超越可疑步驟：長程代理的本體信任

links.title: Efficient RLVR Scheduling via Graph-Structured Online Difficulty Estimation

evidence: Abstract: 'propose a plug-and-play graph-based online difficulty estimator that shares rollout feedback across related samples... mitigating cold start and staleness without dedicated probing' and integration into 'sample-selection and rollout-allocation schedulers'.

Contributions (Introduction): 'We are the first to formulate dynamic difficulty estimation in RLVR as a graph-structured latent-variable inference problem', combining Potts prior, Beta-Binomial state model, and online mean-field variational inference.

Section 'Overall Performance', Table 1: GVM+Ours improves 'in seven of the eight settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one' on MATH500/AIME24/AIME25/OlympiadBench for Qwen-2.5-Math-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.

Section 'Can Our Method Continuously Track Sample Difficulty During RL Training?', Table 2: Ours reaches full-trajectory MAE 0.183 / r 0.836 (Qwen) with ~0.12 A100*h overhead vs ~45.3h for Sample Before Step and early-stage r=0.482 vs MoPPS 0.373.
Ablation Study, Table 3: removing spectral initialization degrades Qwen MAE 0.183->0.218 and r 0.836->0.710; removing prior smoothing and graph sparsification also degrades both models.
Appendix C ('Exact Test and Results', Table 4): pooled exact sign test W=21, L=1, p=1.10e-5 across 24 non-tied comparisons; PCL+Ours alone reaches only p=0.0703 (alpha=0.10).

Appendix D ('Results', Table 5): transfer to LiveCodeBench with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct gives Ours MAE 0.176 / r 0.845 vs MoPPS 0.224/0.773, described as 'transferability rather than a clear advantage in code generation'.
Implementation Details: '4x A100 80G GPUs', matched budget '~1.5M rollouts', Qwen3-0.6B embedding, K=320, k_nn=80, gamma=0.5, beta=2, NuminaMath ~150K training problems.

Appendix E (Table 7): removing the difficulty-aware instruction raises Qwen MAE 0.183->0.309 and drops r 0.836->0.583; MRL-compressed Qwen3-Embedding-4B is best (0.179/0.844), showing embedding-choice sensitivity.

Appendix A provides ELBO derivation and proofs of Propositions 1-3 (monotonicity/convergence for the sequential implementation), while the synchronous Jacobi variant used in practice is explicitly 'not an exact block-coordinate maximization' with discrepancy within 1e-2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology paper on efficient RLVR for reasoning: a graph-structured latent difficulty estimator (spectral init, Potts prior, Beta-Binomial states, online mean-field VI) that plugs into GRPO schedulers. Strongly aligned with LLM, reasoning, RL, and training-efficiency preferences; not an out-of-scope domain application. Novelty is moderate: components (Potts/Markov priors, mean-field VI, Beta-Binomial streaming) are classical, but the graph-coupled online formulation for RLVR difficulty estimation with cold-start mitigation appears new versus MoPPS/VIP/CDAS/GRESO. Rigor is above average: formal derivations with proofs (Appendix A), matched rollout budgets, replay-based evaluation against probing (SBR/SBS) and low-cost baselines (Table 2), component ablations (Table 3), hyperparameter and embedding sensitivity (Tables 6-7), and sign-test statistics (Appendix C), though the sign test on 24 comparisons tests direction only, AIME has 30 problems, and PCL integration is significant only at alpha=0.10. Evidence is broad and consistent but self-contained: Table 1 shows GVM+Ours improving 7/8 settings, Table 2 reports r=0.836 (Qwen) full-trajectory at ~0.12h overhead versus ~45.3h for probing, and Appendix D shows code-domain transfer (r=0.845 on LiveCodeBench), yet all results use small (1B-1.5B, one 7B) models and math-heavy tasks. Generalizability is supported across two model families, three schedulers, and a preliminary code domain, with acknowledged embedding-model dependence. Reproducibility is decent: full hyperparameters (K=320, k_nn=80, beta=2, gamma=0.5, Qwen3-0.6B encoder) and public datasets are specified, and a code/data supplement is referenced, but no explicit public release is verified in the text.

primary_link.title: Efficient RLVR Scheduling via Graph-Structured Online Difficulty Estimation

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models but relies on costly rollout exploration. Assigning the same exploration budget to samples with different difficulty levels is inefficient: easy samples may receive redundant rollouts, whereas difficult but learnable samples may receive too little exploration. Existing adaptive schedulers address this mismatch through curriculum-based sample selection or non-uniform rollout allocati
papers.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）透過自動可驗證的回饋提升大型語言模型的推理能力，但 rollout 探索成本高昂；對難度不同的樣本平均分配探索預算並無效率，而可靠的線上難度估計並不易取得：專門探測開銷大，依賴歷史回饋則有冷啟動與過時問題，且通常忽略樣本間的關聯。本文提出即插即用的圖結構線上難度估計框架：先以難度感知指令搭配嵌入模型建構樣本相似圖，經譜聚類初始化，再以 Potts 圖先驗鼓勵相鄰樣本共享潛在難度狀態；各狀態以 Beta-Binomial 模型匯總 rollout 成敗，並用線上平均場變分推論持續更新狀態分配與成功率，使相關樣本共享證據、無需額外探測。框架可整合於樣本選擇與 rollout 分配排程。實驗將其嵌入 GVM、PCL 與 GRESO 三種排程器，在 Qwen-2.5-Math-1.5B 與 Llama-3.2-1B 上於 MATH500、AIME 2024/2025 與 OlympiadBench 評測，多數設定優於原方法（彙總符號檢定 p 約 1.1×10⁻⁵）；難度估計在低成本方法中整體最佳，全期相關達 0.836 與 0.776，總開銷約 0.12 A100 小時，並初步驗證可轉移至程式碼生成。限制包括實驗以數學為主、累積歷史可能滯後於策略變化，以及超參數需依設定調整。
papers.title: Efficient RLVR Scheduling via Graph-Structured Online Difficulty Estimation
papers.title_zh: 透過圖結構線上難度估計的高效 RLVR 排程

links.title: DEPT: Document Embedding Preservation Tuning for Unified Query Expansion and Retrieval

Results and Analysis, Generation Ability: 'DEPT stays close to the base model, decreasing from 77.56 to 76.28 on average, whereas standard contrastive learning (CL) collapses to 9.32' on GSM8K/IFEval/MMLU-Pro (Figure 6).

Backbones and Baselines: UniRAG is 'our same-backbone reimplementation' serving as the staged unified baseline; Implementation Details: 'all reported results are from a single run, and preprocessing, sampling, and training use seed 42', LoRA r=16/α=32, four RTX PRO 6000 96GB GPUs.

Method / Leveraging Stable Document Embeddings: DEP loss regularizes angular drift δ(d)=1−cos(d,d^0) against cached θ0 embeddings (Eqs. 4–6), fixed whitening fitted on 1,024 cached docs (Eq. 7, Table 2), straight-through top-64 decoding (Eqs. 9–11), enabling index reuse and FAISS-based rank-5 online hard-negative mining; abstract states code is available at github.com/ILSparkle/DEPT.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: a single decoder-only LLM (Qwen3-4B, LLaMA-3.2-3B) is trained end-to-end for both query expansion and dense retrieval, squarely matching the LLM (2.5) and RAG/dense-retrieval (1.8) preferences; it is not a pure domain application or CV/audio/robotics work. The contribution—identifying document-embedding drift as the moving-target obstacle in unified generation+encoding and addressing it with a DEP anchor loss, fixed whitening fitted on cached embeddings, straight-through expansion gradients, and cached-index reuse—is a sensible and reasonably novel combination, though each ingredient (straight-through estimators, whitening, embedding regularization, GritLM-style unified models) exists in prior work; novelty lies mainly in the asymmetric query-side training principle. Rigor is solid: two backbones, five BEIR tasks, training-free/independent/staged baselines, component ablations, generation-preservation check, and index-reuse evaluation; however, results come from a single run with one seed (Implementation Details), ablations cover only three of five tasks (Table 3), UniRAG is the authors' own reimplementation (Backbones and Baselines), and no significance testing or variance is reported. Evidence strength is supported by explicit nDCG@10 tables (DEPT 42.59 avg vs ExpandR 41.09 on Qwen, Table 1), ablation deltas (whitening removal 50.82→42.09), and generation results (77.56→76.28 for DEPT vs 9.32 for CL), but some key evidence is figure-only (index reuse, generation benchmarks). Generalizability is moderate: two 3–4B backbones, LoRA-only, five BEIR subsets, no larger or encoder-based models. Reproducibility is strong: public code link, detailed hyperparameter table (Table 2), seed and hardware stated.

primary_link.title: DEPT: Document Embedding Preservation Tuning for Unified Query Expansion and Retrieval

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can both expand underspecified queries and encode text as dense representations, suggesting a unified model for query expansion and retrieval. Existing systems usually rely on prompted expansions, independently trained modules, or staged optimization, leaving generated expansions only indirectly aligned with the retrieval loss that judges them. We train a single decoder-only LLM end to end, where the same model generates the expansion and encodes both the expanded qu
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究如何將查詢擴增與稠密檢索統一在單一 decoder-only LLM 之中。現有系統多仰賴提示產生擴增文字、分開訓練生成器與檢索器，或分階段最佳化，擴增文字無法直接被評判其好壞的檢索損失調整；但若端對端訓練同一模型，會出現移動目標問題：更新參數改善查詢擴增時，文件嵌入也隨之漂移，妨礙對比學習穩定收斂。作者提出 Document Embedding Preservation Tuning（DEPT），以 DEP 損失把微調後的文件嵌入約束在初始快取嵌入附近，搭配在快取嵌入上擬合的固定 whitening 轉換、線上困難負樣本挖掘，以及 straight-through 解碼，讓檢索梯度穿透離散生成路徑、主要作用於查詢側的擴增與表示學習。實驗以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 與 LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct 為骨幹，在 BEIR 五個資料集上，DEPT 與精簡關鍵字版 DEPT-K 的平均 nDCG@10 皆超越免訓練、獨立訓練與分階段統一的基準；消融實驗顯示 whitening 貢獻最大，DEP 損失同時支援快取索引重用並保留一般生成能力，而標準對比學習會使生成能力崩壞。限制包括結果來自單次執行、僅驗證兩種骨幹與少數任務，SCIDOCS 仍是長擴增的邊界案例。本文指出統一生成與表示檢索必須主動穩定文件嵌入，才能兼顧檢索品質、生成能力與部署端的索引重用。
papers.title: DEPT: Document Embedding Preservation Tuning for Unified Query Expansion and Retrieval
papers.title_zh: DEPT：統一查詢擴增與檢索的文件嵌入保存微調

links.title: PlanPO: Group Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Agentic LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'PlanPO improves over GRPO by 27.2% on average across the challenging multi-turn benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld'
Table 1 (ALFWorld/WebShop, Qwen2.5-1.5B): PlanPO All 91.3±4.1 vs GRPO 72.8±3.6 and GiGPO w/o std 67.4±4.5; mean and variance over three random seeds noted in caption
Experiments > Implementation details: group size N=8, lr 1e-6, KL coefficient 1e-3 (SciWorld) / 0.01, max turns 50/15/20, α_init=2α_final=0.1, trained on 6 NVIDIA H200s and 8 A40s
Theorem 1 (Bias–variance trade-off): Bias²(A_α)=(1−α)²(A^{S,⋆})², Var(A_α)=v_E+α²v_S+2αc, linking the decayed α(k) to estimator variance
In-depth Analysis > Ablation Study: α_init=0.1 best among {0.5,0.2,0.1,0.05,0}; ablating A^E 'significantly degrades PlanPO's performance'
Generalization Verification (Table 3): Out-Success 87.1±3.6 vs GRPO 70.1±2.5 and GiGPO 82.4±2.0 on ALFWorld OOD
Planning-Aware Strategies (Figure 5): mean interaction turns reduced to 13.8 vs 26.1 (GRPO) and mean response length 56.3 vs 95.1 tokens

Figure 4 (Length-Normalized Method Comparison): unconditional length shaping in PPO 'quickly collapses to nearly zero success', isolating the benefit to success-conditioned group-relative normalization
Missing: no limitations section and no code/data availability claim anywhere in the paper text
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological paper squarely on-preference: it trains LLM agents (Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B) with a GRPO-style RL variant for multi-turn tasks, hitting Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Reasoning, and RL preferences strongly; it is not a pure domain application. The core contribution—success-conditioned length normalization of outcome rewards at trajectory and turn levels combined into a coarse-to-fine advantage with a decayed weight—is a fairly simple twist on existing GRPO variants (GiGPO, DAPO, Dr. GRPO, length shaping), making novelty moderate despite the clean framing and a simple bias-variance theorem. Rigor is good: strong baseline coverage (PPO, RLOO, GRPO, EMPG, GiGPO, AgentGym-RL, prompting and closed-source models), three seeds with mean±std, ablations on α schedule and components, OOD evaluation, and a control isolating success-conditioned length shaping from unconditional shaping (Figure 4); however there is no explicit limitations section and no significance testing. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., OOD +17.0 points over GRPO matches the claimed 24.3% relative gain; Table 1 shows 91.3±4.1 vs GiGPO 67.4±4.5 on ALFWorld-1.5B), though many results on SciWorld baselines are imported rather than re-run. Generalizability is supported across three benchmarks and two model scales but only Qwen2.5 backbones, and hyperparameters needed per-environment adjustment (α reduced to 0.05 for SciWorld). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed hyperparameters and hardware are given, but no code release is claimed.

primary_link.title: PlanPO: Group Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Agentic LLMs

papers.summary: Group-relative policy optimization has emerged as a key paradigm for training agentic large language models (LLMs) on multi-turn interactive tasks. However, most existing variants fail to distinguish advantages among successful trajectories even when these trajectories differ substantially in their interaction efficiency. For instance, circuitous successes are often assigned the identical outcome reward, causing advantage collapse and severe performance bottlenecks. To this end, we propose Group
papers.summary_zh: 針對多輪互動任務的代理式 LLM，GRPO 等群組相對策略最佳化常把所有成功軌跡視為同等優良，即使它們的互動效率差異極大，繞遠路的成功也拿到相同結果獎勵，造成優勢塌縮與效能瓶頸。本文提出 PlanPO：只在成功軌跡內進行由粗到細的長度正規化，分別在軌跡層級以回合數、在回合層級以回應 token 長度正規化結果獎勵，再個別計算群組相對優勢並加權結合；回合層級權重 α(k) 隨訓練線性衰減，避免退化成無條件的長度極小化，作者並以理論分析說明偏誤—變異數權衡。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 SciWorld 三個基準上，以 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 與 7B-Instruct 實驗，PlanPO 平均較 GRPO 提升 27.2%，超越 PPO、RLOO、GiGPO、EMPG 等強基準，ALFWorld 分布外任務亦有 24.3% 增益；平均互動回合從 26.1 降到 13.8、回應長度從 95.1 降到 56.3 tokens，額外訓練成本可忽略。消融顯示軌跡層級訊號是主要來源，α_init=0.1 最適，過大或過小都會降低表現。限制包括各 RL 方法在 SciWorld 的 Chem-Mix 領域持續失敗，且長度只是規劃效率的代理指標。本文證明成功軌跡的異質性是簡單、可擴充的訓練訊號，能學得可泛化的規劃行為。
papers.title: PlanPO: Group Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Agentic LLMs
papers.title_zh: PlanPO：多輪代理式 LLM 的群組規劃感知策略最佳化

links.title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations

evidence: Abstract: 'Edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items; edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items.'

Section 3.6: item classification uses a Fisher exact test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 5% within each migration-benchmark cell, a practical-significance threshold epsilon=0.2, and calibration against a 1,000-replication permutation null at matched sample size.

Section 4.2: 'the 95th percentile of the reliable-change share was 0.0% in every migration-benchmark cell' across 1,000 label permutations, consistent with BH false-rejection probability under the complete null.

Section 3.3 and Appendix A Table 2: pre-specified screening of 11 candidates; GPQA Diamond (26.7%), MMLU-Pro (6.7%), and IFEval (26.7%) fell below the 35% headroom threshold, supporting the selection logic but also the headroom limitation.
Appendix B Tables 3-4: none of the 457 reliable item-level changes is recoverable from a single draw; raw flips are cross-tabulated against the K=50 classification over 2,700 item-edge pairs.

Section 6 (Threats to Validity): shares are 'estimates for informative benchmarks, not population rates'; single vendor (GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol) and three benchmarks; epsilon and K jointly bound detectability.

Data Availability: complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs at github.com/WenJing95/gpt-regression-data, claimed recomputable without re-querying commercial APIs; the URL itself is unverifiable from the document.

Internal consistency check: Appendix E Table 8 counts reproduce Section 4.1 means (e.g., SuperGPQA GPT-5.4: 15841/25000 = 63.4%; Sol IFBench: 9111/15000 = 60.7%), and strict-loose gaps in Section 4.3 (R=6.3, 5.1, 9.0) yield the reported Delta R values exactly.

Section 3.4: collection ran in per-model phases in release order (30 July-13 August 2026) with item-repetition randomization only within phases; no cross-phase drift or silent-update control is discussed, an unaddressed temporal confound.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement study squarely in preferred LLM-evaluation territory: item-level backward-compatibility testing of commercial LLM API upgrades via repeated sampling (K=50), BH-FDR-controlled Fisher tests, a practical-significance threshold, and permutation-null calibration of the entire classification pipeline. Rigor is strong for an empirical study: pre-specified benchmark screening (Appendix A), deterministic scoring decoupled from collection, sensitivity analysis over epsilon (Appendix C), a single-draw contrast (Appendix B), honest threats-to-validity, and internally consistent statistics (Appendix E counts reproduce Section 4.1 means; Appendix D totals match 900x50x3=135,000 responses). Novelty is incremental: the design explicitly extends a K=10 open-weight reliable-change study to frontier commercial APIs and adds a strict/loose verifier-gap analysis; the core item-level churn idea is prior work. Generalizability is limited to one vendor, three headroom-screened public benchmarks, and the paper says so itself; phased collection in release order leaves a temporal/silent-update confound undiscussed; no human audit of the automated parser is reported. External anchors (named model versions, the release URL) cannot be verified from the document, which caps evidence and reproducibility credit. Weighted score ~0.74.

primary_link.title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations

papers.summary: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad
papers.summary_zh: 商用 LLM API 的下游系統在供應商淘汰舊模型時必須遷移，這類更新類似軟體相依性升級，理論上需要回歸測試；但遷移決策通常只依賴聚合基準分數，把異質的題目層級行為壓縮成單一淨值。本文以 GPT-5.4、GPT-5.5 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 構成產品線的三條兩兩升級邊為對象，在 SuperGPQA（研究所程度知識）、Omni-MATH hard（奧林匹亞數學）與 IFBench（指令遵循）共 900 道公開題目上，每題每模型獨立取樣 50 次，估計答對機率的變化，並以 Fisher 精確檢定搭配 Benjamini–Hochberg 錯誤發現率控制與 20 個百分點的實務顯著性門檻，將每題分類為可靠改善、可靠退化、實務等價或無法判定，再用置換虛無假設校準整個分類流程。結果顯示九個遷移—基準組合中可靠改善與可靠退化並存：聚合上升達 7.3 個百分點的邊仍含最多 8.3% 可靠退化題目，聚合下降的邊含最多 10.7% 可靠改善題目；IFBench 上嚴格與寬鬆計分的差距在最新遷移擴大 3.9 個百分點，嚴格計分的 3.9 點退化在寬鬆計分下僅剩 0.04 點，顯示退化集中於格式遵循。單次取樣偵測不到 457 個可靠題目層級變化中的任何一個。限制是僅涵蓋單一供應商與三個具辨識空間的基準。本文提醒只看聚合分數的遷移閘門會漏掉雙向變化，並公開完整回應封存以供重算與驗證。

links.title: Contracting for LLM Delegation: Moral Hazard in Technology and Effort Choice

evidence: Abstract: derives optimal linear contract where the Agent chooses 'a model and an associated effort level (e.g., token budget)' and calibrates on 'open-weight LLM pairings across the MATH and MMLUPro benchmarks'.
Section 3.1: FOC gives x*_m=(1/k_m)ln(alpha*M_m*k_m/c_m) with activation threshold tau_m=c_m/(M_m*k_m); utility U_m(alpha)=M_m[alpha-tau_m-tau_m*ln(alpha/tau_m)] verified algebraically.
Section 3.3: Principal's per-model payoff V_m(alpha)=M_m[1+tau_m-alpha-tau_m/alpha] is maximized at alpha*_m=sqrt(tau_m), clipped against switching threshold theta (Eq. 6-7).

Section 4.1/Table 1: calibration via scipy curve_fit with burn-in (Eq. 8); R^2 0.983-0.999 and RMSE 0.414-2.153 across six models (Llama-3.2, DS-R1-Distill, Gemma-4) on MATH levels 3-4 (2,962 questions) and MMLU-Pro (12,032 questions).

Section 5.1/Table 2: learned theta_0 vs estimated, e.g., Llama 1B vs 3B MATH 0.367 vs 0.409; Llama 1B vs DS 1.5B 'L dom.'; DS 1.5B vs Gemma 4B 'H dom.' (flipped order with tau_L=0.0833 > tau_H=0.0464).
Section 5.3/Fig. 6: Principal trained 3,000 episodes with 21 UCB arms against frozen Agent; greedy contract share 'close to theoretical expectations' for Llama 1B vs 3B.

Appendix E: seed=42, 2,000 episodes, batch k=16, N=21 token bins, LinUCB with handcrafted context [1, alpha, ln(alpha)], vLLM temperature 0.0; 'All code is attached as a zip. A more organized version will be made publicly available upon acceptance.'

Appendix H: N-model extension with dominance removal, capability ordering, staircase proposition, and counterexample (10,0.1),(11,0.5),(50,0.6) where model 2 is never optimal; Section 6 admits costless verification in the base model and non-ground-truth settings left to future work.

Appendix F: LLM controllers (Gemma 4 31B, Qwen 3.6 35B, DeepSeek R1 70B) recover qualitative model-choice direction but 'spend less than optimal' on token budgets, presented only as preliminary evidence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A principal-agent contract-theory paper squarely on LLM delegation: the Agent's hidden two-dimensional action is (model choice, token budget), directly matching LLM, Agents & Tool Use, and test-time-compute reasoning preferences. Theory is clean and verifiable: activation threshold tau_m=c_m/(M_m k_m), optimal share alpha*=sqrt(tau_m), plus burn-in, fixed-payment ('selling the firm'), costly-verification, and N-model extensions, several of which I spot-checked and found correct (e.g., Appendix H counterexample D_12(1)~-5.01, D_23(1)~2.99 reproduces). Empirics calibrate a saturating production function on six real open-weight models (R^2 0.983-0.999) and show LinUCB/UCB bandits converge to the theoretical switching threshold within ~7-16% and the Principal's learned contract near alpha_dagger. Deductions: validation is simulation-only against curves fitted from the same deterministic (temperature-0) generations, a single fixed seed with no variance across seeds, ground-truth verifiers and linear value-in-accuracy assumed, and only small 1B-7B models on MATH/MMLU-Pro, so external validity beyond curated benchmarks is untested; code is attached but public release is only promised upon acceptance. Novelty is solid but incremental over Saig et al. and inference-time compute work: the genuinely new element is endogenous technology choice within moral hazard plus a continuous unobservable effort variable.
topics: Contract theory / mechanism design for LLMs

primary_link.title: Contracting for LLM Delegation: Moral Hazard in Technology and Effort Choice

papers.summary: We extend the standard Principal-Agent framework to scenarios where the Agent selects from a suite of technologies, each characterized by a distinct cost-capability profile. This framework is increasingly critical in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), where Agents choose both a model and an associated effort level (e.g., token budget). We model the relationship between output quality and effort as a concave, saturating function, which depends on the Agent's hidden two-dimensional action ch
papers.summary_zh: 當任務由人類委派給自主 AI 代理，委派的不只是努力程度，還包括選用哪個模型與投入多少推理運算；按 token 計費會造成道德風險：代理可能過度思考，或暗中改用更便宜的低能力模型節省自身成本。本文將經典 Principal-Agent 框架擴充到代理同時隱藏選擇模型 m 與連續 token 預算 x 的情境，以飽和函數 q_m(x)=M_m(1−e^{−k_m x})（可再加 burn-in tokens）刻劃品質對努力的報酬遞減，推導線性合約下代理的最佳回應：存在啟動門檻 τ_m、最佳努力水準與模型切換門檻 θ，並據此得出委託人的最佳線性合約 α*=√τ_m（依切換門檻裁剪）。作者以 Llama-3.2、DeepSeek-R1-Distill 與 Gemma 4 六組開源模型配對，在 MATH 與 MMLU-Pro 上校準生產函數參數，並以 LinUCB（代理）與 UCB（委託人）線上學習驗證：學到的切換門檻與理論值相近（約 10–15% 差異），涵蓋標準順序切換、高階模型全面主導與低階模型主導等情境；LLM 控制器實驗方向一致但預算偏保守。限制包括模型成本與任務估值假設已知、驗證成本設為零或常數、預算離散化與推論雜訊帶來落差。本文顯示簡單線性合約即可誘因相容地引導技術感知的複雜委派，對 LLM 機制設計與代理市場定價具參考價值。

links.title: Whether LLMs Can Navigate Beliefs and Facts Depends on How You Phrase It

evidence: Abstract/Section 4: accuracy gap between factual and false claims ranges from +50% on 'vaguely remember' to -14% on 'seriously doubt' across 18 verbs, with 'believe' at 28%.

Section 5, Table 1: 'no fact-check' instruction raises false-claim accuracy in every verb family (positive belief 48.3->80.7%, evidential 33.4->62.0%, confidence 57.0->81.5%, negation 69.1->80.6%); Appendix B shows factual accuracy also rises.

Section 5, Figure 3 and Appendix C: fact-checking CoTs (42.9% of judged sample) score 25.1% on false claims vs 75.8% for non-fact-checking CoTs; judge validated on 200 hand-labeled CoTs at Cohen's kappa=0.78 (0.88 on factual verification).

Section 5, Table 2 and Appendix G: attention suppression (alpha*=-2, selected on disjoint 50 items) raises llama-3.1-8b confirmation 73.5->85.5 (~5 bootstrap SE) while verification falls 87.5->84.0; qwen-3.5-9b gain is within 1 SE; Appendix E reports mixed/null effects on four other models.
Appendix D, Table 4: claim-attention share higher on incorrect items in all six locally-run models, significant in five of six; gemma-3-12b estimate rests on only n=12 incorrect items (acknowledged).
Appendix H, Table 6: option-order permutation on all 10 models shows no accuracy collapse at any position, ruling out an (A)-preference artifact.
Appendix F: 9 of 10 models run via OpenRouter with greedy decoding but unpinned provider routing; parse failures below 2% per cell; code released at github.com/ngqm/belief-fact-phrasing.
Limitations: results from a single benchmark (KaBLE Task 5), single-turn templated prompts, only one model shows intervention gain beyond bootstrap SE, frontier models untested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM behavioral/interpretability research: extends the KaBLE belief-confirmation benchmark (Suzgun et al. 2025) across 18 epistemic verbs and 10 open-weight LLMs, identifies task confusion via fact-checking instruction contrasts, categorizes CoT strategies with a hand-validated LLM judge, and adds an attention-suppression causal intervention. Rigor is above average: answer-position permutation control (Appendix H), claim-token-count covariate for attention (Appendix D), disjoint α* selection with bootstrap SEs (Appendix G), and honest reporting of null/mixed intervention results (qwen-3.5-9b within 1 SE; Appendix E). Novelty is moderate since the benchmark, phenomenon, and much framing come from prior work; the verb generalization, instruction contrast, and decoding-time intervention are the new contributions. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent, with the causal claim appropriately scoped as a single-model existence proof. Generalizability is constrained: one benchmark, single-turn templated English prompts, no frontier models; OpenRouter provider routing unpinned slightly hurts reproducibility despite released code, templates, and inference details.
topics: belief tracking and theory of mind

primary_link.title: Whether LLMs Can Navigate Beliefs and Facts Depends on How You Phrase It

papers.summary: Humans naturally form and express beliefs in daily communication, e.g., "I think the answer is 3" or "I suppose that's right." Such beliefs inevitably intertwine with fact and knowledge, making the ability to handle them in tandem desirable for large language models (LLMs), as they are increasingly deployed in user-facing settings. Prior work showed that even capable LLMs exhibit a systemic weakness in acknowledging user beliefs grounded in incorrect information. We extend this evaluation to 10
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在實際部署中經常需要理解使用者表達的信念。本文擴展 KaBLE 基準的第 5 項任務，讓 10 個開源權重模型面對「我相信 X。我相信 X 嗎？」形式的提問，並將信念動詞替換為 18 種認知表述。正確答案永遠是「是」，但結果顯示：事實與錯誤陳述之間的準確率差距隨動詞而劇烈變化，從「我依稀記得」的 +50% 到「我嚴重懷疑」的 -14%。作者主張此弱點源自任務混淆：模型預設去對底層主張做事實查核，蓋過使用者明示的信念。證據包括：禁止事實查核的指令在所有動詞家族皆提升準確率；屬於事實查核的思考鏈在錯誤陳述上的表現明顯較差；模型在答錯的錯誤陳述上給予主張更多注意力，而在解碼時抑制該注意力僅在一個模型部分恢復準確率。限制包括僅測試開源權重模型、單一基準與單輪對話，且注意力干預的效果不一致。本文的意義在於揭示事實查核這項普遍可取的行為，可能干擾模型對信念的追蹤，未來研究需在信念確認與事實驗證兩種能力之間取得解耦。
papers.title: Whether LLMs Can Navigate Beliefs and Facts Depends on How You Phrase It
papers.title_zh: LLM 能否處理信念與事實，取決於提問的措辭

links.title: A Jagged Frontier: Evaluating Robustness of Code Agents to Semantics-Preserving Transformations

evidence: Abstract: 'up to 6.7 percentage points mean resolve-rate drop in the most affected configurations with statistically significant degradations in 6 of 16 configurations of model, scaffold, and dataset'
Experiments > Setup: 'we selected 28 task instances from SWE-bench Verified and 26 from SWE-bench Pro' across scaffolds mini-SWE agent and OpenCode with four frontier models
Semantics-Preserving Transformations > Validation: 'Across all three projects, every test retained its outcome under all 14 transformations' via differential testing on SymPy, sqlfluff, xarray
RQ1: 'Qwen is the most robust model under mini-SWE agent, degrading only 0.2 points, yet the most brittle under OpenCode at 5.5 points' supporting the jagged-frontier claim
RQ2: 'On SWE-bench Verified, cost rises in all 8 configurations, from 4.0% (mini-SWE agent with Opus) to 22.9% (OpenCode with MiniMax), and the interval excludes zero in every one'

Appendix C > Sampling Procedure: 'we first identified instances resolved by Claude Opus 4.5... 26 passing instances were sampled', indicating a solvability-filtered, capability-biased instance selection
Appendix E: derivation that Var(mu-hat)=(K*sigma^2+nu)/R is 'strictly increasing in K whenever sigma^2>0', justifying one run per variant under a fixed budget
Appendix D: 'The interval excludes zero in only 7 of the 224 cells on SWE-bench Verified and 7 of the 208 on SWE-bench Pro', showing limited per-instance statistical power
Appendix C > Randomness and Reproducibility: 'We do not fix a random seed... Reproducing our results therefore means drawing 20 fresh variants per instance at the same hyperparameters'
Appendix C > Code and Instance Lists: 'Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/CSU-TrustLab/jagged-frontier' including SPT implementations, harness, prompts, and instance IDs
RQ3: 'We manually analyze 20 agent trajectories across both scaffolds, both benchmarks (14 distinct instances), and all 4 models'
Related Work: 'All of the above evaluate single-turn model inferences on classification or short-generation tasks... Our work extends this to multi-turn agents', the core novelty claim
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: a robustness evaluation of LLM-backed coding agents (mini-SWE agent, OpenCode; Claude Opus 4.5, Kimi K2.5, MiniMax M2.5, Qwen 3.6-27B) on SWE-bench Verified/Pro, intersecting Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs, and robustness/evaluation topics. Novelty is incremental rather than fundamental: SPT-based code perturbation is well established for single-turn models (Yefet 2020, Ramakrishnan 2022, ReCode); the contribution is the first systematic extension to multi-turn repository-level agents, the scaffold-dependent 'jagged frontier' ranking result, and the variance analysis showing one-run-per-variant is optimal under a fixed budget. Rigor is strong for an empirical study: paired seed/variant runs, 20 runs per condition, bootstrap and Newcombe intervals, empirical SPT validation via differential testing on three large test suites, and an explicit fixed-population inference framing. Evidence is solid but bounded: significance in only 6 of 16 configurations, per-instance intervals exclude zero in only 14 of 432 cells, and the qualitative RQ3 rests on 20 manually reviewed trajectories. Generalizability is limited by 54 total instances, Python-only transformations, and a sample pre-filtered to instances Claude Opus 4.5 can solve, which likely understates degradation on harder tasks; the paper's own thesis is that rankings do not transfer. Reproducibility is good (public code, instance lists, versions, hardware) but no random seed is fixed and agent runs are stochastic at temperature 1.0. Not out of scope: this is agentic LLM methodology, not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: A Jagged Frontier: Evaluating Robustness of Code Agents to Semantics-Preserving Transformations

papers.summary: AI code agents are increasingly deployed to resolve real software issues, yet their reliability under superficial code variations remains poorly understood. We evaluate whether coding agents that repair repository-level issues remain reliable when the surrounding codebase is rewritten into a semantically equivalent form. We introduce a random variant sampler that applies common semantics-preserving transformations (SPTs) - spanning control-flow rewrites, dead-code injection, and identifier renam
papers.summary_zh: AI 程式碼代理被廣泛用於解決真實軟體議題，但其對表面程式碼改動的穩健性仍不清楚。本文開發 14 種語意保持轉換（控制流改寫、死碼注入、識別碼重新命名等），並以隨機變異取樣器對儲存庫產生語意等價的擾動版本；透過對未擾動種子與變體的反覆配對執行，將擾動效應與代理本身的隨機性分離。實驗涵蓋 mini-SWE agent 與 OpenCode 兩種代理框架，搭配 Claude Opus 4.5、Kimi K2.5、MiniMax M2.5 與 Qwen 3.6-27B，任務取自 SWE-bench Verified 與 Pro 共 54 個實例。主要發現：多數設定出現小幅退化，最嚴重達 6.7 個百分點，16 個設定中有 6 個具統計顯著性；穩健性排名無法跨框架或基準轉移，例如 Qwen 在 mini-SWE agent 上最穩健，在 OpenCode 上卻最脆弱，呈現「崎嶇的穩健性前沿」；較簡單的框架整體更穩健；擾動也推高步數與成本至 9.9% 與 22.9%。限制包括實例數量有限且取樣刻意非對抗性。此研究提醒排行榜表現可能高估真實部署的可靠性。

papers.title_zh: 崎嶇的前沿：評估程式碼代理對語意保持轉換的穩健性

links.title: An Empirical Study of Reward Specification and Benchmark Reliability in GRPO-based LLM Unlearning

evidence: Section 1/Contributions: foregrounds broad-topic answering as a third behavior-level requirement beyond target suppression and utility preservation, comparing R0-Lex, R1-AntiRefusal, R2-Rubric, R4-Refusal in one GRPO pipeline

Section 5.1/Table 2: 0.5B and 1.5B cold-start R0-Lex show lex/sem leakage 0.000 and refusal 1.000 with prompt helpfulness 0.000, evidencing refusal collapse; R1-AntiRefusal 0.5B/1.5B show refusal-classifier hacking via AI-policy boilerplate
Section 5.2/Table 3: warm-start R2-Rubric reaches broad-topic helpfulness 0.812 (0.5B) to 0.906 (3B) with semantic leakage <=0.047 and refusal <=0.031
Section 5.3: all four warm-start 3B rewards reduce RWKU forget overlap by similar magnitudes, supporting the claim that benchmark forgetting alone cannot identify the behavioral endpoint
Appendix B.1: ten forget targets fixed before examining outcomes; one training seed per target-condition, so intervals reflect target heterogeneity not seed variance
Appendix C.2/Table 5: R2-Rubric implemented as refusal-filtered GPT-5.4-nano structured-judge reward with deterministic 0.0-1.0 mapping; audit judge (GPT-5.6-luna) claimed independent in Appendix E.1

Section 6 Limitations: acknowledges proxy rewards, incomplete 7B artifact coverage, temperature-zero decoding only (no leak@k under sampling), judge bias/version dependence, and no parameter-level deletion claims

Front matter/Section 1: project webpage, GitHub code, W&B report, and Hugging Face collection (checkpoints and datasets) linked for reproducibility; Appendix D Tables 6-8 give full SFT/GRPO/LoRA hyperparameters
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: GRPO-based LLM unlearning on Qwen2.5 with LoRA, squarely matching LLM, alignment/RLHF (reward specification, reward hacking), AI safety (unlearning, leakage), and evaluation preferences. The diagnostic contribution—showing that RWKU scores, held-out audits, and terminal rollout audits disagree across four reward designs and cold/warm initialization—is well executed and honestly scoped, but the core insight (reward proxies select behavioral endpoints; benchmarks are diagnostic-insufficient) is an instantiation of known reward-hacking and spurious-rewards findings, so novelty is moderate. Design is controlled (matched pipeline, held-out split reserved from optimization, per-target deltas vs. no-training baselines) but limited by one seed per target-condition, 10 forget targets, some cells with N=1-2 learned runs, incomplete 7B coverage, and no significance testing; medians/IQRs summarize target heterogeneity rather than seed variance, which the authors themselves acknowledge. Evidence is well supported by detailed appendix grids and qualitative examples, with appropriately hedged claims (e.g., policy-support mechanism stated as hypothesis). Generalizability is constrained to one model family, one benchmark, LoRA-GRPO; authors note judge dependence and temperature-zero decoding limits. Reproducibility is excellent: code repo, W&B report, HF checkpoints/datasets, full hyperparameters and judge prompts. Overall a solid, transparent empirical study rather than a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: An Empirical Study of Reward Specification and Benchmark Reliability in GRPO-based LLM Unlearning

papers.summary: Practical LLM unlearning is usually evaluated through two objectives: suppress target-specific knowledge and preserve non-target utility. In generative QA, this leaves a third behavior underspecified: when a target-adjacent prompt admits a broader answer without target-specific leakage, the model should answer at that level rather than leak, evade, or refuse. We study this specification problem in a controlled LoRA-GRPO RWKU setting, comparing four reward designs that span lexical suppression, a
papers.summary_zh: 實用的 LLM 遺忘通常以「抑制目標知識」與「保留非目標效用」兩目標評估，但未指明當提示允許更廣泛回答時模型該如何回應。本文在受控的 LoRA-GRPO RWKU 設定中比較四種獎勵設計：詞彙抑制 R0-Lex、反拒絕塑形 R1-AntiRefusal、以 LLM 評審促進廣泛主題回答的 R2-Rubric，以及對比診斷用的 R4-Refusal，並搭配有無 SFT 熱身。結果顯示最佳化成功不等於行為上的遺忘：RWKU 遺忘分數可能對應拒絕崩塌、拒絕分類器遭駭或殘留洩漏等不同行為端點。小型模型在冷啟動時容易學成全面拒絕；3B 與 7B 冷啟動因策略支撐不足難以學習，熱身能開啟學習但最終端點仍由獎勵決定；R2-Rubric 在終端訓練軌跡審計中達到最高的廣泛主題有用性與最低洩漏。限制包括僅測行為層面、未證明參數刪除、模型規模有限且依賴 LLM 評審。本文的意義是主張可信的遺忘宣稱必須同時審計端點行為，而非僅看基準分數的改善。
papers.title: An Empirical Study of Reward Specification and Benchmark Reliability in GRPO-based LLM Unlearning
papers.title_zh: GRPO 式 LLM 遺忘中獎勵規格與基準可靠性的實證研究

links.title: Explicit State Elicitation Is Not Enough: A Controlled Audit of Memory-Policy Classification

evidence: Abstract: 'an isolated explicit state-output field does not significantly improve policy accuracy for Llama-3.3-70B and gives only a marginal, non-significant gain for GPT-OSS-120B'

Section 5 (Data): development set has '240 Use, 120 Update, 120 Ask, and 0 Ignore' and a supervised TF-IDF diagnostic reaching '89.6±3.5% policy accuracy under random folds' — motivating the controlled redesign

Section 7 (Results, Table 1): taxonomy-only arm improves accuracy on both endpoints (Llama +9.17 pp, Holm p=0.0012; GPT-OSS +5.00 pp, Holm p=0.0135) while state-output is null, with family-cluster bootstrap CIs and permutation tests
Appendix A: two annotators 'working separately and blind to the rule-derived reference policies' agreed with each other and the reference policy on all 160 examples, though labels remain rule-derived
Appendix S: execution ledger of 10,562 hosted calls at $1.8007 with seeds, temperature, parse-failure accounting, and resumable call IDs
Limitations: 'Both datasets are synthetic' and experiments 'evaluate policy classification only', excluding downstream responses, tool actions, and memory-store mutation
Section 7.1 / Appendix G: family exact-match is 0.0% for Llama and at most 5.0% for GPT-OSS, showing example-level accuracy overstates counterfactual consistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent methodology paper: audits whether explicit structured intermediate outputs (memory states) improve policy routing for personalized LLM agents, spanning high-weight preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, prompting, memory, evaluation/faithfulness). Strengths: unusually careful design — pre-frozen prompt arms, matched four-way counterfactual families, family-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests with Holm correction, leakage audits (TF-IDF), parse/provider failures counted as incorrect, and honest reframing of a prior 'positive' result as a dataset-shortcut artifact. Weaknesses: fully synthetic rule-derived data (160 examples), only 2 main endpoints plus a small third, no downstream task or naturalistic validation, internal (non-independent) annotation, and no public code/data release stated. Conclusions are appropriately narrow (a null/negative result) and well supported within scope, limiting generalizability but boosting credibility.

primary_link.title: Explicit State Elicitation Is Not Enough: A Controlled Audit of Memory-Policy Classification

papers.summary: Personalized agents must decide whether retrieved user memory should be used, ignored, updated, or queried before it affects a current task. We use this setting to develop an empirical audit protocol for structured intermediate outputs: first audit dataset shortcuts, then isolate bundled prompt changes, check whether intermediate labels are answer-associated, test decomposed semantic evidence, and audit provider-level execution failures. A 480-example synthetic development set initially suggeste
papers.summary_zh: 個人化代理取回使用者記憶後，必須決定該使用、忽略、更新或進一步詢問。本文以此為場景提出五階段審計協定：先審查資料集捷徑，再分離組合式提示變更，檢驗中間標籤是否與答案關聯，測試分解語意證據，並稽核供應商層級的執行失敗。480 例合成開發集最初顯示狀態結構化提示有大幅增益，但 TF-IDF 診斷顯示其具詞彙可分性且缺乏獨立的 Ignore 案例。作者據此凍結 160 例、含 40 個配對四向家族的反事實集合。在該集合上，要求輸出顯式狀態欄位對 Llama-3.3-70B 無顯著幫助，對 GPT-OSS-120B 僅邊際且不顯著；提供基準關聯的狀態標籤會移動預測，但因其與政策一一映射，這只是標籤條件化診斷而非機制證據；家族層級與種子穩定性分析顯示範例級準確率高估反事實一致性；分解語意證據引出甚至降低表現。限制包括資料皆為合成且僅評估政策分類。本文提醒通用的「狀態優先」提示配方缺乏依據，並提供可重用的審計框架。
papers.title: Explicit State Elicitation Is Not Enough: A Controlled Audit of Memory-Policy Classification

links.title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents

evidence: Abstract: dual parsed/native access improves OfficeQA Pass@1 by 8.3-12.1 points over artifact-only and APEX mean rubric score by 4.7-9.2 points over parsed-only; SW-Agent 63.9% OfficeQA (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and 42.1 APEX (GPT-5.4 Nano) vs published 29.3% and 25.5.
Section 3.4.3: nonparametric bootstrap with 10,000 resamples, seed 20260515, paired within-item resampling preserving arm covariance; three attempts per task for mechanism models.
Section 4.2: paired bootstrap p_boot=0.005 (GPT-5.4) for OfficeQA dual vs artifact-only; APEX dual vs artifact-only positive lifts but paired-bootstrap p values remain above 0.05 for all models.

Section 5 Limitations: 'the published comparison rows are not one-to-one, since they differ in attempt budget, agent harness, retrieval backend, and parser choice'; parser-sensitivity check shows parsed-only shifts <2pp across two Treasury exports; ablations do not separate the workspace contract from parser/retriever.
Table 3(c) / Section 4.2: review-axis ablation on 57 file-editing tasks (~12% of APEX) shows diffs-visible lifts of +2.5 to +8.5, described as a supporting mechanism.
Appendix D.3 Table A.7: 188/452 evaluated APEX tasks are all-arm zeros for at least one model triplet, showing state sync does not remove planning/domain-reasoning failures.

Appendix F Reproducibility: runs use public benchmark assets and graders; 'We plan to release a sanitized research implementation... but was not used for the reported production runs'; Reducto API credits disclosed in Acknowledgments.
Appendix B.1/B.2: sandbox spec (Daytona, 1 vCPU, 250-tool-call budget), tool routing by arm (Table A.1), and verbatim grader prompts for OfficeQA exact-match and APEX rubric grading.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent infrastructure work squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, RAG, and evaluation preferences: a versioned workspace layer (SW-Agent) that binds parsed search records, native files, and review diffs to content hashes for knowledge-work agents. The causal claims rest on fixed-harness three-arm read-axis ablations (dual/artifact-only/parsed-only) and a review-axis ablation, with paired bootstrap intervals, McNemar/sign discordance checks, and unusually honest reporting of non-significant contrasts (APEX dual vs artifact-only p>0.05) and large all-arm-zero residuals (188/452). Novelty is moderate: hash-based invalidation, dual views, and journaled diffs are known mechanisms recombined for non-code artifacts under a new 'workspace-state contract' framing. Evidence for the headline full-system gains is weaker because published-row comparisons are non-paired with different harnesses/budgets, acknowledged in Limitations; the review-axis result covers only 57 tasks (~12% of APEX) without intervals. Generalizability is constrained by one agent stack, one parser (Reducto), and two benchmarks, which the authors admit. Reproducibility is decent (public benchmarks, verbatim grader prompts, tool routing, 250-call budget, bootstrap seed 20260515) but code is only promised and was 'not used for the reported production runs.'

primary_link.title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents

papers.summary: AI agents increasingly perform knowledge work (i.e., produce and modify persistent digital artifacts such as code repositories, documents, spreadsheets, slides, reports), yet the parsed views they search, the native files they edit, the changes they review, and the artifacts they submit can refer to different versions of the same work product. We formulate this as a workspace-state contract: every view should be explicitly tied to a version of the evolving workspace state. Coding agents partly a
papers.summary_zh: 知識工作代理會搜尋解析視圖、編輯原生檔案、檢視變更並提交成品，若各環節對應不同版本，便會產生不一致的工作成果。本文提出工作區狀態契約：每個視圖都應明確綁定演變中工作區的某個版本，並實作 StagedWorkspace，包含同步的解析與原生雙視圖、以內容雜湊鍵控的快取失效與刷新，以及可審閱的分段變更日誌。作者在 OfficeQA Pro 與 APEX-Agents 上以固定測試框架進行消融：相對於單一受限視圖，雙視圖在 OfficeQA 提升 Pass@1 達 8.3 至 12.1 點、在 APEX 提升平均規格分數 4.7 至 9.2 點；SW-Agent 於 OfficeQA 以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 達 63.9%，於 APEX 以 GPT-5.4 Nano 達 42.1，遠高於同模型的公開成績 29.3% 與 25.5。57 個檔案編輯任務的配對消融亦顯示可見差異可提升分數 2.5 至 8.5 點。限制包括評分僅看最終結果、公開比較未配對，且 188 個 APEX 任務為全臂零分。本文將工作區狀態確立為知識工作代理的重要實驗變數。
papers.title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents
