links.title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'the selected seed reaches 98.48% safe success across 2,896 evaluation episodes spanning all 500 held-out tasks, compared with 64.36% for the base policy'
Sec. IV-A, Table II: excess-authority success 132 (4.56%) base vs 23 (0.79%) seed 1; task episode success 68.92% vs 99.27%
Sec. IV-A: 'we selected the most stable, Seed 1 using the routine 206 task evaluation set before running the complete 500-task and external evaluations' (selection before final eval)
Sec. IV-B: prompt ablation, seed 1 safe success 97.63% full prompt vs 97.39% one-line prompt; base falls 61.65% to 57.95%
Sec. IV-C, Table IV: MetaTool 81.9%->83.6% (p=4.55e-4); FORTIS T2 over-privilege 43.28%->40.72% on only 1,250/1,543 shared-parseable items (Sec. IV-C notes parse-validity asymmetry)
Sec. IV-D: 'Under the default ToolPrivBench prompt, the over-privilege rate is 45.2% for base and 45.0% for seed 1, and paired tests show no statistically different performance'
Sec. IV-E, Table V: 400-task continuation cuts ToolPrivBench over-privilege 45.04%->38.05% (p=3.7e-5) while 500-task safe success unchanged at ~98.5%

Sec. V Limitations: 'the study only uses one 4B model and one adapter family' and tasks are 'largely synthetically generated from structured families'; reward weights 'were selected manually, and not learned'
Sec. III-D: training details (rank-32 LoRA alpha 64, bfloat16, TRL 1.5.1, vLLM 0.22.1, 2x32GB GPUs, 3 seeds x 12,000 trajectories)
Acknowledgment: 'The majority of the repository's code and task authoring was synthetic, generated by the tools of Codex and Claude Code' - repository referenced but no link or release provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: Central to the preference profile: LLM tool-use/terminal/MCP agents, least-privilege agent safety, and RL post-training (Dr. GRPO + LoRA on a 4B LLM) hit Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, AI Safety, and RL preferences. The framework (six-dimensional authority vector, pre/post-execution broker audits, sufficient-authority envelopes, deterministic verifiers) is a meaningful but incremental delta over closest prior work ToolPrivBench, which the paper itself positions as contemporaneous privilege-aware post-training. Rigor is above average: three seeds, within-family and excluded-family holdouts, prompt ablation, checkpoint analysis, external benchmarks, and McNemar/bootstrap tests. However, the headline 64.36%->98.48% safe-success jump largely reflects general task success on self-authored synthetic tasks (excess-authority events only fall 4.56%->0.79%); the seed was selected on a 206-task routine set before final evaluation; reward weights were manually chosen and unablated; and FORTIS T2 is compared only on a shared-parseable subset where the base model left many items unparseable. Honest negative results (ToolPrivBench default-prompt parity at 45.2% vs 45.0%) and a candid limitations section support credibility. Generalizability is limited by one model, one adapter, and synthetic task families; reproduction is hampered by no repository/data link despite a code mention, though hyperparameters and the reward function are fully specified.

primary_link.title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents

Traditional permission gating systems alone for validating agent environments are insufficient. We study whether post-training can teach a 4B-parameter model to choose task-conditioned authority in executable terminal and Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments to complement those measures. We propose a framework where eac
papers.summary_zh: 工具使用代理可能在完成任務的同時，行使使用者未授予或任務不需要的權限，形成過度授權錯誤。本文提出任務條件化最小權限學習框架：每個動作在執行前後皆以六維風險向量（寫入、執行、外部、機密、範圍、持久）審計，並以決定性驗證器評分任務完成、證據、精確狀態、禁止嘗試與安全成功；再依預定義的充分授權包絡計算超額權限，於後訓練中最佳化。作者以 LoRA 搭配 Dr. GRPO 訓練 Qwen3.5-4B 於 1,500 個終端機與 MCP 任務。結果顯示：在 500 個保留任務、2,896 個評估回合中，安全成功率從基線的 64.36% 升至 98.48%，過度授權事件由 4.56% 降至 0.79%；外部測試（MetaTool、FORTIS、ToolPrivBench）顯示工具能力獲得保留甚至提升；提示消融證明行為已內化；400 任務延續訓練使 ToolPrivBench 過度權限再降 6.99 個百分點。限制包括任務多為合成、僅測一個 4B 模型，外部泛化亦不一致。此框架應作為權限閘門與沙盒的補充，而非替代。

links.title: CABLE: Extending the Reach of Memory Retrieval via Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion

evidence: Abstract: CABLE yields higher mean LLM-judge scores in every evaluated system-level setting; core implementation released at https://github.com/TanZheling/CABLE.
Section 4.2.1, Table 1: gains of +3.58 (Qwen3.5-27B) and +2.11 (DeepSeek-chat) on LoCoMo and +6.00 (Qwen3.5-27B) and +1.00 (GPT-4o-mini) on MA-LongMemEval.
Section 4.1.3/4.1.4: the same backbone serves as both pipeline and LLM-judge within each setting, with only mean judge scores reported and no human or lexical-metric cross-check.
Section 4.1.5: hyperparameters specified (Nq=3, Kb=Kh=15, expansion budget 5, tau=0.3, theta=0.9) plus per-system protocols in Appendix A.
Table 5 (Appendix C): removing overlap subtraction costs -0.91 (LoCoMo) / -0.67 (MA-LongMemEval); removing verification costs -2.66 on MA-LongMemEval; generic query decomposition -0.46 on LoCoMo.
Figure 3 (Section 4.2.2): temporal-reasoning drops of -1.33 and -2.67 on MA-LongMemEval are reported, indicating expansion can hurt precise temporal tasks.
Table 3 (Section 4.3): transfer beyond A-MEM shown via SimpleMem (+0.58, +1.62) and Mem0g (+2.20) on LoCoMo, though the SimpleMem gain is small.
Appendix F (Limitations): append-only graph with no forgetting/decay; evaluation limited to conversational QA, excluding tool use and multi-agent coordination.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent memory/retrieval work with strong preference fit (LLMs, agents, RAG, long-context memory). The retriever-complementarity principle and the overlap-subtraction-then-verify link construction are a genuine, if incremental, contribution over prior memory graphs (A-MEM, Mem0g, HippoRAG). Evaluation is reasonably controlled (fixed entry budgets, replacement not appending, three host systems, two benchmarks, three backbones) with component ablations and a concrete case study, and honestly reports negative results (temporal-reasoning drops, small SimpleMem gain of +0.58). Main weaknesses: sole reliance on LLM-as-judge where the judge is the same backbone as the pipeline (Section 4.1.3/4.1.4), no significance testing or seed variance, ablations confined to one model/benchmark pair, and modest effect sizes in several settings. Code release, specified hyperparameters, and integration protocols support reproducibility, though prompt bodies are not rendered in the document.

primary_link.title: CABLE: Extending the Reach of Memory Retrieval via Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion

papers.summary: As LLM agents operate across structured workflows and sessions, preserving long-term history does not ensure that later contexts can recover relevant evidence through a bounded memory interface. We study this evidence-reachability problem in long-term conversational memory, where retrieval still relies heavily on semantic similarity. This works well for topical recall, but it often misses earlier experiences, plans, or motivations that are semantically distant from the later events they help exp
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理的長期記憶檢索多依賴語意相似度，能處理主題式回憶，卻常漏掉與後續事件語意距離遙遠、卻能解釋其來龍去脈的早期記憶。本文提出 CABLE 外掛：在記憶寫入時，為新記憶生成前因導向查詢，同時檢索直接語意鄰域與前因候選，扣除重疊後由 LLM 驗證，再將接受的前因關聯存入稀疏有向圖；檢索時沿這些連結將種子記憶擴展一跳，進行候選評分與新穎性過濾，且不需額外 LLM 呼叫。實驗將 CABLE 整合入 A-MEM（於 LoCoMo 與 MA-LongMemEval）、SimpleMem 與 Mem0g，使用 Qwen3.5-27B、DeepSeek-chat 與 GPT-4o-mini。結果顯示所有系統層級設定均獲提升，增益介於 1.00 至 6.00 個百分點，其中開放領域、多工作階段與偏好類問題獲益最大，時間推理則略降。消融顯示重疊扣除與驗證步驟皆有貢獻。限制包括連結僅增不刪、圖形持續成長，且僅涵蓋對話式問答。本文確立「檢索器互補」作為記憶連結設計的重要原則。

links.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements

evidence: Abstract/Sec 1: claims ES gives model scalability, flexibility, and long-horizon scalability; Sudoku +12.50% over RL with Qwen3.5-4B
Sec 4, Table 1: at H*=15, Agentic ESOpt 53.13±2.55 vs GRPO 40.63±2.55 and PPO 0.00±0.00; GPU memory 8.41GB vs 58.88GB (GRPO)
Sec 4, Table 2: matched-compute wall-clock 9.4h vs 19.0h and 9.4 vs 10.9 EFLOPs at H*=15 on 4x H100
Sec 5.1, Table 3: Qwen3.5-4B Mean@4 DAPO 76.8 (ESOpt) vs 68.8 (GRPO); AIME 70.8 vs 58.3; DocVQA accuracy 52.5 vs 48.0
Sec 5.2, Table 4: Qwen3.5-27B WebArena-Lite 29.47→36.16 (+6.69); ESOpt+Trace2Skill 36.36 vs 33.94 baseline
Sec 6 + App D.5.2: 28 of 36 matched AHD comparisons improved, incl. Tables 14 (ACO) and 17 (t-test p=0.0258 TSP, p=0.0100 KP); some gains marginal (0.15-0.17%)
App D.2.2/D.3.2: GRPO baselines compress per-turn token budgets to fit 4x A100 memory, a potential disadvantage vs forward-only ESOpt
App A.1: acknowledged limitations - new sigma hyperparameters, unfavorable when environment evaluation is extremely expensive, continual-learning concerns
App D.6 Table 19 + Appendix E: cross-setting hyperparameter summary and full prompts; GitHub link and license table (App F) support reproducibility
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: proposes evolution strategies (ES) as a backprop-free alternative to agentic RL (GRPO/PPO) for long-horizon agent fine-tuning, with a controlled horizon-scaling study (Sudoku), tool-use fine-tuning (Math/DocVQA ReAct), a 27B WebArena web agent, and test-time heuristic-design co-evolution. Topic alignment with LLM, agents, reasoning, and training-efficiency preferences is very strong. Novelty is moderate: ES for LLM fine-tuning already exists (Qiu et al. 2026, ESSA/ESSAM cited in B.2); the contribution is an agentic extension, a cosine sigma-decay schedule, and prompt-parameter co-evolution, which are incremental. Rigor is solid but not airtight: matched-FLOPs accounting (App C.5), ablations (Table 1 vanilla/no-sigma_T; Table 15/16), t-tests (Table 17), and 3-run stds support claims; however eval sets are small (32 Sudoku instances, 30 AIME, 100 DocVQA questions), DocVQA GRPO training compressed token budgets (D.2.2, a possible baseline disadvantage), WebArena lacks an RL baseline (justified by memory), and the variance theory rests on acknowledged weak-correlation assumptions (C.3). Evidence is quantified but some AHD gains are marginal (0.15%-0.17% in Table 14) within the 28/36 count. Generalizability spans 4B-27B and five task families, but the key crossover claim is validated mainly in one controlled environment. Reproducibility is good: GitHub link, extensive hyperparameter tables (Table 19), prompts in Appendix E, and licensing details, though the repo contents cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements

papers.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been promising in single-turn LLM fine-tuning. However, long-horizon agentic reasoning introduces increasingly branching interactions and sparse rewards, exposing several limitations of RL: its heavyweight backpropagation-based training stack makes it impractical to fine-tune larger LLMs, and longer-horizon trajectories make credit assignment in RL substantially harder. This paper argues that evolution strategies (ES) can be a better choice for fine-tuning long-ho
papers.summary_zh: 強化學習在單輪 LLM 微調成效卓著，但長程代理推理帶來分支互動與稀疏獎勵，使反向傳播的記憶體成本高昂且功勞分配困難。本文主張演化策略（ES）更適合長程代理：只需推論等級的 GPU 記憶體即可進行全參數最佳化；黑箱軌跡回饋易與提示空間演化（如技能最佳化、測試時運算）組合；以軌跡層級參數歸因取代逐輪功勞分配。Agentic ESOpt 在每步對模型參數取樣擾動、以環境獎勵評估、並進行線上加權更新，同時以餘弦衰減調控擾動尺度 σ。實驗顯示：在最少成功步數為 15 的數獨上，Agentic ESOpt 以 53.13% 領先 GRPO 的 40.63%，而 PPO 在稀疏終端獎勵下崩潰；ReAct 式數學與 DocVQA 上較 4B 基線平均提升 13.7%、較 GRPO 提升 8.3%；在 WebArena-Lite 上對 Qwen3.5-27B 進行全參數微調，成績由 29.47% 升至 36.16%；測試時自動啟發式演算法設計於 36 個設定中 28 個勝出。限制包括新增超參數、昂貴環境評估下權衡改變與持續學習疑慮。此框架讓大型代理能在有限硬體上進行全參數調適。

links.title: Write, Execute, Refine: From Skill Followers to Skill Optimizers via Reinforcement Learning from Execution Feedback

evidence: Abstract: WER improves average Pass@1 by 7.80 (BFCL v4) and 3.85 (tau2-bench) over no-skill baseline; 4B optimizer reaches 76.63% on BFCL v4, beating all evaluated off-the-shelf optimizers
Section 4.2: untrained Qwen3-4B optimizer under identical workflow scores 67.28%/40.43% vs WER 76.63%/50.72% (BFCL/tau2), isolating the optimizer-training effect
Section 3.3, Eq. 4-6: reward combines format, programmatic verifier outcome, and length terms; group-relative GRPO update with no KL term or reference policy
Section 4.1 Evaluation Protocol: frozen GPT-4o executor for all training and evaluation; GPT-5.1 generates seed skills; GPT-5.5 merges domain skills - proprietary pipeline, merge step not ablated
Section 4.3: phase-wise BFCL averages improve monotonically 69.35 -> 71.29 -> 76.63; Section 4.4: depth-3 revision slightly lowers average to 75.33 (saturation)
Limitations: results limited to BFCL v4 and tau2-bench with programmatic verifiers; verbatim trajectory retention untested on long-horizon or multimodal tasks; no transfer to other executors
Appendix A.3: verl framework on 8x Ascend 910B, batch size 6, lr 1e-6 cosine, temp 0.95; inconsistency between n=2 rollouts (Section 3.4 retention rule) and 'four rollouts per prompt' (A.3)
Abstract/code link: code released at github.com/littlepkk/WER4skill-optimizer-training; prompt templates in Appendix C
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching top preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL/GRPO training). Novelty is moderate: training a skill-writer with RL while freezing the executor overlaps closely with Skill-R1/SkillMaster/SkillOS; the distinct contribution is the matched success/failure pair construction of next-phase refinement states (§3.4), a genuinely clever but incremental mechanism in a crowded space. Rigor is decent: formal operator definition, Algorithm 1, group-relative GRPO without KL (§3.3), a key ablation with an untrained Qwen3-4B optimizer under the fixed workflow (§4.2), phase-wise (§4.3) and depth (§4.4) analyses, plus a backbone comparison (Table 4). Weaknesses: small per-domain test sets (150 test instances for BFCL) with three-run averages but no variance or significance reporting; the GPT-5.5 skill-merge step in the evaluation pipeline is never ablated; rollout counts are ambiguous (n=2 in §3.4 vs 'four rollouts per prompt' in A.3); evaluation stays within the same benchmark distribution used for training. Evidence is consistent across two benchmarks with programmatic verifiers, and the limitations section honestly scopes claims to verifier-available settings, but no transfer to other executors or open-ended tasks is shown. Reproducibility is helped by released code, public benchmarks, and full hyperparameters, but depends on proprietary GPT-5.1/GPT-4o/GPT-5.5 APIs.

This gap suggests that following procedural guidance and improving it from execution evidence are distinct capabilities. Inference time loops can repair skills but do not improve the model that writes the next one. We study how to organize execution experience from intermediate skills into training states for an optimizer. We introduce WER (Write, Execute
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對工具使用型代理的一項能力落差:專家撰寫的自然語言技能能提升代理表現,但代理自行撰寫的技能反而比完全不使用技能低 8 至 11 個百分點,顯示「遵循程序性指引」與「從執行證據改良指引」是兩種不同能力,而推論時的修正迴圈雖能修補當下技能,卻無法讓撰寫下一份技能的模型進步。作者提出 WER 框架,在凍結的執行者之外訓練一個 Skill Optimizer:最佳化器針對任務提出多個技能修訂,由凍結代理反覆執行,再以程式化驗證器評分;分數除提供群組相對優勢並以 GRPO 更新外,也用於挑選成功與失敗軌跡成對混合的紀錄,重組為下一階段的修正狀態,形成階段式自我引導(self-bootstrapping),讓最佳化器從自己先前輸出的後果中學習。實驗上,WER 在 BFCL v4 多輪與 τ²-bench 分別將平均 Pass@1 較無技能基線提升 7.80 與 3.85 分;在相同修正流程下,較未訓練的同骨幹高出 9.35 與 10.29 分;訓練後的 4B 最佳化器在 BFCL v4 達 76.63%,平均勝過所有受評的現成通用模型。限制方面,研究僅涵蓋提供程式化驗證的兩個基準,尚未驗證對開放式評估、未見工具介面或不同執行者的遷移;逐字保留成對軌跡也使狀態隨互動變長而膨脹。此成果確立技能修正本身是可訓練的獨立能力,凍結執行者的設計更讓成效可歸因於技能文件本身,對代理經驗學習與強化學習訓練設計深具參考價值。

links.title: Deep Academic Survey: Stateful Agentic Closed-Loop Paradigm for Academic Survey Automation

evidence: Abstract: 'DAS achieves the highest average in all four dimensions, with an overall score of 4.34 compared with 4.03 for the strongest competitor'; Table 2 confirms DAS 4.34 vs Naive RAG 4.03 and Gemini DR 3.92 on DAS-Bench.

Table 3 (Ablation results on DAS-Bench): w/o Taxonomy scores 4.35 and w/o Hier. Draft 4.34, at or above Full DAS 4.34; the text concedes 'taxonomy planning and hierarchical drafting exhibit cross-dimensional trade-offs,' limiting the causal evidence for two claimed core mechanisms.
Table 4 (Repair policy ablation): Full DAS achieves 74.59% Review Pass Rate at 0.79M review tokens per survey vs 45-58% for single-action policies, supporting the adaptive-scope repair design.

Appendix E (LLM Judge Configuration): 'The main judge is Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8' — the same backbone used for DAS generation (Appendix C), creating a self-judging bias risk partially mitigated by the Kimi K2.6 cross-judge.

Appendix G (Cross-Judge Agreement): Qwen3.5 vs Kimi K2.6 yield Spearman ρ=0.507, MAE=0.630, with ranking DAS > Naive RAG > AutoSurvey preserved but fine-grained scores judge-sensitive, as the authors acknowledge.

Appendix G (Expert Recruitment and Results): three non-author blinded evaluators preferred DAS over Naive RAG on 27/30 topics and over AutoSurvey on 19/21, with Fleiss' κ=0.726 and complete per-topic rankings in Table A19.

Appendix B (Metadata Integrity Audit): 200-record structural audit passes 100% on schema checks but title lexical recovery is 97.5%; the 20-record semantic audit finds adjudicated errors (e.g., a misstated order-of-magnitude comparison in arXiv:2011.03522), honestly documenting extraction fallibility.

Appendix H (Limitations): authors state 'the moderate cross-judge correlation limits fine-grained conclusions,' the backbone sensitivity covers only five topics, and only nine benchmark topics are non-CS, bounding generalizability claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly preference-relevant LLM-agent systems paper: DAS is a stateful multi-agent orchestration framework (query planning, taxonomy planning, paper routing, claim/citation planning, scoped review-repair, deterministic validation) over a 2M-paper retrieval substrate, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: individual mechanisms (agentic retrieval, self-refinement, LLM-as-judge, citation grounding) are established; the contribution is the state-machine formulation with scoped repair and the reusable metadata lake, incrementally advancing AutoSurvey/LiRA/DeepSurvey-style systems. Evaluation is broad (30-topic benchmark, 16 rubric criteria, component ablations, repair-policy ablation, backbone sensitivity, blinded 3-expert ranking with κ=0.726) but has notable weaknesses: the primary judge (Qwen3.5-397B) is the same model family as the generation backbone (Appendix E), cross-judge correlation is only ρ=0.507, several ablations show no net total gain (w/o Taxonomy 4.35 vs Full 4.34), and deltas lack significance testing. Evidence for the headline claim (4.34 vs 4.03) is reasonably solid and honestly caveated, including self-reported metadata-extraction errors in the audit. Reproducibility claims (code, DAS-2M records, prompts, rubrics) are detailed but framed as a release plan, and the system requires a 397B-scale backbone and heavy offline processing.

papers.summary_zh: 學術綜述是掌握快速擴張文獻的關鍵入口,但產出過程需要深入的論文分析、連貫的知識組織、細緻的引用支持與可靠的原稿組裝;現有 Deep Research 與自動綜述生成系統僅處理部分環節,未能以共享且可修訂的狀態協調論文理解、文獻組織、證據導向撰寫與原稿驗證。作者提出 DAS,首個具狀態的代理閉迴路框架:先建置 DAS-2M,一個涵蓋約 200 萬篇論文、動態更新的中介資料湖,提供可重複使用的綜述導向論文表徵;接著透過以候選文獻為基礎的分類法規劃與反向論文對章節路由,將文獻指派至合適章節;再進行階層式主張與引用規劃及段落撰寫;語意審查僅重新啟用受影響的撰寫狀態進行修復,並輔以確定性驗證確保結構完整與可編譯,形成範圍限定的閉迴路。作者另建 DAS-Bench(30 個主題)與 DAS-Eval(4 個維度、16 項準則)。結果顯示 DAS 在四個維度平均皆居首,總分 4.34 高於最強對手 Naive RAG 的 4.03,且在 21 個 CS 主題子集保持相同排序;盲測專家評估在 30 個主題中的 27 個偏好 DAS 勝過 Naive RAG,於 21 個共同 CS 主題中的 19 個勝過 AutoSurvey;消融實驗顯示反向路由與語意審查帶來最穩定的增益。限制包括文獻快照僅涵蓋 2020 至 2026 年 arXiv 論文、中介資料擷取可能遺漏或誤述細節、系統依賴大型生成模型、跨評審相關性中等,且生成綜述仍屬草稿,投稿前需領域專家查核。此工作確立以狀態管理與修復機制規模化產出可靠學術綜述的基礎,對科學寫作自動化具重要意義。

links.title: ArborMem: Navigating Interaction States with Memory Forests

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: ArborMem represents a long-running conversation as a navigable forest of interaction states; localizes the relevant state, restores branch-local context, and augments with cross-branch evidence
Table 1 (Main Results): ArborMem best on all four benchmarks—68.40 LongMemEval, 53.15 LoCoMo, 49.75 BEAM 100K, 81.00 BranchMemEval; gains of 9.00, 10.31, 3.36, 5.00 points over strongest baselines

Read-Budget Analysis / Table 2: on a fixed 50-question LongMemEval subset across 256-32K token budgets, ArborMem best at six of eight budgets and ties at 32K; exceeds strongest competitor by 16-26 points at 256-1K budgets

Table 4 (Component Ablations): removing state localization drops accuracy from 82.0% to 70.0% (Qwen3-30B) and 48.0% to 46.0% (Qwen3-4B) on the 50-question subset; all component ablations reduce accuracy
Table 3 (Efficiency): ArborMem 1.363 s/turn ingestion vs Mem0 1.543 and A-MEM 3.091; full query latency 0.451 s; throughput 10.45 q/h vs 9.39 and 4.69
Appendix A Table 5: reference settings include τ=8.0 new-root threshold, 16,384-token branch budget, up to 10 atomic facts with min similarity 0.4
Appendix B: BranchMemEval contains 33 sessions, 100 in-dialogue questions, 1,442 non-question interactions across five diagnostic dimensions (B1-B5) with rule-based normalized scoring
Discussion: acknowledges routing errors may propagate into subsequent memory updates and that ambiguous/multi-intent turns may correspond to multiple states
Appendix C Table 9: shared settings—Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 answer/memory model, BGE-M3 embeddings, BGE-Reranker-v2-M3, ~32K answer-time evidence budget; compute on eight NVIDIA A800s
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper on long-term conversational memory for LLM agents, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, RAG/knowledge, long context & memory). Core contribution—localizing which prior interaction trajectory a turn resumes before evidence selection, via a single-parent memory forest plus a separate reusable evidence store—is a distinct but incremental advance over prior conversation disentanglement (Kummerfeld et al. 2019; Yu & Joty 2020) and hierarchical/tree memory systems (MemTree, A-MEM). Experiments are reasonably rigorous: four benchmarks (LongMemEval 500 questions, LoCoMo C1-4 1,540 questions, BEAM 100K 400 questions, BranchMemEval 100 questions), eight shared-model shared-budget baselines, an eight-level read-budget sweep, matched efficiency comparison, and two-model component ablations; Table 2 internal numbers are consistent with the 'best at six of eight budgets, tie at 32K' claim. Weaknesses: read-budget and ablation analyses use only a 50-question subset (differences of 2-6 points equal 1-3 questions), no significance testing, some baseline results look under-tuned (LiCoMemory 26.40 on LongMemEval in Table 1), and BranchMemEval is small (33 sessions) and planner-generated. Extensive implementation appendices (hyperparameters, τ=8.0 threshold, prompts verbatim) aid reproduction, but no explicit code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: ArborMem: Navigating Interaction States with Memory Forests

papers.summary: Large language models increasingly serve as persistent conversational assistants, requiring memory that preserves relevant experience and maintains continuity across interactions. Existing methods improve access to conversational history through long-context processing, selective retrieval, and structured memory organization. However, most systems treat memory access as retrieving relevant past information without first determining which prior interaction state the current turn resumes. This lim
papers.summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型成為長期對話助理，如何保存並延續跨輪次的互動脈絡成為關鍵課題。現有記憶系統多以語意相關性擷取歷史資訊，卻往往忽略一個前提：先判斷當前輸入究竟要接續哪一個先前的互動狀態。當對話交錯多項任務、人物與計畫時，語意相近但結構不同的軌跡極易被混淆。本文提出 ArborMem，一個線上記憶框架，將長期對話表示為可導覽的互動狀態森林：每個分支保存局部連貫的軌跡，整座森林維持多條可日後恢復的軌跡。對每筆新輸入，系統先進行狀態定位，還原分支局部脈絡，再補充跨分支擷取的可重用證據，並於生成後提交記憶更新，維持讀取與寫入的因果邊界。作者另提出 BranchMemEval 診斷基準，涵蓋軌跡回跳、狀態更新、助理產出物、跨分支橋接與平行雙線五項能力。實驗以 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 為答題模型，ArborMem 在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、BEAM 100K 上領先最強基線 3.36 至 10.31 個百分點，在 BranchMemEval 上領先 5.0 分；受限讀取預算下優勢更明顯，完整查詢延遲低於半秒。消融實驗顯示狀態定位與原子事實擷取貢獻最大。限制方面，系統仰賴可靠的擷取與摘要，路由錯誤可能向後傳播，單親樹結構也難以處理多重意圖輸入。本研究確立互動狀態定位作為可靠長期記憶的基礎。
papers.title: ArborMem: Navigating Interaction States with Memory Forests
papers.title_zh: ArborMem：以記憶森林導覽互動狀態

links.title: What Makes Software Issue Resolution Tasks Difficult for Agents?

evidence: Section 4.1 / Table 6: XGBoost on any_success achieves AUC=0.863, MCC=0.549, Brier=0.129 on held-out test; 10-fold CV AUC 0.851±0.009 confirms stability.
Section 4.2 / Table 7: Patch+Repo ablation reaches AUC=0.861 and R2=0.401 vs full 54-feature model AUC=0.863 / R2=0.406; prompt-only AUC=0.599 (near chance).
Section 3.1: study uses 45,769 tasks from SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench across 1,553 repositories with trajectories from Qwen3-Coder-480B in OpenHands v0.52.1; R2E-Gym tasks excluded.

Section 3.4.2: split is at task level (36,615 train / 9,154 test); no repository-grouped split is reported despite repository features ranking 4th by SHAP (Section 4.3.1), a leakage risk not addressed.
Section 4.3.2 / Finding 3: prompt features appear in top-5 SHAP contributors for 70.3% (404/575) of mid-band tasks vs 6.8% (60/886) of hard tasks, with median contribution ratio R=0.404.

Section 6.1-6.2: authors acknowledge Qwen3-Coder pretraining contamination of public repos, temperature-induced stochasticity, single model/scaffold, and Python-centric sample limiting external validity.
Section 8: 'The replication package is available here'; Section 3.2-3.3: features are fully deterministic with VIF-filtered 54-feature set and reported hyperparameters (Section 3.4.3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly aligned with top-weighted preferences (coding agents, agent benchmark evaluation, LLM-based agents, SHAP interpretability): the paper studies what makes issue-resolution tasks hard for an LLM coding agent (Qwen3-Coder-480B in OpenHands) at scale. Novelty is moderate: static-feature difficulty prediction extends IRT-style work (Ge et al.) and JIT defect-prediction constructs, with the mid-band 'layered difficulty' finding as the freshest contribution. Rigor is solid but not airtight: nested hyperparameter tuning, 10-fold CV stability, group ablations, calibration diagrams, and a candid threats-to-validity section (Sections 6.1-6.3) are strengths, but the 80/20 split is at task level (Section 3.4.2) while repository features (e.g., repo_top_level_dir_count) rank among top predictors, leaving possible repository-level train/test leakage unexamined, and no significance testing on the 0.861 vs 0.863 AUC gap. Evidence is strong within the studied setting (AUC=0.863, MCC=0.549, R2=0.408; detailed ablation Table 7; quantified mid-band SHAP analysis 404/575). Generalizability is explicitly limited to one agent/scaffold and Python-centric repositories, which the authors themselves flag. Deterministic features, open dataset, and a stated replication package (Section 8) support reproducibility, though trajectory regeneration depends on a proprietary-scale model.

primary_link.title: What Makes Software Issue Resolution Tasks Difficult for Agents?

papers.summary: Background. Advances in agentic systems are simultaneously, and rapidly, saturating benchmarks. Despite this often discussed phenomena, benchmark scores remain difficult to interpret due to the lack of control and characterization of task difficulty. More specifically, we currently have little understanding of what makes one task harder than another, and to what extent task difficulty is predictable from static task properties. Aims. We propose a measurement framework to investigate and systemat
papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理（coding agent）在軟體議題解決基準上的整體解題率快速攀升，但聚合分數無法說明任務為何困難，也難以預判哪些任務容易失敗。本文以迄今最大的開放代理軌跡資料集 CoderForge-Preview 為基礎，涵蓋 45,769 個任務、1,553 個儲存庫，軌跡由 Qwen3-Coder-480B 在 OpenHands 腳手架下產生，系統性量化任務靜態結構屬性與代理成功率的關係。作者從三個面向工程化共 63 項特徵：黃金修補（patch）的編輯量、碎片化與空間分布；儲存庫的規模、目錄結構、命名歧異與測試基礎設施；以及議題提示詞（prompt）的句法複雜度、三類歧異與連貫性等語言學特徵。結果顯示靜態特徵可良好預測代理成敗：XGBoost 達 AUC=0.863、MCC=0.549，並解釋 41% 的通過率變異。特徵群組消融指出，修補碎片化與儲存庫規模幾乎解釋全部可預測變異（AUC=0.861），僅用提示詞特徵則接近隨機；但在預測機率接近平均的中段任務中，70.3% 的任務至少有一項提示詞特徵擠進前五大 SHAP 貢獻者，呈現分層的困難度結構。研究限制包括僅評估單一模型與腳手架、樣本以 Python 為主，且提示詞特徵僅捕捉歧異的必要條件。此框架全為確定性計算、無需模型推論，可支援基準稽核、難度分層評估，並協助開發者校準對代理工具的信任。
papers.title: What Makes Software Issue Resolution Tasks Difficult for Agents?
papers.title_zh: 是什麼讓軟體議題解決任務對代理而言困難？

links.title: Leveraging Association Context Retrieval in Knowledge Edit- ing to Build White-Box Attacks on LLMs

evidence: Abstract: proposes a novel white-box attack inspired by locate-then-edit knowledge editing, claiming improved attack effectiveness across architectures without critical damage to general performance
Section 2: prior KE-attack work (Chen et al. 2025; Li et al. 2024b) uses backdoor trigger words placed before every prompt, motivating the trigger-free alternative

Section 4: subject extraction uses regular expressions on the first preposition and three manually defined structural categories with fixed target objects ('Sure! The plan is:' etc.), classified via LLM-as-a-judge
Section 5.3/5.4: Harmfulness scored by DeepSeek V3.2 judge (0-4 scale, few-shot calibrated) and WildGuard; Locality via judge plus 5-shot MMLU and 25-shot ARC-C; greedy decoding; 3 seed repetitions

Table 1 (Section 6): MEMIT+pref on Llama-3-8B reaches Harm 3.19±0.17 vs Refusal 2.72±0.14 with MMLU change -0.05±0.21; on GPT4ALL-J Heretic is strongest on Harmfulness (3.20) but worst on locality/MMLU drop (-1.35)
Table 2 (Section 7.2): alpha ablation shows refusal-direction shifts trade harmfulness against broken outputs (post_score=0 fraction rises with alpha, e.g., 0.67 at alpha=2.0 on Llama-3-8B)
Appendix D/Table 3: prefix-length ablation shows random prefixes trade Harmfulness vs Generalization while subject-conditioned prefixes are length-insensitive
Section 9 (Limitations): only three open-weight models (2022-2025), and not all locate-then-edit baselines (GLAME/PMET/BIRD) tested with the prefix modification
Appendix C: code and hyperparameters 'accessible via link' (placeholder in text); KL-weight 0.0625; single NVIDIA H200, ~4h compute plus ~4h judge API per run
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety research (white-box alignment removal via knowledge editing), strongly matching LLM, AI Safety, Alignment, and Red Teaming preferences; well outside the excluded out-of-scope areas. Novelty is moderate: KE-for-attack exists (BadEdit-style backdoors per Section 2), and the main new pieces are trigger-free subject extraction plus a fairly incremental 'association context retrieval' prefix enrichment of k*. Rigor is solid—multiple editors (ROME/MEMIT/MoEEdit/MoTE), refusal baselines (Arditi, RDO, Heretic), dual judges (DeepSeek V3.2 LLM-as-judge and WildGuard), MMLU/ARC-C locality, 3 seeds with stds, alpha and prefix-length ablations (Sections 5, 6, 7, App. D)—but weakened by regex-based subject extraction, manually chosen target objects, and no human validation of the judge. Evidence supports main claims: e.g., MEMIT+pref on Llama-3-8B achieves Harm 3.19 vs Refusal 2.72 with ~0 MMLU drop (Table 1); however, gains over Heretic on GPT4ALL-J are not uniform and generalization deltas are modest (2.38/2.54 vs 2.33). Generalizability is decent across GPT/Llama/MoE architectures but limited to English prompts and white-box access; reproducibility is hampered by a placeholder code link despite detailed hyperparameters and judge prompts.

primary_link.title: Leveraging Association Context Retrieval in Knowledge Edit- ing to Build White-Box Attacks on LLMs

papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are granted increasing autonomy, it is essential to investigate methods that can induce unsafe behavior. We propose a novel white-box attack inspired by locate-then-edit approaches from the field of Knowledge Editing. Our choice is motivated by the observation that models edited with such schemes tend to assign unusually high prediction probabilities to the edit target, a property that is particularly advantageous when designing attacks. We modify the editing fram
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討如何透過知識編輯（Knowledge Editing）技術對已對齊的大型語言模型進行白箱攻擊。不同於先前利用後門（backdoor）詞彙或拒絕方向（refusal direction）正交化的方法，作者提出一種類別層級的攻擊：將移除對齊視為對行為關聯的知識編輯問題，讓模型面對任何有害提示時傾向以順從的開場語（如「Sure! Here it is:」）作答。方法核心包含三個步驟：首先以修改後的因果追蹤程序從有害提示中自動擷取指令片段作為主體 s；其次重新詮釋 locate-then-edit 框架中鍵向量 k* 的計算，將其視為關聯檢索問題，讓模型從預定義範本產生富含主題知識的前綴，使 k* 捕捉主體在關聯脈絡下的分布而非單一表面出現；最後套用 ROME、MEMIT（密集模型）或 MoEEdit、MoTE（混合專家模型）求解值向量 v* 並寫入權重。實驗在 GPT4ALL-J、Llama-3-8B 與 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上進行，以有害性、局部性與泛化性三項指標評估。結果顯示此方法在有害性上超越拒絕方向基線，同時對 MMLU 與 ARC-C 等通用能力損害更小，且能泛化至同結構與同語義類別的未見提示。侷限包括未涵蓋 2026 年最新模型、部分編輯基線未搭配前綴修改，且攻擊依賴模型權重的直接存取。此研究的價值在於揭露 locate-then-edit 機制可能成為比拒絕方向抑制更隱蔽的對齊移除途徑，為發展更穩健的防禦與編輯偵測技術提供重要參考。
papers.title: Leveraging Association Context Retrieval in Knowledge Edit- ing to Build White-Box Attacks on LLMs
papers.title_zh: 運用關聯脈絡檢索於知識編輯以建構大型語言模型的白箱攻擊

links.title: GUPO: Gradient Uncertainty-aware Policy Optimization for Post-Training Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: GUPO models each group gradient as a random variable under a Bayesian formulation, derives Dirichlet-based uncertainty, and calibrates each group gradient's contribution during aggregation.
Empirical Analysis (Fig. 2c-d): among 563 group-gradient pairs, 262 (46.5%) have negative cosine similarity; high-conflict mini-batches show lower median validation ΔNLL with negative updates.

Table 1: Pass@1 averages GUPO 63.4 (+3.1) on DeepScaleR-1.5B, 55.4 (+4.1) on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, 71.4 (+2.8) on 7B across GSM8K/MATH500/MinervaMATH/AMC/AIME24/AIME25, best of seven baselines per model.
Experimental Settings / Implementation Details: learning rate 1e-6, weight decay 0.01, global batch size 256, NVIDIA H100 cluster; three base models at 1.5B/7B scales.

Methodology (Bayesian-based Group Gradient Distribution): posterior only over the final trainable layer Φ⊆θ, diagonal empirical Fisher H~=Diag(F)+δI, Monte Carlo sampling of M parameter draws; no wall-clock overhead reported in main text.
Ablation Study about Parameter Sensitivity (Fig. 6): grid over s in [0.01,0.9] and η in [0,0.5]; best at s=0.5, η=0.1; no ablation comparing Dirichlet evidence mapping to direct precision weighting.
Related Work: differentiates from DaGRPO (within-rollout-group conflicts), PCR (plasticity/stability), ResRL (positive/negative gradients), SEED-GRPO and CAPO (advantage-level uncertainty).
Missing: no seed/variance/significance reporting in Table 1, no explicit limitations section, and no code-availability statement in the provided text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: improves GRPO post-training for reasoning by reweighting query-level group gradients via Dirichlet/evidential uncertainty, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, RLHF/alignment). The angle—cross-query gradient conflicts within a GRPO mini-batch—is a plausible delta over DaGRPO/PCR/ResRL (within-group, plasticity-stability, positive-negative conflicts) and SEED-GRPO/CAPO (advantage-level uncertainty), but the machinery adapts known evidential-deep-learning tools to gradient aggregation, so novelty is moderate. Rigor is solid: a controlled empirical conflict analysis (563 pairs, 46.5% negative cosine similarity tied to lower validation ΔNLL), three base models × six math benchmarks against seven re-run baselines, and sensitivity sweeps over s and η; however, single-run results without seeds/error bars/significance, a correlational (not causal) conflict-update link, no wall-clock/compute overhead accounting for the M-sample Monte Carlo estimation, and no ablation of the Dirichlet evidence mapping versus simple precision-weighted aggregation weaken the case. Evidence strength is limited by absence of variance reporting and appendix-only details. Generalizability is constrained: only math reasoning (GSM8K–AIME), only ~1.5B/7B Qwen-family distills; the aggregation mechanism is architecturally general but untested on code, general RLHF, or non-verifiable rewards. Reproducibility is partial: public benchmarks/models and key hyperparameters (lr 1e-6, batch 256, s=0.5, η=0.1) are given, pseudo-code is in the appendix, but no code release is stated and M, prior/likelihood specifics, and training prompt data are deferred to the appendix.

primary_link.title: GUPO: Gradient Uncertainty-aware Policy Optimization for Post-Training Large Language Models

papers.summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a widely used approach for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning. In GRPO, the group gradients induced by different queries within the same mini-batch are directly averaged to form the policy update. However, these group gradients can point in conflicting directions. Our empirical analysis suggests that group-gradient conflicts tend to be associated with less effective policy updates, motivating the need for a reliable aggre
papers.summary_zh: 本論文針對群組相對策略最佳化（GRPO）後訓練中的一個關鍵問題：同一小批次內不同查詢所誘導的群組梯度可能方向衝突，而標準 GRPO 直接平均這些梯度，未考量其可靠度差異。作者透過實證分析發現，在 563 個群組梯度對中有 46.5% 呈現餘弦相似度為負的方向衝突，且衝突嚴重的小批次往往伴隨較低的驗證集更新效益。為此，論文提出梯度不確定性感知策略最佳化（GUPO）：在貝葉斯架構下，先對策略模型最後一層可訓練參數建構高斯近似後驗（以對角經驗 Fisher 資訊近似），再以蒙地卡羅取樣估計各群組梯度的機率分布；接著將梯度精確度映射為證據，並遵循主觀邏輯以 Dirichlet 式框架推導逐維信念與群組層級不確定性，最後用該不確定性校準梯度聚合，賦予低不確定性群組梯度更大權重、衰減高不確定性者的影響。實驗在 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 與 7B 三個基礎模型上，於 AIME、AMC、MATH500、MinervaMATH、GSM8K 等數學推理基準進行，GUPO 相較 GRPO 及多種後訓練基線（如 Dr.GRPO、GCPO、MRT）皆取得一致提升，平均最高增益達 4.1 個百分點，且在高衝突小批次上效益最為顯著。限制方面，方法僅針對最後一層參數建構分布，且參數 s 與 η 需經敏感度調校。此研究凸顯顯式建模梯度不確定性對強化學習後訓練穩定性的價值。

links.title: VisDocAgentBench: Benchmarking Agents for Visually Rich Document Retrieval

evidence: Section 1/Abstract: benchmark of 2,375 pages from 100 documents with 120 unique-target queries balanced across direct, one-bridge, two-bridge structures
Section 6.1/Table 12 (App. E.1): Nemotron ColEmbed visual R@1 is 97.50% on L1 but 2.50% on L3; agents range 19.17%-67.50% visual R@1 under identical tools
Section 6.2/Table 4: removing page inspection lowers GPT-5.6-sol R@1 by 15.84 (visual) and 21.67 (OCR-text) points; removing iterative search by 8.34/9.17
Section 6.3/Table 5: support-provided initialization improves all L2/L3 metrics, e.g., visual L3 R@10 +22.50 points
Section 4.4/App. C.1: one author and one AI reviewer independently score paths on 0-100 with a dual >=60 gate; no agreement statistics reported
Limitations: English-only scientific papers, fixed corpus, 120 queries, only 6 cross-document paths limiting that analysis
Appendix H/Table 18: open-weight Qwen3.5 deployment details and runtimes; App. G covers licensing and redistribution rules; project page URL given
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope benchmark for agentic visual-document retrieval: LLM planners (GPT-5.x, Claude, Qwen3.5) with tool use perform iterative search over a closed corpus, directly matching the Agents/Tool-Use, LLM, RAG, and Evaluation preferences, though the visual-document surface gives it a substantial multimodal/CV flavor. Novelty is moderate: agentic search and visual-document retrieval benchmarks exist (MMDocIR, Mind2Web 2, MM-BrowseComp cited), and the contribution is the intersection plus a relation-preserving L1/L2/L3 evidence-path construction with hard-negative validation rather than a new method. Rigor is good but bounded: careful QC pipeline, static vs. agentic comparison under a shared contract, four ablations and a support-context intervention; however only 120 unique-target queries (40/level), a single ablation model, one author plus one AI reviewer for path scoring with no inter-annotator statistics, and no significance testing. Evidence claims are internally consistent with the reported tables (e.g., 97.50% L1 vs 2.50% L3 R@1 for the late-interaction retriever; 15.84-21.67 point drops without page inspection), but many level-wise deltas rest on 40-query subsets. Generalizability is limited by design to English 2026 arXiv pages with only 6 cross-document items, as the Limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is aided by detailed appendices (tool schemas, prompts, runtimes, licensing, project page) though key construction and evaluation rely on closed-source models.

primary_link.title: VisDocAgentBench: Benchmarking Agents for Visually Rich Document Retrieval

papers.summary: Visually rich documents encode relevance through language, layout, structured visual elements, and corpus context, yet retrieval is typically evaluated by one-shot query--page matching. Agentic-search benchmarks usually score downstream question answering or report generation, leaving document ranking under iterative evidence acquisition underexplored. We introduce VisDocAgentBench, a closed-corpus benchmark comparing static and agentic retrieval under a shared ranked-output contract. It contain
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 VisDocAgentBench，一個以封閉語料庫評估視覺豐富文件檢索的基準，同時比較靜態檢索器與使用工具的代理式搜尋。語料庫包含 100 篇 2026 年 arXiv 論文的 2,375 頁影像，並設計 120 個唯一目標查詢，均衡分布於直接（L1）、一橋（L2）與兩橋（L3）三種證據結構。建構流程採角色專屬描述子與有向關係、關係保留路徑組合、全文審查、受限查詢撰寫與困難負例驗證，以確保查詢的語義、關係與視覺條件皆有語料脈絡支撐。主要發現有三：其一，強大的 late-interaction 視覺檢索器在直接項目上達 97.50% Recall@1，但在兩橋項目僅剩 2.50%，顯示當相關性仰賴分散於語料的脈絡時，查詢與目標匹配的強度無法解決問題。其二，代理式互動能大幅彌補此差距，但規劃器（planner）的選擇至關重要——Claude Opus 5 在視覺與 OCR 兩條路徑皆取得最高 R@1（67.50% 與 37.50%），而所有規劃器使用視覺檢索均優於 OCR 文字檢索。其三，消融實驗顯示迭代搜尋與頁面檢視為關鍵能力，提供完整支援脈絡則能進一步提升排序；軌跡分析將剩餘失敗定位於目標發現、候選檢視與證據角色整合。限制包括僅涵蓋英文科學論文、查詢數量較小，且跨文件路徑比例偏低。此基準為視覺文件檢索代理的研究提供了嚴謹且可稽核的評估框架。
papers.title: VisDocAgentBench: Benchmarking Agents for Visually Rich Document Retrieval
papers.title_zh: VisDocAgentBench：視覺豐富文件檢索代理的基準測試

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety research: multi-agent RL debate training to curb reward hacking in RLAIF with a frozen weaker LLM judge, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, alignment/RLHF, AI safety, LLM-as-judge, reasoning). Novelty is solid but incremental over Irving et al. debate and concurrent RL-debate work (Wells et al.), differentiated by unsaturated tasks and full-parameter training on capable models (Section 2). Rigor is strong: four protocol variants, multi-seed runs pooled with a Bayesian peak comparison (Appendix A), ablations over judge strength, word limits, prompted misalignment, ground-truth critic training, and honest negative results (Section 4.4, Appendix E). Evidence is quantified (Table 1: peak acc 0.7474 vs 0.7263, RLVR 0.7730, ~45% gap recovered, P(best)=0.9987) with detailed qualitative case studies, but everything runs on proprietary models, a proprietary AIME-like dataset, and a proprietary RL algorithm, and the authors concede the P(best) statistic is overconfident due to within-question correlation (Appendix A.3) and debate runs with different word limits are pooled (A.1). Generalizability is limited to verifiable math with verifiable ground truth for evaluation only; the paper itself flags that subjective/fuzzy domains may behave differently and that word limits restricting the critic are a required crutch (Section 5.2). Reproducibility is poor despite full prompts in Appendix G, since the policy, judge, data, and trainer are closed.

primary_link.title: Debate Training Reduces Reward Hacking in RLAIF

papers.summary: We demonstrate that RL finetuning an LLM using debate, a two-player adversarial game between a generator and a critic adjudicated by a weaker LLM judge, reduces reward hacking compared to a reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) baseline. Reward hacking is a central obstacle in RLAIF: as training progresses, the policy learns to exploit systematic errors in its AI judge, degrading task performance, a problem that worsens precisely when the judge is weaker than the policy, the setting mo
papers.summary_zh: 本論文實證展示，在強化學習自 AI 回饋（RLAIF）中以辯論（debate）方式微調大型語言模型，能顯著減少獎勵駭取（reward hacking）問題。獎勵駭取指策略學會利用 AI 評審的系統性錯誤：在單人基線中，模型發展出冒充評審、權威式語言等操弄行為，使獎勵上升但答案正確率與評審 MCC 持續下滑。作者以 Gemini 2.5 Flash 等級的策略模型搭配較弱的 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 凍結評審，在數學推理任務上比較單人基線（RLAIF-A）、雙人辯論（Debate-AB，含批評者）與含反駁的辯論（ABA），並以可驗證獎勵（RLVR）作為效能天花板。結果顯示辯論能在整個訓練過程維持評審 MCC 穩定，峰值驗證正確率高出基線約 2 個百分點，回收約 45% 與 RLVR 天花板的差距，且此優勢持續多個 RL 步驟。額外實驗發現：進一步弱化評審會加速駭取，但可透過增加一輪辯論補償；RL 誘因能壓過提示的錯位指令；使用 LLM 評審的訓練與驗證獎勵差距小於 RLVR；以真值標籤學習說服評審雖可行但進展緩慢。關鍵平衡機制是對批評施加 150 字以內的字數限制，否則冗長的批評者會利用評審的冗長偏好而支配賽局。限制包括僅在可驗證的數學任務上評估、機制理解有限，以及字數限制會犧牲批評的表達細膩度。此研究為辯論作為可擴展監督（scalable oversight）訓練協定的可行性提供了重要的正面證據。
papers.title: Debate Training Reduces Reward Hacking in RLAIF
papers.title_zh: 辯論訓練可減少 RLAIF 中的獎勵駭取

links.title: GraphWake: Group Polarization via Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade in LLM-Agent Communities

evidence: Results and Analysis - Overall Performance: 'GraphWake increases both polarization measures in 44 of the 48 case while targeting only 10% of the agents'; mean P increases from 0.098 to 0.146 and mean ER from 0.130 to 0.213.

Table 1 (Experiments): per-proposition ER and P with mean±std across LangMem, Mem0, A-MEM and Qwen3.5-Flash/DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbones, e.g., Mem0/Qwen3.5-Flash C2 ER 0.227±0.039 baseline vs 0.463±0.041 attack.
Table 3 (Can target agents stably reproduced axioms?): mean LPR rises from 0.382 (original arguments) to 0.847 (optimized axioms), e.g., LangMem optimized 1.000→0.669 over rounds 1-5.
Table 4 (Ablation Study): removing Memory Cueing causes the largest drop (C1 ER 0.155→0.063, P 0.132→0.058), followed by removing the stance-support KG.

Table 2 (Blocking Cascade Propagation): text claims 'both ER and P remain close to the baseline', but E2 no-spillover P is 0.155±0.022 vs baseline 0.124±0.023 (n=8), a ~25% increase that is not close.

Experiment Setup - Evaluation Model: stance scores computed by a Qwen3-8B G-EVAL evaluator; 'we additionally conduct a manual second check of the random evaluator outputs' with no agreement statistics reported.
Appendix C Defense Robustness: perplexity filtering yields ΔP of only -0.012 to -0.082, while paraphrasing defenses reduce ΔP by -0.092 to -0.101 across three paraphrasing LLMs.

Limitations and Ethical Scope: 'our evaluation is restricted to open-ended propositions without a factual ground truth' and 'generalization to heterogeneous platforms remains uncertain' since each simulated community uses a homogeneous configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent safety paper: formulates a new community-level red-team threat (memory-mediated polarization cascade) using agent memory as a persistence channel and public discussion as a propagation channel, targeting Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming, and Long Context & Memory preferences. Novelty is genuine: unlike prior memory-poisoning (single-agent compromise) or echo-chamber work, the attack coordinates opposing stance arguments to widen camp separation; the KG-based argument construction and stance-neutral cueing are crafted but mostly assembled from standard techniques. Rigor is moderate: the threat model is formalized, evaluation spans 8 propositions, 3 memory systems, 2 backbones, 20 repeats, with ablations (Table 4), no-spillover control (Table 2), sensitivity analysis (Figure 4), and defense analysis (Appendix C). Weaknesses: reliance on a Qwen3-8B LLM-as-judge stance evaluator with only a vague 'manual second check' and no agreement statistics; no statistical significance tests; Table 2 contradicts the text for E2 (no-spillover P 0.155 vs baseline 0.124 is not 'close'); results limited to open-ended philosophical propositions with no factual ground truth, as the authors themselves acknowledge. Evidence is backed by detailed tables (48-case coverage claimed as 44/48 improvements), but everything is simulation-only on a reconstructed MoltBook environment with homogeneous per-run configurations, limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is limited: prompts (Appendix D) and proposition/stance definitions (Appendix B) are given, but no code or data release is stated, and graph-optimization details are deferred.

primary_link.title: GraphWake: Group Polarization via Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade in LLM-Agent Communities

papers.summary: LLM-driven agents can autonomously exchange opinions on online platforms and form communities. Such agent-operated social platforms raise a new security concern: attackers may manipulate agents to induce group polarization. Existing methods manipulate agent prompts or construct echo chambers, both of which are difficult to realize in practice. We therefore formulate a new threat, Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade, which uses agent memory as a persistence channel and public discussion as a pro
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理已能在線上平台自主交流並形成社群，攻擊者可能藉操縱代理引發群體極化。既有方法需存取系統提示或建構回音室，實務上難以實現。本文提出新威脅「記憶介導極化級聯」，以代理記憶作為持久化通道、公開討論作為傳播通道，並據此發展 GraphWake 攻擊：先建構立場支持論證知識圖譜，萃取中心路徑並蒸餾為緊湊公理，使目標代理的記憶系統保留這些論證；再發布含共享線索、立場中立的公開討論，觸發各目標代理同時檢索並重現各自論證，進而向未受處理的代理迭代傳播。在以 MoltBook 真實互動重建的模擬平台上，僅針對 10% 代理，三種記憶系統（LangMem、Mem0、A-Mem）的平均變異數極化由 0.098 升至 0.146，Esteban-Ray 極化由 0.130 升至 0.213；公理最佳化將平均字面保留率（LPR）由 0.382 提升至 0.847，證實內容可穩定重現。消融實驗顯示記憶線索貢獻最大；阻斷未受處理代理的暴露後，極化增幅近乎消失；困惑度過濾防禦效果有限，改寫防禦較有效。研究僅涵蓋無事實標準答案的開放命題，模擬環境組態同質，亦未於真實平台部署。此成果凸顯社群層級紅隊評估的必要性，並指向記憶來源溯源與跨代理傳播防禦的研究方向。
papers.title: GraphWake: Group Polarization via Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade in LLM-Agent Communities
papers.title_zh: GraphWake：LLM 代理社群中記憶介導極化級聯造成的群體極化

links.title: From Global Benchmarks to Local Evaluations: Benchmarking LLMs for the German Public Sector

evidence: Abstract/§1: MÖVE evaluates 39 LLMs from 13 providers on energy consumption, provider transparency, and knowledge of German-party positions; no single model excels across all dimensions.
§3 Energy Consumption: estimated energy varies by a factor of 63 (0.647–40.6 Wh per query, median 1.788 Wh), with reasoning models incurring particularly high costs.
§2.3: transparency assessed via 21 questions across 7 domains yielding 819 model-question assessments; manual–automated scoring divergence reduced from 27.4% to 16.2%.

Table 2/§2.4: top political-knowledge accuracy is 0.671 (DeepSeek R1, GPT-4o Mini) over 4,788 labeled positions from 64 parties, versus a 0.475 majority baseline; each model queried once per datapoint.

Table 1 caption: datasets constructed for the benchmark 'are not released to the public', limiting reproducibility despite public leaderboard (footnote 1: moeve.bundesdruckerei.de, github.com/Bundesdruckerei-GmbH/moeve-lmbench).
Limitations: energy results are comparative estimates relying on EcoLogits' assumptions for undisclosed parameter counts; transparency data collected March–May 2026 only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope LLM evaluation/benchmarking work: 39 LLMs scored on three governance dimensions (energy, provider transparency, German political knowledge), matching LLM (2.5) and evaluation/benchmark (1.8) preferences. Solid concrete findings (63-fold energy spread, transparency gap on compute/energy, 0.671 max accuracy vs 0.475 majority baseline) with public leaderboard, code, and transparency matrix. Weakened by estimated rather than measured energy (EcoLogits assumptions for proprietary models), single-query political-knowledge protocol with no variance or significance testing, transparency scored primarily by one researcher, and private benchmark datasets explicitly withheld, limiting reproduction and generalizability beyond the German context. Governance-dimension focus is a genuinely underexplored angle, but methodological novelty over existing holistic frameworks (HELM, BetterBench) is incremental.

primary_link.title: From Global Benchmarks to Local Evaluations: Benchmarking LLMs for the German Public Sector

papers.summary: Public institutions face a persistent challenge in selecting LLMs suited to their specific context. Existing benchmarks, however, are of limited use as they primarily reflect English-language and US-centric settings, and often only evaluate task performance. In this paper, we present first results of MÖVE, a holistic evaluation framework for the German public sector, examining three rarely considered governance dimensions: energy consumption, provider transparency, and knowledge of German-party
papers.summary_zh: 公部門機構選擇 LLM 時，僅憑通用基準排名並不足夠：既有基準多反映英文與美國脈絡，且偏重任務表現，忽略治理面向。本文提出 MÖVE 評估框架的初步成果，為德國公部門評測 39 個開源權重與專有模型，涵蓋三個治理構面：以 EcoLogits 依九個德文資料集的實際輸出統計估計推論能耗；以橫跨七個文件領域的 21 題矩陣，結合人工與自動化代理評分衡量供應商透明度；並以 64 個德國政黨在 Wahl-O-Mat 的 4,788 筆官方立場，以分類準確率檢驗政治知識。結果呈現明顯取捨：模型間估計能耗相差達 63 倍（0.647 至 40.6 Wh），且非模型大小所能完全解釋，摘要任務最耗能；透明度得分（滿分 42）介於 18 至 38，運算與能源揭露最不透明，簽署 EU AI Act 自願準則者僅小幅領先；政黨立場分類最高平均準確率僅 0.671，由 DeepSeek R1 與 GPT-4o Mini 並列，歐洲模型並未展現在地政治知識優勢，三個構面皆無單一模型全面領先。研究受限於僅三個維度與固定模型集，能耗屬比較性估計，專有模型的參數量仰賴假設。此框架強調：模型選擇應反映部署情境的治理需求，供應商與監管者亦應強化透明度規範。

links.title: Encoded but Not Actionable: Auditing the Decode-Generate-Steer Gap in Frozen LLMs for Geometric Constraints

evidence: Section 5.2 / Table 1: pretraining improves P1 macro-F1 over random init by 0.127-0.185 versus only 0.037-0.048 for P2 at the P1-selected layer, yielding positive DI with 95% CIs excluding zero for all six models.
Section 5.4 / Table 2: P3 forced-choice generation macro-F1 (0.025-0.259) falls 0.460-0.700 below matched P1 probe F1 (0.714-0.734) on the same held-out pairs and eight-class label set.
Section 5.5 / Appendix E.1: restoration peaks at layer 4 (0.781 Qwen2.5-3B; 0.876 Llama-3.1-8B) and reaches zero by layer 16/12, before P1 decodability peaks at layers 21/14.

Appendix E.2 / Table 7: mean-difference steering produces no target-class flips at any alpha in {0.5,1,2,4,8} for either task or model, reproduced across two independent runs with random-direction controls.

Section 6.4 Limitations: P2 labels are heuristic Grubler-style DOF counts not solver-verified; interventions cover only two backbones on n=169 and n=145 corruption-informative pairs; main results use one fixed split and one random-init checkpoint per architecture.
Appendix D: five-seed sketch-level GroupShuffleSplit on Qwen2.5-3B gives 0.700+/-0.002 versus 0.699+/-0.009 for the pair-level split, addressing sketch-overlap leakage.
Appendix F / Table 8: cross-dataset P1 check on Fusion 360 Gallery peaks at 0.643 macro-F1 (selectivity 0.515) at layer 26, but no matched P2 labels exist for that dataset.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to LLM-focused interpretability preferences: a four-part audit (linear probing, forced-choice generation, activation patching, mean-difference steering) of six frozen decoder-only LLMs (Qwen2.5, Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B), with CAD geometry as a controlled testbed rather than a pure domain application, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Rigor is unusually strong: shuffled-label selectivity, random-init and pure-input baselines, shuffled-order controls, entity-count control, sketch-level split check, content-free prompt priors, chance-normalized dissociation index, and random-direction steering controls. Evidence is quantified with bootstrap CIs and claims are carefully scoped to the tested setting. Novelty is moderate: probing-does-not-imply-use is established (the paper cites Ravichander et al. 2021), but the local-vs-global pretraining dissociation (positive DI in all six models) and the divergence between persistent decodability and transient restoration effects are new empirical contributions. Generalizability is limited by heuristic non-solver-verified P2 labels, interventions on only two backbones with small n (169/145 pairs), and a single main dataset with a P1-only cross-dataset check. Reproducibility is aided by public datasets/models, fixed seeds, and detailed protocols, but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Encoded but Not Actionable: Auditing the Decode-Generate-Steer Gap in Frozen LLMs for Geometric Constraints

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on structured reasoning tasks, but what they encode and whether it informs model behavior remain unclear. We investigate this question through geometric reasoning, using parametric CAD constraints as a controlled testbed for separating local pairwise relations from sketch-level constraint status. By probing the hidden states of six frozen decoder-only LLMs, we examine four properties: linear decodability, forced-choice generation,
papers.summary_zh: LLM 在結構化推理上表現優異，但模型內部編碼了什麼、這些資訊是否真正影響行為仍不清楚。本文以參數式 CAD 的幾何約束作為可控測試平台，對六個凍結的 decoder-only LLM（Qwen2.5 家族 0.5B 至 7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B）進行四部分稽核：線性可解碼性、強制選擇生成、激活層級影響與行為可操控性，並以隨機初始化、亂序標籤、純輸入對照與實體亂序等控制排除捷徑。結果呈現系統性落差：局部成對約束（P1）的解碼大幅受益於預訓練，峰值 macro-F1 達 0.714 至 0.734；但草圖層級的自由度狀態（P2）在隨機初始化下已高度可解碼，預訓練僅帶來 0.037 至 0.048 的增益，分歧指標在六個模型皆為正。更關鍵的是，可解碼不等於可作用：P3 生成的 macro-F1 遠低於 P1 探針（差距 0.460 至 0.700），Mistral-7B 幾乎坍縮至單一類別；激活修補的修復率於第 4 層達峰後，在第 12 至 16 層歸零，可解碼性卻持續存在；均值差異操縱在任一強度下皆無法翻轉至目標類別。研究僅限 SketchGraphs 的純幾何輸入，P2 標籤採啟發式自由度計算，干預實驗僅涵蓋兩個骨幹模型。此稽核框架說明高探針分數不足以證明可靠幾何推理，實務 CAD 系統仍需明確的效度監督或求解器驗證。

§5.4 Table 3: SRT adds 14.7% wall-clock overhead vs CPT and 3.5% vs Uniform Replay.
Appendix D Table 12: external TemporalWiki check, SRT average PPL 2785 vs CPT 6209 vs Base 2112, with explicit tokenizer/snapshot caveats.
Limitations: 'both from the Llama family, and evaluation is restricted to English; behaviour at larger scales, across different model families, and in multilingual settings remains open'.
Ethics and Reproducibility: 'Exact benchmark artifacts, code, logs, and QA items are proprietary and are not released.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: LLM continual pre-training methodology evaluated on TinyLlama-1.1B and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct with code corpora, matching 'Large Language Models' and 'Training & Optimization'. Strengths: matched-budget design (§4.3: Uniform Replay and SRT share the same 20/80 exposure cap, isolating within-pool scheduling), a diagnostic PPL-Prioritised baseline separating difficulty-prioritisation from interval scheduling, three ablations (replay ratio Table 4, threshold scaling Table 5, ease factor Table 6), overhead quantification (14.7% vs CPT, 3.5% vs Uniform Replay, Table 3), and honest external validation with caveats (TemporalWiki, Appendix D). Novelty is moderate: cognitively-inspired replay (Leitner queues, forgetting-curve replay, self-synthesized rehearsal) already exists; per-example SM-2 state with perplexity-derived recall quality is incremental but genuine, and the framing shifts replay from mixture-level to example-level. Evidence is solid but partly rests on self-constructed 500-question QA benchmarks with LLM generation and manual checks (Appendix A.3), and the striking Uniform-Replay reasoning collapse (BBH 8.4%, GSM8K 6.8%, Table 2) comes from a single training run per condition (Limitations); Table 2 variance reporting is inconsistent (±3.6 vs ±0.0 under the same protocol). Generalizability is partially supported (two scales, text+code, auxiliary vision/tabular) but limited to the Llama family and English. Reproducibility is capped by the explicit statement that 'Exact benchmark artifacts, code, logs, and QA items are proprietary and are not released', despite detailed algorithm, hyperparameters (Table 9), and corpus criteria.

primary_link.title: When to Review: Spaced Repetition for Continual Pre-Training of Language Models

papers.summary: Continual pre-training of large language models must acquire new information without erasing old knowledge. Existing replay methods often choose a global old/new mixture and sample uniformly, ignoring that examples differ in how quickly they are forgotten. We formulate continual pre-training as adaptive review scheduling: the training loop should decide not only how much history to replay, but which examples should return at each step. We introduce Spaced Repetition Training (SRT), a continual l
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型的持續預訓練必須在學習新資訊的同時避免抹除舊知識，但既有重播方法多在全球層級決定新舊資料混合比例並均勻取樣，忽略各範例遺忘速度的異質性。本文將持續預訓練形式化為自適應複習排程問題，提出 Spaced Repetition Training（SRT）：透過為每個範例維護 SuperMemo-2 演算法的審查狀態（容易度因子、連續成功次數、間隔與到期步數），將範例困惑度映射為回憶品質分數，使難以保留的範例提早重訪、穩定保留者延長間隔；排程同時作用於歷史與新進範例，且不更動模型架構、目標函數與最佳化器。在時間切分的 Wikipedia 與程式碼語料上，以 TinyLlama-1.1B 與 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 實驗，SRT 相較天真 CPT 可挽回 5 至 37 個百分點的舊知識準確率，同時維持或提升新知識習得；在較大規模上，SRT 幾乎完整保留 MMLU、BBH、GSM8K、PIQA 等基準，而均勻重播反而使 BBH 跌至 8.4%、GSM8K 跌至 6.8%。消融顯示 20/80 配比、預設閾值與初始容易度 2.5 最優，排程相對均勻重播僅增加 3.5% 時間開銷；視覺與表格資料輔助實驗支持原理可跨模態。研究僅測試 Llama 家族與英文，寬基準結果來自單次訓練執行。此工作證明排程而非曝光量才是關鍵，可作為現有持續預訓練流程之上的互補排程層。
papers.title: When to Review: Spaced Repetition for Continual Pre-Training of Language Models
papers.title_zh: 何時複習：語言模型持續預訓練的間隔重複排程

links.title: COMA: A Compositional Misleading Attack Class on Security-RAG, and a Causal Counterfactual Defense

evidence: Section VI-A, Table I: action-corruption bites all five models (incl. gpt-5.5 and deepseek-v4-pro) at 100% on every run across three seeds; verdict-flip is stochastic with 95% Wilson CIs, from 100% [78-100] on llama3.1:8b to 60% [36-80] on frontier models

Section VI-B, Table II: per-document ccd localization - removing D4 (prior-hardening misdirection) flips the JDOM answer 15/15 runs; removal of all six other documents flips 0/15, pattern reported to hold across all five models
Section VI-C, Table III: zero false positives across only four benign controls (CVE-2021-33813, CVE-2020-5411, CVE-2024-21907, CVE-2017-7525) at N=15
Section VI-D, Table IV: split-misdirection adaptive adversary evades per-document ccd (no single removal flips) but aggregate ccd (removing D4+D5+D6 together) detects on every run across five models

Section VII Limitations: 'Our evaluation rests on a small set of hand-constructed seeds rather than a population-scale benchmark'; authors 'argue structurally that P1-P4 are blind... rather than benchmarking them head-to-head'; seeds 'authored and verified by the same set of investigators'; grounded results lean on a single obscure CVE

Section V-C: threshold theta is 'implicit' - flagging requires some low-trust document to achieve influence 1.0 at N runs; continuous influence scores and calibrated thresholds deferred to future work
Abstract and Section VII Ethics: 'We release attack seeds and a ccd reference implementation' under a research-use license - a release commitment, not confirmed artifact availability

Section VI-A, inference-versus-stated ablation: inserting an explicit disambiguating document collapses the attack and removing it restores the bite, supporting the paper's governing principle but only on the JDOM seed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM-security paper: attacks and defenses for RAG-backed LLM security copilots, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, RAG & Knowledge, Red Teaming). The attack class (all-true, instruction-free, non-contradictory documents whose composition misleads) is a genuinely distinct angle vs. PoisonedRAG-style poisoning, and the leave-one-out causal-influence audit defense is plausibly new to RAG security, though leave-one-out ablation itself is a standard technique and the closest prior (counterfactual prompting) is only qualitatively differentiated. Rigor is mixed: careful definitions (C1-C4), N=15 runs, Wilson CIs, two-proportion tests, an explicit-disambiguator ablation, and an adaptive-adversary round are strengths; but there is no head-to-head benchmarking against P1-P4 defenses (structural arguments only, admitted in Section VII), only 4 benign controls for the zero-false-positive claim, a single grounded real CVE, and the threshold theta is left implicit (flags only on deterministic flips per Section V-C). Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (Tables I-IV) but small-scale and self-authored seeds verified by the same investigators, limiting generality beyond SOC security copilots; the authors themselves note high-profile CVEs resist the attack due to memorized remediation, narrowing the empirical scope. Reproducibility is decent: seeds are fully specified (Fig. 2), models and settings given, and a ccd reference implementation plus seeds are promised for release under a research-use license, though availability is a commitment rather than a verified artifact.

primary_link.title: COMA: A Compositional Misleading Attack Class on Security-RAG, and a Causal Counterfactual Defense

papers.summary: Every document a security copilot retrieves can be true, instruction-free, and non-contradictory --- and the copilot can still be driven to assess a critical, exploitable vulnerability correctly and then recommend a remediation that leaves it open. We study this failure in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) backing analyst-facing copilots in Security Operations Centers, and identify a class of attacks, \emph{\compmis{}} (COMA), in which every adversarial document is factually correct, instruct
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究資安營運中心（SOC）中檢索增強生成（RAG）系統的一類新型攻擊。作者提出「組合式誤導」（COMA）攻擊：每份攻擊文件皆符合四項條件——事實正確、無指令內容、不與其他文件矛盾、分布上與良性文件無異，但透過文件「組合」仍可誤導答案。攻擊以兩種機制實現：action-corruption 使模型診斷正確卻建議脆弱的組態修補而非根本修復；verdict-flip 則以無解的循環可達性鏈動搖可利用性判斷。核心原則是：當釐清事實必須「推論」而非「閱讀」取得時，攻擊才會成功。防禦方面，作者提出 ccd（因果反事實防禦），以留一法重執行衡量每份文件對答案的因果影響，並標記影響集中在低信任文件的回答。實驗涵蓋五種模型（含前沿推理模型）與真實 CVE-2021-33813：action-corruption 在每次執行皆命中；verdict-flip 隨模型能力遞減但不消失；ccd 精準定位攻擊文件且在四個良性控制集上零誤報，聚合版更能偵測自適應的影響分散攻擊。限制在於僅使用少量手工建構的種子、未與既有防禦系統直接比較，且種子由同一組作者建構與驗證。此研究對安全副駕的啟示深刻：模型能守住診斷卻守不住處方，基準測試應納入此面向。
papers.title: COMA: A Compositional Misleading Attack Class on Security-RAG, and a Causal Counterfactual Defense
papers.title_zh: COMA：針對安全 RAG 的組合式誤導攻擊類別與因果反事實防禦

links.title: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme

evidence: Abstract: 'Across eight models, the official rubric pays 0.020 to 0.159 points less per Part II question than proportional credit' and the Qwen3.5-27B History 2025 drop 'from the 90th to the 77th percentile among 481,293 candidates'.
Section 4 (Evaluation Methodology), Eq. 2: formalizes shortfall SF as mean of (0.25*a_q - ladder[a_q]) over Part II questions, with maximum penalty 0.25 on half-known questions.
Section 4: 'Our cohort records successfully reproduce the ministry's published statistics on 310 out of 312 comparisons' — validates the percentile-in-cohort methodology.

Section 4.1 (Answer-Only Baseline): fixed string DDSS 'wins on all 20 exams' earning 'between 11.07% and 24.25%' of a ten-point exam without reading questions, appearing 14.5% vs the 6.25% balanced rate.

Section 5.2: cohort-vs-model exam difficulty correlations rho=0.04 (Qwen3.5-27B), 0.02 (Qwen3.5-9B), 0.35 (InternVL3.5-8B), none significant; positive control Qwen3.5-27B vs GPT-5.5 at rho=0.86, p<0.001 on the same eighteen exams.

Section 5 (Experiments): 'the arms are not matched on decoding' — closed models run at vendor defaults while open-weight models use recommended sampling settings, a stated confound; six open-weight responses hit the token cap and score zero.

Section 5.3: isolated ladder demonstration — on Biology 2026, Qwen3.5-27B and the blind string both got 11/16 statements correct but earned 1.75 vs 2.35 points, showing grouping not count determines payout.

Section 7 (Limitations): percentile grid coarseness cannot separate models within 0.25 points, and the 2026-exam contamination intercept is 'statistically indistinguishable from zero' — explicitly a null result.
Section 8 (Ethics and Data Statement): corpus, keys, and code promised under CC-BY-4.0 but the release URL is '[PENDING: release URL]', limiting verifiable reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation contribution: THPT-Ladder scores eight LLMs (Qwen3.5, Claude family, GPT-5.5, InternVL3.5) on 632 items from 21 official Vietnamese exams under the ministry's non-additive convex marking rule rather than flat accuracy. The core finding is well-supported: accuracy overstates marks (shortfall 0.020-0.159 points per Part II question) and does not predict the penalty, since the same statement accuracy can pay 0.869-0.932 points per question. Novelty is genuine: the paper claims, plausibly, to be the first benchmark scoring models under an official non-additive national marking scheme and placing models in the actual human cohort via published score distributions. Rigor is strong: exact random baselines derived from exam structure, an answer-only string baseline (DDSS) exposing key imbalance, validated cohort records (310/312), significance-tested Spearman correlations with a positive control (rho=0.86), and an honest limitations section covering grid coarseness and a null contamination result. Weaknesses: findings are tied to one national exam reform, decoding arms are unmatched between open and closed models, and the promised code/data release URL is still pending, lowering reproducibility. Relevance to the preference profile is solid (LLM benchmark/evaluation) but not aligned with the highest-weighted Japanese, agent, or reasoning topics.

primary_link.title: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme

papers.summary: When evaluating language models on human exams, benchmarks typically score each response as right or wrong and report the overall accuracy. This approach assumes that partial knowledge is worth proportional credit, an assumption that fails when an examination uses a non-additive grading scheme. The 2025 reform of Vietnam's National High School Graduation Examination demonstrates the cost of this substitution. In Part II of the exam, candidates evaluate four true/false statements per question. Th
papers.summary_zh: 教育測驗基準通常以對錯二元計分並回報準確率，隱含「部分知識應獲等比例給分」的假設。本文以越南2025年高中畢業會考（THPT）改革證明此假設的代價：該考試第二部分每題含四個是非題，採凸階梯給分——答對0至4個分別得0、0.10、0.25、0.50、1.00分，答對三個只得0.50分而非0.75分。作者建立 THPT-Ladder 基準，收錄11個科目、21份官方試題共632題，完全依教育部公布規則評分，並利用超過百萬考生的公開分數分布，將模型置於人類考生群體中定位。八個模型的實驗顯示，官方規則比等比例給分每題少付0.020至0.159分；Qwen3.5-27B 在2025年歷史科因此從第90百分位降至第77百分位（共481,293名考生）。關鍵發現是語句準確率無法預測此懲罰：在 Claude Sonnet 5 相同準確率下，每題得分可在0.869至0.932之間變動，因為給分取決於正確語句如何分布於各題。作者另發現官方解答並非語句平衡，固定答案字串在不讀題的情況下即可取得11.07%至24.25%的分數。限制包括0.25分網格使百分位區辨粗略，且2025年試題已公開逾一年，可能有資料污染之虞。此研究指出：以通用準確率取代官方評分規則，會回報一種考試制度本身不會認證的能力。
papers.title: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme
papers.title_zh: 衡量部分給分落差：以越南2025年凸階梯評分制建立的嚴格基準

links.title: An Omitted Mode Is a Rare Rule: The Sampling-Verification Danger Law in Continuous Code World Models

evidence: Abstract and Section 3: danger defined as expected risk with exact gate-miss factor (1-r)^N (Prop 1) and a localization budget vol(E_eps) >= kappa((eta-eps)/L)^(d+m) for Lipschitz pairs at boundary points (Props 9, Corollaries 2-3).

Section 7: with real LLM synthesis on 1D clamps, GPT-5.x repaired the exact rule in 105 of 111 mode-containing draws, every attempt exact on 50/56 instrument-stream blocks, exact 95% interval [0.781, 0.960]; every mode-absent sample yielded an accepted, blind, exploited artifact (20/20 across sizes).

Section 7.1 and Appendix L: 2D repair collapse, 0/156 mode-containing draws over 20 raw seed blocks (exact CP95 upper bound 0.168 per block); 76-artifact audit finds dimensional reduction to half-planes (38/76 source, 39/76 behavior) and no artifact encoding its seen patch.

Section 9 and Table 6: eight targeted ablations plus two positive controls locate the 2D failure in induction of a located rule, not curvature, budget, variable naming, interior censoring, or evidence coverage (least-squares fit recovers region on 20/20 samples at widest dose while the synthesizer recovers 0/20).

Appendix P: reproducibility manifest maps every table/figure to versioned JSON; nine cell-parsed, five claims-only, one unaudited (Table 5); notes missing archived DOI release and unrecorded token counts as gaps.
Appendix Q: pre-specification ledger dates 14 confirmatory items on the 1D story, classifies all 2D ablations and theory as post-hoc/exploratory, and corrects two unsupported pre-registration claims.

Section 12 (Limitations): three hand-designed instruments, two planner families with one fixed configuration each, mini/large arms share gate samples, cross-family spot-checks at n=3, mode-capable baseline deliberately favourable by design.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-plus-experiment study of what a sampling acceptance test certifies for LLM-synthesized continuous code world models. Highly relevant to top-weighted preferences: LLMs (GPT-5.x, Qwen3-Coder, Claude) are the object of study (synthesis, repair, prompting ablations), with strong secondary alignment to code generation/program synthesis and evaluation methodology. Statistical hygiene is exceptional for this genre: block-level inference units, exact Clopper-Pearson intervals, refusal to pool dependent shared-seed draws, and a candid pre-specification ledger (Appendix Q) that reclassifies most 2D work as exploratory. Evidence is versioned and machine-audited. Deductions: the core gate-miss law (1-r)^N is an elementary Bernoulli fact and the paper extends the author's own companion paper; all findings live on three hand-designed deterministic instruments with two planner families at one configuration each; 2D repair and cross-family claims rest on tiny or model-specific samples; no external benchmark or prevalence evidence. Reproducibility is strong (manifest, per-cell audit script) but lacks an archived DOI release, token counts, and deterministic LLM sampling.

primary_link.title: An Omitted Mode Is a Rare Rule: The Sampling-Verification Danger Law in Continuous Code World Models

papers.summary: In the Code World Model paradigm an LLM synthesizes an executable world model that a classical planner searches, and the model is accepted when it reproduces sampled transitions. We ask what that acceptance certifies in continuous control. We define the pipeline's danger as an expected risk and isolate its exact factor: the probability that N i.i.d. gate rollouts all miss a critical event of probability r is exactly (1-r)^N; an independent acceptance sample adds its budget to the exponent. On th
papers.summary_zh: 程式碼世界模型（Code World Model）典範由 LLM 合成可執行的世界模型，再交由傳統規劃器搜尋，並以取樣轉移比對作為驗收門檻。本文探問此驗收在連續控制中究竟保證什麼。作者將危險定義為期望風險，證明 N 次獨立取樣皆遺漏機率為 r 的關鍵事件之機率恰為 (1-r)^N，並在表示層面證明「定位預算」：兩個 Lipschitz 常數至多為 L 的模型若在一點相差 η，必在半徑 (η-ε)/2L 的度量球上超出容差 ε 地不一致，故平滑模型無法將錯誤侷限於任意小的區域；唯有本文的非連續重置模式（牆、停止、凍結）不受此約束——被省略的模式即是罕見規則。三個混合動力儀器（帶牆小車、帶角度停止的單擺、四維雙模式貼片場）顯示：門檻法則成立，被剝削的規劃器在每個稀有度旋鈕皆被釘在邊界，損失幾乎全部可得回報；真實 LLM 合成實驗中，一維情形的危險化約為可辨識事件本身——GPT-5.x 在111次含模式取樣中105次寫出精確規則——但二維區域規則的修復完全失敗（0/156），八項消融與兩個正對照將障礙定位於「位置規則的歸納」，而非證據、覆蓋率或常數擬合能力。限制包括儀器僅三種、修復能力受幾何範圍限制、規劃器各僅一種設定，且合成細胞規模有限。此研究對取樣驗證的警示明確：門檻只保證它檢查過的地方。

links.title: Multi-turn Conversational AI from Text to Multimodal Interaction: Data, Models, Evaluation, and Open Challenges

evidence: Abstract (p.1): 'This study reviews multi-turn conversational AI across text-only dialogue, AudioLLMs and speech-native systems, multimodal and omni-modal systems, and tool-augmented agents.'

p.2 (Survey Scope and Selection): 'we followed PRISMA-ScR framework (Page et al., 2021)... Our initial search identified ~4K papers. After applying the PRISMA screening, we selected 200 papers for detailed review.'

Table 1 (p.2): comparison matrix showing this survey uniquely covers MT + Speech + Vision + Tri-modal + Cultural + multi-turn evaluation gaps versus six related surveys marked with partial or absent coverage.
Sec. 3 findings (p.4): '43 of 52 dataset entries are English-only' and '32 of 53 benchmarks focusing on text-only dataset' — quantified coverage claims verifiable against Table 2 and Table 3.

Sec. 6 (p.7-8): organizes evaluation into five families (surface-form/task, session-level, agentic/retrieval-grounded, speech-native/full-duplex, LLM-as-judge/human) with Table 9 and Table 10 comparing limitations.
Appendix A.4 (p.36-37): full search keyword groups for six query areas, supporting reproducibility of the literature search.
Sec. 7 (p.8): open challenges (persistent memory, cross-turn grounding, full-duplex timing, evaluation mismatch, cultural coverage) framed as research agenda without original empirical validation.
Limitations (p.9): authors acknowledge 'the literature is growing quickly, and some new or concurrent resources may not be included' and that broad categories 'may hide finer differences.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A PRISMA-ScR systematic survey of multi-turn conversational AI that is squarely on-topic for the curator's preferences: it centers LLM-based dialogue, agentic tool use (Sec. 4, ReAct/ToolSandbox/τ-Bench), conversational RAG (Sec. 5), RLHF/DPO training families, persistent memory/long context, multimodal/omni-modal systems, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Topic match is strong but it is a synthesis, not new methodology: the novelty lies in a unified session-level, three-axis framing (Table 1/Table 11 differentiate it from six prior surveys), which is genuinely useful yet inherently limited. Rigor of the review process is good (multi-database search, ~4K→200 screening, structured tables of 52 datasets, 53 benchmarks, model and training taxonomies), though selection criteria beyond keywords and qualitative categorization choices are thinly specified. Evidence strength is moderate: coverage claims are quantified and verifiable from its own tables (e.g., '43 of 52 dataset entries are English-only', Sec. 3), but the headline 'gaps' (capability, resource, evaluation, integration) are asserted from literature rather than demonstrated by any original experiment. Generalizability is high since the taxonomy and research agenda span modalities, languages, and system types; reproducibility is supported by Appendix A.4 search keywords and a released resource link, though screening details would need expansion. Not out-of-scope: language methodology is central, not a pure CV/audio/medical application.

primary_link.title: Multi-turn Conversational AI from Text to Multimodal Interaction: Data, Models, Evaluation, and Open Challenges

papers.summary: Conversational AI is moving beyond isolated text prompts toward sustained, multimodal interaction. In real conversations, users clarify goals, revise requests, interrupt responses, switch topics, and introduce new evidence while expecting systems to preserve context across turns. This makes multi-turn dialogue a distinct challenge requiring systems to maintain and update memory, ground responses across modalities, tools, and external knowledge, and adapt across languages and cultures. This study
papers.summary_zh: 本文是涵蓋多輪對話式人工智慧的系統性文獻回顧，遵循 PRISMA-ScR 流程從約四千篇論文篩選出200篇深入分析。作者以整段對話的持續互動為分析單位，沿互動深度、模態複雜度與文化語言多樣性三軸組織文獻，橫跨純文字對話、AudioLLM 與語音原生系統、多模態與全模態模型，以及工具增強代理。文中整理資料集與基準、建模典範演進（從模組化管線、指令微調 LLM、AudioLLM 到全模態系統與代理式對話），並將訓練策略歸納為五類：監督式微調、強化學習與偏好最佳化、多工學習、合成資料生成，以及對話式檢索增強訓練；評估方法亦分為五類，涵蓋表面形式指標、整段對話層級指標、代理與檢索評估、語音原生與全雙工評估，以及 LLM 評審與人工評估。核心發現指出四大落差：能力落差（更長上下文與更多模態不保證整段對話層級能力）、資源落差（英文與純文字主導，語音、影片與文化依據資源稀少）、評估落差（可重現的整段對話指標不足），以及整合落差（少有資源同時涵蓋記憶、多語、語音、視覺、工具與安全）。作者據此提出記憶、跨輪依據、全雙工互動、穩健修正與文化對齊的研究議程，並強調未來評估應從單回合給分轉向整段對話層級的能力認證。
