llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an end-to-end LLM agent system (research-problem discovery with role-based verification agents, critic gating, and typed evidence graphs) running entirely on a local open-weight 9B model, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, RAG/Knowledge, and Reasoning preferences. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself acknowledges the core structural-motif idea comes from the authors' own PRISM workshop paper, and prior systems (ResearchAgent, AI-Scientist-v2, Graph2Idea, SciMON, HypER) cover much of the design space; the verification-before-formulation gate and provenance-rich artifacts are incremental but sensible additions. Rigor is limited by an evaluation that is purely LLM-judge based with no human expert assessment, no statistical testing, and an explicitly acknowledged confound: the formulation rubric caps scores when fields like formal problem statements and ambiguity flags are absent, and Section 4.3 concedes SGHA's advantage on grounding and ambiguity hygiene exists 'because these fields are part of the final artifact' — a rubric-structure circularity that inflates SGHA's margins. The comparison is admitted to be system-level rather than information-matched, and component ablations (e.g., verification gate vs. critic vs. formalization) are absent. Evidence strength is modest: 15 candidates per method and detailed count funnels, but no variance, inter-judge agreement, or downstream validation of whether generated problems are actually novel or useful; the authors appropriately disclaim novelty/correctness claims. Generalizability is decent across five ML domains plus profile conditioning, but only ML domains are tested. Reproducibility is comparatively good: public GitHub link, full prompts, schemas, gate thresholds (min_survival_score 0.60), and judge panels documented in Appendices A-B, though corpus selection details and parsed-paper shortfalls (e.g., 137/250 for reasoning) are under-specified.

primary_link.title: SGHA: Evidence-Grounded Research Problem Discovery with Local Language Models

radar.summary: Recent efforts toward fully automated AI scientists have demonstrated that language-model agents can generate hypotheses, execute experiments, and draft scientific manuscripts. However, during the early stages of research, when research problems are formulated, these AI scientists often rely heavily on proprietary frontier models. Their proposals are shaped by opaque parametric knowledge and by literature searches conditioned on the proposals themselves. Such knowledge is effectively a black box
radar.summary_zh: 自動化 AI 科學家在構思研究問題時多半依賴封閉的前沿模型，提案建立在難以稽核的參數知識上，易受幻覺與偏見影響，將機敏研究資料送往外部 API 也引發保密與治理疑慮。本文提出 SGHA（Structural Gap Hypothesis Agent），一套完全以本地開放權重模型 Qwen3.5-9B 運作、以語料為先的研究問題探索系統。其流程為：檢索並解析論文，抽取帶有出處的證據三元組，建構型別化證據圖；以預定義的結構性 motif（如假設—失敗、共享失敗、反覆未解的限制）偵測候選缺口；經語料層級篩選後，由支援、懷疑者、可行性、機制等角色代理與批判者驗證，僅通過硬性關卡者進入表述階段，再經變體擴展與獨立批判者過濾，整併為研究問題家族，輸出含假設、目標、成功準則與模糊標記的半形式化問題陳述。在五個機器學習領域、1,250 篇論文上，系統抽取 8,634 條證據，39 個缺口通過驗證，形成 15 個問題家族。與同模型 AI-Scientist-v2、Claude Opus 版本及 MOOSE-Star 比較，五位 LLM 評審在隱去方法標籤下評分，SGHA 整體表述品質最高（5.99），在來源紮根、歧義處理與假設邊界清晰度領先，但清晰度與範圍控制由 Claude Opus 基線勝出。限制包括評審僅評估表述品質、未驗證外部新穎性與正確性，且 4B 模型無法產出最終家族，顯示對規模敏感。此工作證明不需前沿模型也能產出可稽核、可追溯的研究問題起點。

evidence: Abstract: 'Intrinsic scoring reached 33.0% Hit@1 pooled across both scorers, compared with 16.6% for prompted listwise ranking. The strongest configuration... reached 53.1%, though this was the maximum across 14 model-by-scorer combinations selected post hoc.'

Section V-A: 'as the maximum of 14 model-by-scorer combinations chosen after seeing the results, this value should be read as an upper bound on what a well-matched pairing can achieve rather than as an unbiased estimate.'

Section VI-B (Limitations): 'the task is closer to identifying a known hypothesis than evaluating truly open-ended scientific reasoning' and gold hypotheses 'may simply be more fluent than the distractors, which our current design cannot fully separate.'
Section VI-B: 'We tested prompted ranking with only one proprietary model and one zero-shot prompting strategy, so different prompting methods or models could produce different results.'
Section V-C / Table IV: GPT-5 pairwise 'Gold beats candidate' = 37.4%, below the stated 50% random-ordering baseline, with no failure-mode analysis reported.
Data and Code Availability: 'The data used in this study are publicly available from a previously published study [12]. The code and associated artifacts will be released upon acceptance.'

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: compares logit-based intrinsic confidence (softmax NLL and raw-logit energy) against prompted LLM-as-judge ranking for scientific hypothesis selection. Strong alignment with LLM and LLM-evaluation preferences, but no relevance to Japanese NLP, agents, code, or CoT reasoning. Rigor is solid in design (1,323 papers, 16 candidates, bootstrap CIs, pairwise and cross-model agreement analyses) and unusually honest: the headline 53.1% Hit@1 (Llama 3.2 1B, Raw) is explicitly flagged as a post-hoc maximum over 14 combinations and thus an upper bound. Main weaknesses: the prompted baseline is a single proprietary model with one zero-shot listwise prompt restricted to top-5 (GPT-5 pairwise 37.4%, below chance, with no failure-mode analysis), and acknowledged confounds (gold hypotheses possibly more fluent, task is identification of known published hypotheses, not novel-hypothesis evaluation) limit generalizability. Mechanistic explanation for Gemma 2's Raw-score failure (tanh soft-capping) is offered only as conjecture. Reproducibility is good: public models with HuggingFace links, public ResearchBench data, detailed compute/software stack, and Algorithm 1; but code is only promised 'upon acceptance' and the GPT-5 API baseline is version-dependent. Novelty is moderate: likelihood/energy signals for selection are established (Kadavath 2022; energy-based OOD detection), the contribution is the systematic paradigm comparison on a new task, not new scoring methodology.

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Know a Good Hypothesis When They See One? Logit-Based Energy Scoring Outperforms Prompted LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Hypothesis Ranking

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific hypothesis generation. However, evaluating generated hypotheses remains a challenge for trustworthy AI-enabled scientific workflows. Existing approaches often use LLMs as judges or rely on semantic similarity, which can favor familiar ideas over novel ones. We propose a logit-based energy scoring method that evaluates hypotheses using a language model's intrinsic confidence rather than comparative judgment. We benchmarked seven la
radar.summary_zh: 評估 LLM 產生的科學假說目前多仰賴 LLM-as-a-judge 或語意相似度，但這類方法受位置偏見、冗長偏見影響，且偏好熟悉想法而犧牲新穎性。本文提出 logit 能量評分，直接利用模型內在信心評估假說：在固定背景與研究問題的提示下，只對假說片段計算兩種分數——softmax 負對數概似（NLL）與未正規化的原始目標 logit 能量（Raw），分數越低代表模型越認為該假說可信；每個候選只需一次前向傳遞，無需比較式判斷。資料採用 ResearchBench 的 1,323 篇跨 12 學科論文，每篇含 1 個正確假說與 15 個干擾選項，共測試 8 個模型。結果顯示內在評分合計 Hit@1 為 33.0%，明顯高於 GPT-5 以 listwise 提示排序的 16.6%；最佳單一組合是 Llama 3.2 1B 搭配 Raw 評分，Hit@1 達 53.1%，但此值是事後從 14 種組合中挑出的上限。Raw 對小型模型（Llama 3.2、Mistral）幫助大，卻傷害 Gemma 2 2B（作者推測與其 tanh 軟截斷有關）。兩兩比較中 GPT-5 僅 37.4%，低於隨機水準。限制包括基準取自已發表論文、無法完全排除模型記憶（memorization）風險，正確假說可能較流暢，且僅測試一種提示策略。此研究顯示機率式內在訊號可勝過顯式提示，讓小型開放權重模型也能勝任假說評估。
radar.title: Do LLMs Know a Good Hypothesis When They See One? Logit-Based Energy Scoring Outperforms Prompted LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Hypothesis Ranking

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems/methodology work on MoE routing locality for edge inference, squarely hitting MoE architecture, inference/serving, and efficiency preferences, though it misses the top-weighted topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP). Novelty is moderate: the core adjacent-token routing-consistency loss is acknowledged as concurrent (StickyMoE, §6), so the contributions are the stricter pre-registered multi-domain evaluation, a domain-confinement arm, and the training-time × training-free stacking result. Rigor is unusually strong for a single-author, single-GPU effort: frozen pre-registration with amendments logged before unblinding (§6, Appendix F), two seeds, monotone dose-response, matched budgets, and honest reporting of a null result under joint miss/quality gates. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitatively grounded (§3 bandwidth model within 6%; §7 Table 5 shows λ=0.05 cutting misses 59-60% at +2.1-3.1% PPL, failing the ≤1% gate), but rests on 137M/340M toy models that are undertrained, one hardware setup, a proxy model for traces, and modeled-not-deployed serving projections (§9). Generalizability is genuinely uncertain at frontier scale—the 340M rung is suggestive only and the paper itself flags the tension with StickyMoE and Oracle-MoE. Reproducibility is exemplary: released pre-registration, code, traces, configs with SHA-256 hashes, unit tests, and a corrections log (Appendix G).

primary_link.title: Cacheable by Design? Training Mixture-of-Experts Routers for Locality Against the Edge Memory-Bandwidth Wall: A Pre-Registered Negative Result with a Systems Measurement Study

radar.summary: Serving a 235B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model on a single 8 GB GPU is bottlenecked not by compute but by memory bandwidth: decode must stream each token's active experts from whichever tier holds them, and on consumer hardware most experts sit on an SSD far slower than RAM. We quantify this bandwidth wall on Qwen3-235B (Q4_K_M, 134 GB): measured decode is 0.44 tok/s warm, matching a bytes-per-token / bandwidth model, while a batching scheme that should amortize one disk sweep instead c
radar.summary_zh: 在單張 8GB 消費級 GPU 上伺服 235B 參數的 Mixture-of-Experts 模型（Qwen3-235B-A22B，4-bit 共 134GB），瓶頸不在運算而在記憶體頻寬：實測解碼僅 0.44 tok/s，與每 token 讀取位元組數除以頻寬的理論模型吻合；批次處理理應攤提磁碟掃描，卻在 batch 32 因分頁抖動而崩潰。作者以自製 llama-moe-trace 工具量測 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的路由結構：相鄰 token 的專家重用率為隨機的 2 倍、95% 流量集中於 52.5% 的專家，程式碼領域與其他領域近乎正交；僅快取 13.4% 專家的 LRU 策略即可服務 66% 請求。據此作者預註冊實驗，訓練 137M 參數 MoE，加入相鄰 token 路由一致性（局部性）損失與領域侷限損失，並設定快取未命中下降與 perplexity 的雙重關卡。結果顯示機制有效——局部性訓練最多降低 60% 未命中、領域訓練達 99% 靜態釘選命中率——但所有設定皆未通過 ≤1% perplexity 關卡，未命中下降與品質損失緊密耦合；此結果與同時期 StickyMoE 在單一領域小模型上宣稱近乎免費的發現形成張力，340M 測試亦顯示代價未隨規模縮小。不過無需訓練的快取感知重路由可與訓練後的局部性疊加，在兩種規模都達到約 80% 未命中下降、perplexity 增幅 ≤3.4%。限制包括僅兩個規模階梯、訓練不足、單一硬體與代理模型量測。這項預註冊負結果把模糊期望轉為可否證的規模化主張，並揭示訓練時與推論時局部性互補的實用組合。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM post-training methodology paper: analyzes why curriculum learning works for LLM reasoning via a first-order gradient-based Relative Transfer measure and derives TDCS dynamic sampling. Strongly matches LLM (w2.5), reasoning (w2.5), and training/optimization (w1.5) preferences with partial code-generation relevance. The core mechanism (normalized gradient inner products between data subsets) is closely related to known influence/gradient-conflict techniques (LESS etc.), so novelty is moderate; the transfer-based explanation of curriculum efficacy and adaptive sampler are sensible but incremental. Rigor is reasonable (ablation Table 6, sensitivity Table 9, multi-scale Table 4) but weak on baseline breadth: Section 2.2 cites adaptive data-selection methods yet Section 6.1 baselines are only Curriculum/Mix/Random, with no variance reported and small datasets (Appendix Table 7: 800-1000 training examples; test sets 200-1000). Evidence is self-consistent and concrete but includes a suspicious +20.8% jump (Llama3.2-3B iGSM, Table 4) and a mathematically wrong iGSM example (Appendix 8.4: '19 + 4 = 0'), and a learning-rate inconsistency (Section 6.1: 1e-5 vs Appendix Table 8: 5e-5). Generalizability is decent across three tasks, two model families, and a self-improvement setting, but confined to LoRA SFT with hand-defined difficulty levels. No code or data release is claimed; hyperparameters are documented, giving middling reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Understanding Curriculum Learning in Large Language Models via Cross-Difficulty Optimization Dynamics

radar.summary: Curriculum learning has been widely adopted in the post-training of large language models by organizing training data from easy to hard. However, its effectiveness varies substantially across reasoning tasks, suggesting that no single curriculum is universally optimal and raising a fundamental question: what determines when curriculum learning works? In this paper, we answer this question by analyzing the optimization dynamics induced by different curriculum schedules. We show that the transfer
radar.summary_zh: 課程學習(由易到難安排訓練資料)已廣泛用於大型語言模型的後訓練,但其在不同推理任務上的效果差異極大,本文追問:究竟是什麼決定課程學習何時有效?作者從最佳化動態切入,以一階泰勒展開分析在某一難度上進行梯度更新對其他難度損失的影響,將跨難度知識遷移形式化為「相對遷移」(Relative Transfer),即目標難度梯度與更新難度梯度內積對自身梯度範數平方的比值。據此提出TDCS(遷移感知動態課程取樣):依估計的遷移關係,以sigmoid映射決定當前難度的取樣比例,對遷移不足的較易難度進行反向指數加權重播,並在更難難度展現強正向遷移時額外分配訓練量。在Sudoku、iGSM、KodCode三個推理基準與多種模型規模上,TDCS一致優於Curriculum、Random與Mix等固定排程,主要實驗分別領先最強固定策略2.6%、3.8%與1.2%,並可延伸至GSM8K等自我改進設定。消融實驗確認更難難度調整與指數難度分配兩模組皆有貢獻。限制方面,實驗以LoRA微調與特定難度定義為主,遷移估計仰賴一階近似與少量樣本估計。整體而言,本文提供以跨難度遷移解釋課程學習成敗的統一最佳化觀點,並將其轉化為可部署的動態取樣策略。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM safety defense (reference-aware pre-generation gating against localized jailbreaks), squarely within LLM/AI-safety/red-teaming preferences and not pure computer vision, since the contribution is a language-model safety methodology. The framing that the security-relevant unit is the grounded operation-target pair (Section I, Section V) is a reasonably fresh angle, though the system assembles existing components (OCR, open-vocabulary proposals, rule-based scoring). Rigor is mixed: clear threat model (Section III), four backbones, four baselines, held-out threshold calibration (Section VI-C), and honest limitations (Section VIII), but no ablations over K, thresholds, or the max-risk rule; the candidate-level scorer is only a 'fixed rule-calibrated risk mapping' with sparse specification (Section V-C); the monotonicity argument is explicitly intuition, 'not a universal guarantee' (Eq. 16); and using FigStep as a defense baseline is confusing since FigStep is an attack method (Section VI-B). Evidence strength is limited by small curated sets (500 FigStep / 150 JailBreakV-28K samples, Section VI-A), no significance testing, an unexplained +4.9 MM-Vet gain over the undefended MiniGPT-4 for a blocking-only gate (Table III), and undefended ASRs cited in text (14.68/58.58/11.95/24.01) that are not reconciled with Table II columns. Generalizability is aided by model-agnostic external deployment and cross-backbone consistency, but restricted to English-centric, single-target, non-adaptive attack regimes (Sections VIII, X). Anonymous code is provided (Abstract), but pipeline calibration details are thin for full reproduction.

primary_link.title: COMIC: Reference-Aware Safety Gating for Multimodal Large Language Models

radar.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interact with screenshots, scanned documents, diagrams, and other visually grounded inputs. This shift introduces a new safety risk: in many multimodal jailbreaks, neither the prompt nor the image is harmful in isolation. Unsafe behavior emerges only when the model binds an apparently benign operation, such as summarizing, translating, or following, to a localized visual target. This reveals a structural weakness in current multim
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型日益處理螢幕截圖、掃描文件與圖表等視覺輸入,卻衍生新型安全風險:在許多多模態越獄攻擊中,提示與影像各自看來無害,危險行為只在模型將摘要、翻譯、跟隨等看似良性的操作,綁定到影像中局部視覺目標之後才浮現。現有防禦多將提示—影像整體送入審查,錯置了真正的安全單元。本文提出COMIC,一個參考感知的生成前安全閘門:先推斷請求的操作與參考類型,再從OCR與開放詞彙候選建構目標集合,依語意與空間匹配進行接地(grounding),並針對明確的操作—目標對評估風險;同時以最大風險聚合與品質感知路由保守決策,唯有在不安全風險低且接地證據可靠時才放行。在LLaVA-1.5/1.6、MiniGPT-4與Qwen-VL上,COMIC將FigStep攻擊成功率壓至近零,在JailBreakV-28K上平均相對降幅達93.12%,並在MM-Vet上維持良性效用,額外延遲有限。限制包括:感知與候選召回是首要瓶頸,密集輸入的歧義仍可能造成誤放行或誤拒,且分散在多區域的危害超出單一目標推理粒度,評估亦以英文基準為主。其意義在於主張多模態安全應在使用者意圖成為接地形動作之處強制執行。
radar.title: COMIC: Reference-Aware Safety Gating for Multimodal Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: COMIC:多模態大型語言模型的參考感知安全閘門

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent methodology paper: self-evolving declarative rule knowledge with rule-level credit assignment (declared rule-adoption records joined to localized feedback), clustering-based consolidation, and routing-index retrieval, applied to storyboard generation. The mechanism is a genuine granularity advance over trajectory-level skill optimizers (EvoSkill/SkillOpt) and binary-reward rule learners (AutoManual), supported by ablations, iteration dynamics, cross-backbone transfer, LLM-judge validation, and a 14-day production deployment. Credibility is weakened by test-set model selection (round-5 chosen as best-performing on the test set, so the 0.7-point margin over human directors on an n=18 test set has no CIs/significance tests), a judge sharing the backbone of all scored AI systems and validated only on director storyboards rather than AI outputs, no control condition in the deployment study, and single-domain evaluation. Dataset and detailed hyperparameters/prompts aid reproduction, but no code release is stated and appendices are condensed/translated.

(2) Knowledge refinement: authored knowledge is not evaluated against execution outcomes, and op
radar.summary_zh: 分鏡腳本將劇本拆解為逐鏡頭的視覺規劃,其品質仰賴導演的內隱專業知識,是短劇自動化生產的瓶頸。既有將導演知識注入大型語言模型的方式面臨三大挑戰:知識取得依賴人類撰寫、知識修正缺乏與執行結果連結的回饋歸因、知識注入受限於上下文長度與人工挑選。SAGE以技能的工作流程加知識庫結構為基礎,透過對比劇本與專家分鏡自動萃取無內容規則;生成時模型宣告每個敘事群組採用的規則,將規則採用紀錄與局部化回饋連結,即可在規則層級進行歸因,驅動修訂、新增與退役三種演化操作;演化後的規則經去重、嵌入與聚類整併為情境套件,推論時透過路由索引檢索。在三種劇型共18集測試上,SAGE以經專家驗證的評分取得77.8分,超越專業導演的77.1分,並優於Few-shot、CoT及技能最佳化基準;消融顯示無歸因的迭代會先升後降,規則層級歸因是持續改善的關鍵。整併規則可跨GPT-5.4、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek V4-Pro遷移,相對增益8.1%至21.2%。於商業平台部署14天,1,344個輸出中87.2%免實質修改即被採用,每集撰寫時間下降逾83%,並釋出首個由專業導演撰寫分鏡的PROSE資料集。限制在於評分依賴LLM評審(已與人類共識校驗),部分跨模型評估規模亦有限。

links.title: Governance Records as Supervision: Verifier-Selected Self-Training for Structured Workflow Repair

evidence: Abstract: 'VAL-accepted plans increased from 1 to 57, with 56 paired gains and zero regressions; thinking reached 30... approximately 1/56 of thinking's mean latency'

Section 4.3 / Appendix A.5: '41 verifier-only successes, eight self-only successes, paired net +33, and exact p = 1.9647e-6' on 160 fresh cases with case IDs, pool, recipe, and seed fixed
Section 4.2 / Appendix A.4: co-primary interface-cure endpoint failed ('three paired schema gains... p = 0.25'), frozen reading SEMANTIC_ONLY - honest negative reporting
Section 6 Limitations: 'Each external adapter is one training run with one optimizer seed and one frozen recipe... The external result remains one public synthetic planning domain'

Appendix A.1: pinned commits for PlanBench (1f4d600...), VAL (3c7a1f3...), Fast Downward, plus full LoRA hyperparameters (rank 16, alpha 32, lr 1e-4, seed 2026113001) in Appendix A.3; no explicit artifact release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM post-training paper (Qwen3-14B, Phi-4) on verifier-selected self-training that consolidates expensive thinking-mode planning into cheap non-thinking execution via LoRA, directly touching high-weight preferences: LLMs, agents/workflows, reasoning, and training method. It is in scope (not a pure-domain or vision application). Methodological novelty is moderate: the author concedes the method is 'filtered supervised training adjacent to offline reward-filtered self-training' (ReST/STaR/RFT family), with the freshest piece being the matched target-selection ablation showing verifier admission beats blinded self-selection at fixed pool/exposure. Rigor is unusually careful for a single-author paper: preregistered frozen gates, paired exact tests, contamination checks, honestly reported negative endpoints (interface-cure gate failed, p=0.25, SEMANTIC_ONLY reading). Evidence is internally consistent and quantitatively detailed but rests on one external synthetic planning domain (Blocksworld 5-6 blocks), 24 targets, one training seed per arm, and author-owned case construction/prompting despite external PlanBench/VAL authorship. Generalizability is explicitly and correctly bounded; the paper itself disclaims arbitrary planning, enterprise validity, and unrestricted self-improvement. Reproducibility is aided by pinned commits and full hyperparameters/seeds, but no code/data release is stated. Calibrated weighted score ~0.66.

primary_link.title: Governance Records as Supervision: Verifier-Selected Self-Training for Structured Workflow Repair

radar.summary:
Machine-verifiable workflows produce governance records linking a task contract, model attempt, verifier decision, accepted output, and target origin. We test whether these records can supervise bounded models, consolidating occasional or expensive capability into reliable one-shot execution.
  On fresh, structure-disjoint PlanBench replanning cases, Qwen3-14B thinking generated 24 plans admitted by the independently authored VAL verifier. Those plans trained the same checkpoint for non-thinking
radar.summary_zh: 當語言模型代理的產出可由機器驗證時,執行過程會留下連結任務合約、模型嘗試、驗證器判定、通過輸出與目標來源的治理紀錄。本文檢驗這些紀錄能否作為監督訊號,將偶發或昂貴的能力整併為可靠的單次執行。主要實驗採用PlanBench Blocksworld重規劃任務與獨立開發的VAL驗證器:Qwen3-14B思考模式在32個蒐集案例中產出24個通過驗證的計畫,再以LoRA訓練同一檢查點轉為非思考執行;在80個未見案例上,通過驗證的計畫由1個增至57個,配對增益56、零退化,思考模式僅達30,且訓練後模型在全部案例皆符合輸出格式、平均延遲約為思考模式的1/56。配對消融固定候選池、目標數、模型與訓練配方,僅改變目標篩選方式:在160個新案例上,基礎模型、僅格式篩選、模型自選與VAL篩選分別達1、55、69與102,VAL相對自選淨增33(p=1.96×10⁻⁶),顯示獨立語意驗證具因果作用。互補的Phi實驗以Phi-4-reasoning為教師,將基礎Phi-4由2提升至51,符合輸出格式的比例由35/80提升至80/80。限制包括僅涵蓋單一合成規劃域與難度帶、每組態單一訓練種子、學生超越來源的比較屬描述性,且合約符合不等於真實世界或政策正當性。其價值在於釐清目標來源,支持可機器驗證任務上的驗證器篩選自我訓練。

links.title: REChart: Reasoning-Efficient Chart Editing with Large Reasoning Models

evidence: Abstract: claims 79.0% average reasoning-token reduction under a 16,384-token max thinking budget and SOTA among open-source comparable-scale models
Table 2 (Section 5.3): REChart overall 79.71 on ChartEdit vs Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking 74.6 and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 71.2; ChartMIMIC Customized 70.09 vs 69.6
Section 4.1.2: Reason-Score-Refine loop explicitly 'Inspired by MRT' (Qu et al., 2025) with score delta Δt used as per-episode progress proxy
Section 4.2.2: efficiency reward 'Following Qu et al. (2025)' credits only the final reasoning segment before truncation
Table 4 (Section 5.4): +Efficiency Reward variant yields 79.71/70.09/77.15 vs Budgeted GRPO 80.24/68.76/78.96, showing mixed accuracy tradeoff justified by token savings
Table 5 (Section 5.4): average tokens drop from 8,328.55 (base) to 2,436.39 (+SFT) to 1,749.36 (+efficiency reward), matching the 79.0% claim
Appendix A.3: generated scripts executed in sandbox and scored by GPT-4o judge under the official ChartEdit evaluation prompt
Section 4.1.1: manual inspection of a random sample of 1,000 image-code pairs to verify the Qwen3-VL-32B audit
Limitations section: only an 8B base model fine-tuned; framework limited to chart editing with HTML/SVG extension left to future work
Reproducibility statement: representative subset, source code, and scripts in supplemental; full 200k SFT dataset and checkpoints to be released on Hugging Face upon publication
Section 5.2: hyperparameters given (LR 5e-5, batch 256, GRPO group size 8, equal reward weights; 8x A800 SFT, 8x H100 RL)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LRM training paper whose core contributions are language-model methodology: an empirical inverted-U study of CoT length in chart editing, process-supervised SFT trajectories, and GRPO with an episode-level efficiency reward. Strongly aligned with reasoning-efficiency, code generation, and RL-training preferences, though the task (chart editing) is a narrower visualization application and the efficiency reward is explicitly adapted from MRT (Qu et al., 2025) rather than new. Rigor is good: three benchmark settings, many baselines including 32B models, layered ablations (SFT/base GRPO/budgeted GRPO/efficiency reward), token-cost ablations, trajectory-component and data-scale ablations, and internally consistent numbers (13.3-point gain, 79.0% token reduction). Caveats: GPT-4o-as-judge evaluation per the official protocol, no significance testing or seeds, and the efficiency reward trades ~0.5-1.8 points on two of three benchmarks vs budgeted GRPO (honestly framed). Generalizability is limited to one task family and one 8B base model. Reproducibility is well supported by prompts, hyperparameters, pipeline statistics, and promised Hugging Face release of data/checkpoints, but artifacts are not yet public.

primary_link.title: REChart: Reasoning-Efficient Chart Editing with Large Reasoning Models

radar.summary: Chart editing requires inferring and modifying visualization code from a reference chart image based on an editing instruction, challenging fine-grained visual reasoning, instruction following, and executable code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs. Large reasoning models (LRMs) with extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are suitable for tackling such complex multimodal tasks. However, our preliminary study reveals an ``inverted-U'' relationship between reasoning length and chart-editing perfor
radar.summary_zh: 圖表編輯要求模型依據參考圖表影像與編輯指令推論並改寫視覺化程式碼，對多模態大型語言模型的細粒度視覺推理能力構成嚴峻挑戰。本文的初步研究發現，推理長度與圖表編輯成效呈「倒U型」關係：過長的推理會導致過度思考，使模型產生視覺幻覺或陷入冗餘推理迴圈。為此，作者提出REChart兩階段訓練框架：第一階段以角色分工的多代理Reason-Score-Refine工作流程，從約70萬筆影像-指令-程式碼語料合成20萬條高品質推理軌跡供監督式微調，逐步剔除停滯不前的推理片段；第二階段透過強化學習結合兩種互補獎勵：忠實度獎勵評估程式碼正確性、視覺忠實度與結構一致性，效率獎勵則為每次rollout隨機指派思考預算、截斷推理過程，僅對緊鄰答案的最後一段推理依其貢獻給分。在ChartEdit與ChartMIMIC兩大基準上，此8B開源模型達到同規模最先進表現，平均總分提升13.3分，且在最大思考預算16,384 tokens下，平均推理token用量較基礎模型減少79.0%。限制在於僅微調8B模型，且只聚焦圖表編輯任務。此研究證明過程級監督能有效兼顧編輯保真度與推理效率。

links.title: REST API Testing with Verified LLM-Inferred Dependencies and Response-Driven Refinement

evidence: Abstract: APIPilot achieves 92.3% operation coverage, up to 58.6% code coverage, and an 88.1% workflow execution success rate, outperforming LLM-based and traditional baselines on 16 real-world REST API services.
Section I: 'directly trusting LLM-inferred dependencies can make REST API testing fragile'—motivates treating LLM predictions as candidate hypotheses validated by execution.
Section IV Experiment Setup: all tools use the same LLM (OpenAI GPT-4.1-mini) with temperature 0; each experiment repeated five times with averages reported.
Section IV-A Table I: APIPilot average operation coverage 92.3% vs DeepREST 60.4%, AutoRestTest 70.4%, RESTifAI 79.0%, KAT 68.1%.
Section IV-C: APIPilot detects 197 unique 5xx errors vs DeepREST 45, AutoRestTest 178, RESTifAI 151, KAT 8; AutoRestTest detects more undocumented codes (472 vs 271).
Section IV-D Table V: APIPilot uses 155 tokens per test case vs RESTifAI 19,603 and KAT 161; total monetary cost $3.12.
Section V Threats to Validity: authors acknowledge prompt-difference effects, residual nondeterminism, and limited generalization to poorly documented or specification-inconsistent APIs.
Section VIII Data Availability: data and code publicly available (anonymous.4open.science/r/APIPilot); benchmark drawn from prior public baselines' datasets.
Section IV: no ablation study is reported isolating the contribution of dependency validation vs. response-driven refinement; no statistical significance testing across the five runs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-for-software-engineering paper (APIPilot) where LLMs are a core methodology component: they propose candidate producer-consumer dependencies from OpenAPI specs, which are then validated by concrete API execution before deterministic workflow construction. This 'LLM output as hypothesis, execution as validator' design aligns well with LLM/agents/code-testing preferences (GPT-4.1-mini, structured prompt templates, embedding retrieval). Novelty is moderate: it usefully combines the Operation Dependency Graph idea (RestTestGen), execution-feedback refinement (Morest), and LLM inference (KAT/AutoRestTest/RESTifAI) with a clear separation of inference from sequence synthesis, but no component is individually groundbreaking and no ablations isolate the contribution of validation vs. refinement. Rigor is solid but incomplete: 16 real services, 4 strong baselines, 5 repetitions, unified model/temperature, defined metrics (OC, code coverage via JaCoCo, Eff, token costs), yet no statistical significance tests, no variance reporting, and no ablation study. Evidence strength is good—detailed per-service tables (Table I-V) and honest reporting where baselines win (AutoRestTest detects more raw 5xx on several services and more undocumented codes)—though all results come from one benchmark family. Generalizability is limited to OpenAPI-documented, executable REST services, as the authors concede in Threats to Validity. Reproducibility is above average: public replication package, shared public baselines' datasets, fixed model and temperature, hardware described.

primary_link.title: REST API Testing with Verified LLM-Inferred Dependencies and Response-Driven Refinement

radar.summary: Testing RESTful APIs requires generating sequences of API calls that satisfy dependencies among operations, parameters, and runtime-created resources. Recent LLM-based approaches infer such dependencies and generate test sequences from OpenAPI specifications, but they often treat LLM-inferred relationships as correct without execution-based validation. This can introduce spurious dependencies, miss feasible operation chains, and produce infeasible tests. In this paper, we propose APIPilot}, an e
radar.summary_zh: RESTful API測試需產生滿足操作、參數與執行期資源相依性的呼叫序列，但既有LLM方法常直接信賴模型推論出的相依關係而未經執行驗證，容易產生幻覺相依邊與不可行的測試。本文提出APIPilot，一個以執行驗證為核心的REST API測試框架：先透過結構啟發式與LLM語意推理，自OpenAPI規格推論候選的生產者—消費者相依性，再將其視為假設，經實際API執行驗證後才納入相依圖；接著以有界top-k圖形遍歷建構覆蓋感知的工作流程，將語意相依推論與序列建構分離；並以回應驅動的精修機制，依執行結果更新資源池、調整輸入約束並修剪或修正錯誤的相依映射。在16個真實REST API服務上的評估顯示，APIPilot達到92.3%操作覆蓋率、最高58.6%程式碼覆蓋率與88.1%工作流程執行成功率，全面優於DeepREST、AutoRestTest、RESTifAI與KAT等基線，並偵測出197個獨特的5xx錯誤與規格—執行不一致，每個測試案例僅耗約155個token。限制在於結果可能無法推廣至規格不完整或非REST風格的服務。此研究凸顯將LLM推論奠基於執行回饋的重要性。
radar.title: REST API Testing with Verified LLM-Inferred Dependencies and Response-Driven Refinement

links.title: BayesPrompt: human readable prompts that make sense

evidence: Abstract: proposes reframing prompt optimization as Bayesian posterior inference to sample prompts that are both low-perplexity and human readable, contrasting with pseudoprompts from perplexity minimization.
Section 3, Eq. 2: adds prior P(q) to the prompt objective, arguing ill-posedness of Eq. 1 explains pseudoprompt emergence.

Section 3.2: Metropolis-Hastings with replace/insert/delete proposals using forward and reverse model token probabilities; Section 4 sets action probabilities p_replace=0.6, p_delete=0.2, p_insert=0.2.
Section 4: experiments fine-tune Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (LoRA for the reverse model) on NQ-OPEN train split, prompting learned on the test split.

Section 5.1, Figure 1: over 371 NQ-OPEN pairs with 10-token prompts, MCMC has best fluency (closest to ground truth) with confidence modestly below GT; GCG shows heavy-tailed over-confidence, consistent with pseudoprompts.
Section 5.3, Figure 4: LLM-judge plausibility wins 329 for MCMC vs 6 (GCG-Reg), 13 (GCG), 23 (GD-PEZ); grammar scores concentrate near 0.9-1.0 for MCMC vs ~0.4-0.5 for baselines.
Appendix B, Figure 6: warm-started forward and backward chains converge to the same target region with stable acceptance rate ≈0.02, supporting sampler convergence claims.
Appendix D: judge prompts ask for plausibility ranking and grammar scoring; judging is described as querying the Chatbot Arena (LMSYS) platform, a non-reproducible evaluation channel.
Section 6: acknowledged limitation that all analysis uses the relatively small Llama-3.2-1B; no code or artifact availability is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on prompt inversion: reframes prompt optimization as Bayesian posterior sampling with MCMC, using a reverse language model as warm-start, directly relevant to LLMs, prompting/ICL, and interpretability of pseudoprompts. Novelty is genuine but moderate: MH sampling for constrained text generation (CGMH) and energy-based MLM sampling exist; the claim of first framing prompt learning as sampling is plausible but the MAP-with-prior explanation of pseudoprompts is a fairly natural reframing. Rigor is limited: one model (Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct), one dataset (NQ-OPEN, 371 test pairs), no statistical significance testing, no human readability evaluation (LLM-judge only, via an ad-hoc Chatbot Arena workflow), and no ablations over prompt length or chain length. Evidence rests on distributional figures plus judge win counts (329 vs 6/13/23) rather than tables, downstream task accuracy, or multiple seeds. Generalizability is asserted (Section 6: 'can be ported with no modification to much larger models') but untested. Reproducibility is weak: no code release, missing baseline hyperparameters (GCG steps, batch size B, learning rates), MCMC step count underspecified, and judging via the Chatbot Arena platform is not reproducible.

primary_link.title: BayesPrompt: human readable prompts that make sense

radar.summary: Reconstructing prompts that can elicit a desired answer or behaviour in an LLM is an open and important research topic. Optimisation methods which aim at minimising the perplexity of a given answer, however, consistently yield so-called pseudoprompts, unintelligible strings of tokens which can lack human interpretability. We argue that this is a consequence of the ill-posedness of the prompt optimisation task. By reframing the task as a Bayesian posterior inference over prompts, we propose an ef
radar.summary_zh: 為引出大型語言模型（LLM）的目標答案，最小化困惑度的提示最佳化方法常產生所謂「偽提示」（pseudoprompts）——對人類而言毫無意義的token字串。作者主張這是提示最佳化任務不適定的結果，並將其重新表述為對提示的貝氏後驗推論問題。本文提出以Markov chain Monte Carlo（Metropolis-Hastings取樣演算法）在融合答案似然與語言流暢度先驗的目標分布下取樣提示，並引入反向語言模型作為warm-start初始化，大幅提升重建品質。提案分布涵蓋取代、插入與刪除等離散編輯操作，可選用前向或反向模型提供局部條件機率。在NQ-OPEN資料集與Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct上的實驗顯示，相較GCG、GCG-Reg與GD-PEZ等基線，MCMC是唯一能在答案信心接近真實問題水準的同時取得最佳流暢度的方法；warm-start初始化對各最佳化方法的流暢度皆有顯著改善，但信心改善因方法而異；LLM評審的定性評估也大幅偏好MCMC的可讀性與文法正確性。限制包括僅在1B模型上驗證、未來可改用其他取樣方法。此研究從統計角度解釋偽提示現象，並證明高信心與人類可讀性可以兼得。

links.title: Delegation Asymmetry in Agentic Recommender Systems: Measuring Two-Sided Receptivity in Online Dating

evidence: Abstract: two surveys of a major dating platform (N=2,894; N=2,617), send/receive distinct constructs (ρ=0.92, ΔBIC=52), delegation asymmetry θ=−0.38 vs +0.32, 4–13% viable dyads, routing AUC 0.88 with 3.1× lift.
Section 6.1, Table 3: 2D graded response model preferred over 1D (ΔBIC=51.8; LRT=114.5, 8 df, p<10^-15); Table 4 reports discriminations a=1.7–4.2.
Section 6.2: asymmetry 0.71 SD (95% bootstrap CI [0.65,0.77], 200 replicates); model-free paired check 40.7% rate sending above receiving vs 2.1% reverse; 1D refit gives 0.68 SD.

Section 6.7 and Table 6: leave-target-item-out (Y4 excluded) cross-validated routing score AUC 0.88 (full engagement), top-quartile lift 3.1×, with supervised logistic baseline at AUC 0.89 — parity, not superiority, is claimed.
Section 7, Table 7: random-pairing counterfactuals — baseline viable dyad rate 0.044 strict/0.128 soft; reciprocity gate halves volume; top-25% routing raises engagement 0.116→0.394 strict.
Section 4 Availability: data, codebook, and full analysis pipeline archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21971273 with claim that every number reproduces from the deposit.

Section 9 Limitations: stated preferences not behavior, single self-selected platform, EN n=232 confounded with composition, random dyad formation and static propensities assumed, nonstationary attitudes.
Section 6.4: per-item DIF testing flags Y4/Y5 for language; partial-invariance refit leaves gap=0.69 and ρ=0.92 essentially unchanged.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey-based psychometric study of demand-side acceptance of LLM agents in dating platforms, squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use preference (agentic recommenders, agent-mediated communication) and touching LLM and AI Safety (deception/disclosure), but containing no LLM or language methodology itself — the technical machinery is standard graded response IRT. Novelty is good: joint within-person measurement of send vs. receive receptivity and packaging IRT thresholds as market primitives is a genuinely new construct and audit pipeline, though the estimators are off-the-shelf (acknowledged in §3). Rigor is strong: BIC/LRT model comparison (§6.1), bootstrap CIs, coding sensitivity analyses, DIF and partial-invariance testing (§6.4), and an honest limitations section (§9). Evidence is solid at scale (N=2,617/2,894) but rests entirely on stated preferences from concept mockups on one platform, with no behavioral validation (§6.7, §9 concede this); counterfactuals assume random dyad formation and static propensities. Generalizability is limited: single platform, RU-dominant sample, small self-selected EN subsample (n=232), and cross-domain transfer to recruiting/sales is conjecture (§8). Reproducibility is well supported by an archived deposit with codebook and pipeline (§4 Availability).

primary_link.title: Delegation Asymmetry in Agentic Recommender Systems: Measuring Two-Sided Receptivity in Online Dating

radar.summary: Autonomous LLM agents that converse on a user's behalf are an emerging design pattern in matching platforms, yet their viability depends on a condition rarely examined: users must accept not only delegating conversation to an agent, but also receiving agent-mediated communication from others. We study this condition using two large-scale surveys of active users of a major dating platform (N=2,894 on generative profile features; N=2,617 on autonomous conversational agents, fielded in two language
radar.summary_zh: 自主LLM代理代使用者交談是新興的媒合平台設計，但其可行性取決於雙向接受：使用者不僅須願意把對話委派給代理，也須願意接收他人代理傳來的訊息。本文以某大型交友平台兩份大規模調查（N=2,894與N=2,617，涵蓋俄英雙語）為基礎，建立以等級反應模型加潛在迴歸為核心的「代理接受度」測量模型，並提出可重複使用的四階段receptivity audit方法論。結果顯示：傳送與接收意願雖高度相關（ρ=0.92）卻是可分離的兩個構念（ΔBIC=52）；模型量化出顯著的「委派不對稱性」——部署自身代理所需接受度門檻為θ=-0.38，遠低於與對方代理互動的θ=+0.32，差距0.71個標準差。在隨機配對反事實下，僅4–13%的有向配對能同時滿足部署與接收意願，且呈現性別方向性失衡；依接收接受度路由代理聯絡可將每次接觸的互動率提升約三倍（AUC 0.88、3.1倍quartile lift），且經留一項交叉驗證確認有效。約25%使用者屬於想發送代理訊息卻不願接收的不對稱委派者。限制在於測量的是陳述性偏好而非實際行為，且樣本來自單一平台。此研究為代理式推薦系統的揭露、同意與路由設計提供量化依據。

links.title: Benchmarking Automated Security Patch Backporting: How Far Are We?

evidence: Abstract: 'the best commit-level success rate falls from 85.2% on Type-I patches to 24.0% on Type-IV'; 1,234 cases spanning cross-version, cross-branch, cross-repository scenarios

Section 3.3.1: two-tier design — 600-case Replication Dataset (seed 42, post-cutoff stratification) and 634-commit Evaluation Dataset (192 CVEs, 80 repositories, 2024+ cases 'to reduce leakage for LLM-based tools')

Section 3.5: Mystique uses CodeLlama-13B-Instruct with LoRA, PPatHF uses StarCoder with LoRA, PortGPT GPT-4o API ($0.38/case), SWE-agent GPT-4o batch $21.04 for 45 cases

Section 5.1: limitations — C/C++ only, one oracle-blocked and one incomplete case unrefinable, FixMorph excluded from executable comparison, 'temporal cutoff cannot rule out LLM training-data contamination'
Data Availability Statement: artifact metadata and scripts at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21785770
llm_evaluation.rationale: A carefully executed empirical benchmark study of automated security patch backporting that evaluates LLM agents (PortGPT on GPT-4o, SWE-agent) alongside LLM-prompting (Mystique/CodeLlama, PPatHF/StarCoder) and program-analysis tools under an aligned protocol. Preference relevance is moderate: it substantively engages two high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming) but contributes no LLM/NLP methodology — the LLMs are evaluated objects, and the security-patching domain is adjacent rather than central to LLM research; it is not, however, an out-of-scope pure domain application. Novelty is solid for a benchmark paper (first aligned cross-tool backporting comparison, executable POC subset, benchmark-to-reality gap finding) but the task and tools are pre-existing. Rigor is high: stratified sampling with fixed seed (Section 3.3.1), annotated-label agreement (κ=1.000/0.972 on 100 cases), two-blinded-pass manual verification (κ=0.5357, 76.5% agreement on 315 items), δ-tolerance sensitivity, and explicit failure-inclusive denominators; tempered by moderate verification agreement, subjective root-cause categories, and odd RQ numbering/editorial artifacts (e.g., 'Answer to RQ3' empty table reference). Evidence is strong for headline claims (85.2%→24.0% Type-I→IV drop, Table 4; PortGPT 80.0% Full vs SWE-agent 37.8%, Table 9) but key executable and refinement findings rest on small exploratory n (45 and 29 cases, +2.2pp refinement gain). Generalizability is limited to C/C++ security patches, Linux-heavy data, and acknowledged non-representative executable subset. Reproducibility is good: Zenodo artifact, released metadata/validation commands, replay scripts, reported API costs.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking Automated Security Patch Backporting: How Far Are We?

radar.summary: Automated security patch backporting is critical for mitigating N-day vulnerabilities. Recent tools report success rates above 80% on their respective datasets. However, these evaluations are often confined to homogeneous environments, such as one repository or specific project versions. Consequently, it remains unclear how well these tools generalize beyond their originally targeted scenarios. We present Porting Benchmark, a curated dataset of 1,234 security patch backporting cases spanning cro
radar.summary_zh: 當漏洞在某一版本被修復後，修補程式需回移至其他維護版本、LTS分支或下游分岔，此過程稱為修補回移。既有工具在各自資料集上宣稱80%以上成功率，但彼此的資料、指標與輸入假設互不相容，泛化能力不明。本文建構Porting Benchmark，包含1,234個涵蓋跨版本、跨分支與跨儲存庫情境的回移案例，並在共同評測協定下比較FixMorph、TSBPort、Mystique、PPatHF與PortGPT五套工具，涵蓋程式分析、LLM提示與LLM代理三種典範。結果顯示對齊評測徹底改變排名：PortGPT（80.5%）與TSBPort（75.8%）在複製資料集上仍相對強健，FixMorph與Mystique則大幅退化；結構複雜度是主要瓶頸，最佳commit級成功率自Type-I修補的85.2%跌至Type-IV的24.0%。根因分析歸納四類失敗，其中修補建構或定位失敗（45.0%）與非局部相依傳播失敗（39.2%）最常見。在45個含測試案例與POC的可執行子集上，PortGPT達80.0%完整驗證，且可執行回饋精修僅帶來有限但可測的改善。限制包括僅涵蓋C/C++修補，時間截斷無法完全排除LLM訓練資料外洩。此基準為下一代工具設計指出明確方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled fine-tuning study of whether cultural and figurative-language supervision transfer across domains in Arabic LLMs (ALLaM-7B, Fanar-1-9B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B). Directly relevant to LLM fine-tuning, NLP evaluation, and training/efficiency preferences (LoRA, lm-eval harness), though it is Arabic-specific rather than Japanese and not about core reasoning/agent methodology. The research question is genuinely untested in prior work and the paper is unusually rigorous for its scope: three seeds with option shuffling, paired bootstrap CIs, exact McNemar tests, cluster bootstrap with ICC reporting, an ArabicMMLU control separating content from language adaptation, and data-size/hyperparameter ablations. It is also candid that only one pooled effect survives (+2.33% poetry→idioms, p=0.021) and that 5/72 per-seed significances match the global-null expectation. Evidence strength is limited by tiny evaluation sets (150–198 items), small effect sizes driven largely by LLaMA, and mostly null pooled results; the paper correctly frames findings as constraints rather than positive demonstrations. Generalizability is constrained to 7–9B models, LoRA-only, and Arabic, which the Limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is fair: LoRA hyperparameters, prompts, and public datasets are documented, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Figurative and Cultural Knowledge in LLMs: Investigating Cross-Domain Transfer through Fine-Tuning

radar.summary: Figurative language is deeply culturally embedded; fluent use requires not just linguistic competence but cultural immersion. We ask whether LLMs can learn this link: does fine-tuning on cultural data improve figurative language understanding, and vice versa? We conduct a systematic study across four models (ALLaM-7B, Fanar-1-9B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and six Arabic datasets spanning cultural commonsense, proverbs, and poetry across diverse dialects and regions. Fine-tuning on poetry improves
radar.summary_zh: 修辭語言深植於文化，流暢運用不僅需要語言能力，也需要文化浸潤。本文探討在阿拉伯語場景下，LLM能否透過微調習得文化與修辭的連結：以文化資料微調能否增進修辭理解，反之亦然？作者在ALLaM-7B、Fanar-1-9B、Qwen3-8B與Llama-3.1-8B四個模型上，運用六個涵蓋文化常識、諺語與詩歌的阿拉伯語資料集進行系統性LoRA微調實驗，並加入ArabicMMLU作為語言適應控制組，以區分遷移效果是否源自訓練內容。主要發現：詩歌微調是唯一可靠的正面遷移來源，使慣用語理解提升2.33%（p<0.05），且此增益非控制組可重現，顯示其源自修辭內容而非單純的阿拉伯語適應；相對地，文化微調在兩個阿拉伯語中心模型上反而降低諺語解讀準確率。其他方向的遷移與雜訊無異，阿拉伯語模型常因相關知識已在預訓練時飽和而出現退化，多語模型則有較大適應空間。錯誤分析亦顯示微調傾向強化經驗性文化知識（如飲食、習俗），卻使歷史性事實知識變得不穩定。限制包括僅使用LoRA、超參數搜尋有限、模型規模限於7–9B，以及評估集偏小。此研究指出文化與修辭的關聯無法僅靠微調直接習得。

links.title: Debiased Inference for AI-Generated Data without Gold-Standard Labels: Identification via Multiple Imperfect Measurements

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'debiased inference with multiple imperfect measurements (DMM)' combining ≥3 error-prone AI measurements for downstream inference without gold-standard labels.

Section 3.2.2: robust bridge H^R = 3H̄2 − 2H̄3 is Neyman orthogonal; the construction is explicitly credited to Guo et al. (2026, Appendix B), with extensions to any J≥3 and both latent IV/DV settings.

Section 6.1 / Appendix C.3: 500 Monte Carlo replications on Fowler et al.-calibrated data; DMM bias 0.002, coverage 0.948, RMSE 0.063 vs naive majority-vote bias 0.186, coverage 0.018; simulations satisfy conditional independence by construction and use a correctly specified EM model.

Section 6.2 / Appendix C.4: Pan and Chen (2018) validation using GPT-4.1 5-shot, GPT-4 5-shot, and Llama-4 0-shot proxies; DMM estimate −0.844 vs expert benchmark −1.0388, fixed-target bootstrap coverage 0.862 vs DSL 0.981.

Section 5: overidentification diagnostics for J≥4 proxies (2^J−2J−2 restrictions), subset-stability checks, group-level conditional independence, and DMM-assisted DSL combination (eq. 5.1) that is valid without the CI assumption.
Appendix A: proofs of Proposition 3.1 (unbiasedness/local robustness) and Theorem 3.2 (second-order remainder, consistency, asymptotic normality under n^{-1/4} nuisance rates).
Table C.1: shared EM implementation settings (6 starts, 500 max iterations, tolerances 1e-5/1e-7, bridge denominator floor 0.05); no code or data availability statement appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A semiparametric statistics paper on valid downstream inference with error-prone LLM annotations, not an LLM-methodology contribution: LLMs (GPT-4.1/GPT-4/Llama-4, prompting strategies) appear as the measurement tool and motivating application, giving moderate relevance to the LLM/prompting/NLP preferences but no match to core LLM research areas (reasoning, agents, RAG, alignment). Rigor is strong: formal identification via CP decomposition (Kruskal conditions, Result 1), Neyman-orthogonal robust bridge (3H̄2−2H̄3), asymptotic normality with second-order remainder proofs (Appendix A), and an explicit efficiency analysis of adding proxies (Appendix B). However, the central bridge construction is credited to Guo et al. (2026) and the framework extends Zhou & Tchetgen Tchetgen (2024); novelty is a genuine but incremental generalization (J≥3 proxies, general downstream moments, latent IV/DV, CI given rich covariates, diagnostics). Evidence is solid but narrow: 500-replication simulations where conditional independence holds by construction and the EM nuisance model is correctly specified, plus one real-data validation (n=1,412) showing DMM (−0.844) near the oracle (−1.039) while naive estimates range −1.869 to −0.388; no empirical multicategory results, and the key conditional-independence assumption remains the acknowledged main limitation. Reproducibility is aided by detailed EM settings (Table C.1) but no code or data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Debiased Inference for AI-Generated Data without Gold-Standard Labels: Identification via Multiple Imperfect Measurements

radar.summary: An increasing number of scholars use AI to measure variables they subsequently include in downstream analyses. Although AI-measured variables are often analyzed as if observed without error, ignoring prediction errors in automated measurement leads to substantial bias and invalid confidence intervals in downstream analyses, even if AI measurement accuracy is high, e.g., above 90%. Existing solutions, such as design-based supervised learning and prediction-powered inference, combine error-prone A
radar.summary_zh: 學者日益以AI測量變數再納入下游分析，但AI測量的分類錯誤屬非隨機、非古典誤差，即使準確率逾90%，忽略仍會導致嚴重偏差與失效的信賴區間。既有解法如design-based supervised learning（DSL）與prediction-powered inference（PPI）需取得昂貴的黃金標準標籤。本文提出DMM（debiased inference with multiple imperfect measurements），在不需要黃金標準標籤的情況下，結合三個以上帶誤差的AI測量進行有效下游推論。方法假設多個代理測量在潛在真值與觀測特徵（如文字嵌入、任務難度）條件下相互獨立，藉Kruskal CP分解完成識別，並建構Neyman正交的穩健橋接函數（結合成對與三重橋項，具多重穩健性），搭配cross-fitting達成一致性與漸近常態性，支援線性與羅吉斯迴歸等常見下游分析。以政治廣告資料校準的模擬顯示DMM偏差近零、覆蓋率接近95%，而多數決基線即使F1高達0.95仍嚴重偏誤；以中國網路申訴資料進行的實證驗證中，DMM在完全不用專家標籤下得到接近oracle的估計。限制在於仍須條件獨立假設，本文亦提供診斷工具，並可在有少量驗證資料時以DMM-assisted DSL直接修正偏差。此方法對社會科學的LLM標註推論極具價值。

§4: launch benchmark ~900 human-labeled explanations, near-balanced labels, augmented ~300/week in Phase IV (§7)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-methodology LLM evaluation paper, not a pure domain application: RART is a rubric/prompt-optimization loop with a human-rationale-grounded reasoning meta-judge, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, LLM-as-judge evaluation, reasoning alignment, prompting, alignment/safety guardrails). Novelty is moderate: the four-phase judge lifecycle is a genuinely new framing, but RART is self-described as 'a greedy, single-objective special case of GEPA' with deltas over Meta-Rewarding limited to human-grounded rationales and an agreed-fail focus. Rigor is solid but incomplete: 8-seed RART-vs-vanilla ablation with sign tests (Figure 2), 98.6% meta-judge human validation on 300 pairs (§5.3), and per-criterion analysis, yet no comparison to GEPA/TextGrad, no absolute alignment numbers in text, and the A/B control is no-explanation rather than a non-judge-aligned arm, so the judge's isolated effect is unattributed. Evidence strength benefits from a 5-week A/B over tens of millions (+0.2% novel-content, +0.3% successful plays, p<0.05, §6.2) and n=1000 retry-budget analysis (Fig. 3), but many results are internal-only. Generalizability is plausible but untested beyond one surface and one explanation family (§9.1). Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, and §9.1 withholds must-have criteria, generator and judge model identities.

primary_link.title: The Lifecycle of LLM-as-a-Judge for Large-Scale Recommendation Explanations

radar.summary: LLM-as-a-Judge, which leverages a large language model to evaluate natural language generated by another AI application or model, has become a standard, scalable approach for accelerating and extending costly human evaluation. However, most work treats a judge as a static artifact, evaluating it once at construction or against a fixed benchmark. In contrast, we argue that an LLM judge running in a production system is better understood as having a lifecycle: it must be built, trained, deployed,
radar.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge以大型語言模型評估另一模型生成的自然語言，已成為加速昂貴人工評估的標準做法，但多數研究將評審視為一次性靜態產物。Netflix本文主張，線上系統中的LLM評審應被理解為具有生命週期的終身代理，並以每週產生數十萬則節目層級推薦說明、服務數百萬會員的生產系統為例，提出四階段框架：出生階段建立含人工標籤與失敗理由的領域基準資料集；訓練階段提出Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning（RART），以meta-judge比對評審推理與人工理由的落差，迭代精修各準則的評分規則，證明推理對齊能在不損及recall下提升specificity；部署階段讓同一評審兼任品質把關與自省式改寫迴圈的批評者，以有限重試（K=3）後丟棄的設計保護會員信任；監控階段以每週約300則的人工複評樣本進行漂移偵測，於漂移超過門檻時觸發人工審核後的重新調校。上線後為期五週、涵蓋數千萬會員的A/B測試顯示，經評審把關的說明使會員觀看新內容相對提升0.2%、成功播放的瀏覽session提升0.3%，且無品質相關下架事件。限制包括僅驗證行動裝置介面與相似度式說明，且因保密未揭露準則與模型細節。此研究為產業落地LLM評審提供可操作藍圖。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems paper: BSR bounds peak local KV-restore staging (RWS=O(W)) in long-context LLM serving, decoupling discovery from materialization with fail-closed request-level commit across TP ranks. It squarely matches serving/long-context/memory preferences but does not touch the highest-weight methodological themes (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM). Methodology is unusually disciplined: clean same-epoch no-resume sweeps, an explicit five-part acceptance contract (Appendix A), canonical output hashes, and honest refusal to plot an unmeasured 512K upstream baseline (Sections 5-6). Novelty is moderate and self-acknowledged: the authors concede bounded buffers/streaming are established (Section 8), and the exact W-law match is near-definitional since the L1 pool is provisioned as W fixed-size windows. Evidence is internally consistent and artifact-anchored (run IDs, CSV, evidence refs) but self-reported from a likely-private repository with no stated public release. Generalizability is limited: one model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash), one cluster (DGX Spark + Mooncake, TP=2), registration-specific 16,408,576-byte coefficient; limitations section candidly notes RWS is not total process memory and correctness is operational, not formal. Solid calibrated score near 0.6.

primary_link.title: Bounded-State Restoration: Decoupling Local Restore Capacity from External LLM State

radar.summary: Hierarchical KV-cache systems can retain long-context LLM execution state beyond GPU memory, but retention capacity does not determine the local memory required to make that state executable again. We isolate this second resource as the restoration working set (RWS): the peak local staging state whose lifetimes overlap during restoration. In the pinned upstream LMCache whole-plan path, measured full-reuse points for 1.956, 7.823, and 15.646 GiB/rank states first succeed at 2, 8, and 16 GiB L1 ru
radar.summary_zh: 長上下文 LLM 服務常將先前運算的 KV 狀態保存於主機記憶體、SSD 或遠端記憶體,但外部保存容量不等於讓狀態重新可執行所需的本地記憶體。本文定義後者為還原工作集(RWS),即還原期間同時存活的本地暫存峰值;未修改的 LMCache 全計畫路徑實測顯示,1.956、7.823、15.646 GiB/rank 的外部狀態分別需 2、8、16 GiB 的 L1 才首次完整重用,還原容量與狀態大小耦合。作者提出 Bounded-State Restoration(BSR):先以僅探測查找取得完整可重用前綴的知識而不落地整份命中,再以至多 W 個區塊的視窗反覆安裝與釋放,使峰值還原容量為 O(W),總傳輸量仍為 Θ(|S|);並以請求層級提交規則確保部分安裝永不暴露為有效前綴,失敗即整體失效並退回較低層級或確定性重算。實作擴充 LMCache 與 vLLM,於兩台 DGX Spark 節點以 TP=2 執行 DeepSeek-V4-Flash:外部狀態由 1.956 增至 31.277 GiB/rank,RWS 恆為 500.75 MiB/rank(W=32),最大比率 63.959 倍,且 W 掃描與 M_L1=W×16,408,576 位元組/rank 的定律零殘差吻合。524K-token、開啟 MTP 的 170 張量異質狀態通過同一驗收準則;各項層級與 rank 不對稱故障皆呈現完整重用或零外部重用的 fail-closed 行為。SSD 讀取並行度由 1 提升至 4,使 512K 還原 TTFT 由 43.1 秒降至 17.6 秒而 RWS 不變,證明吞吐量與還原容量可分開控制。限制:RWS 並非整體行程記憶體、係數依模型註冊而定、目前以全域鎖序列化並行、512K 上游對照未實測,正確性屬操作式驗證。本文釐清外部容量、還原容量與執行餘裕為三種相異資源,極具實務參考價值。

links.title: One Gate Is Not Enough: Composing Stateful Pre-Action Controls for Agentic AI

evidence: Section 1 ('Scope honesty'): 'This paper claims composition semantics and a mechanism demonstration. It does not claim production prevalence, uses no model calls' - limits LLM-methodology relevance.

Section 8: artifact composes three published engines over 'open payload data (UCI Online Retail, CC BY 4.0) with a declared synthetic metadata layer and a declared eight-class injector'; '30 pre-registered seeds (prereg/seeds., first seed 26313); zero model calls'.

Section 8 CH2/CH7: single-pass unsoundness instantiated as constructed scenario S4 ('S4 the Proposition 3 construction with the cap between pre- and post-substitution order values'); CH7 finds '86 of 243 grid points disagree' for remediation ordering.

Appendix A: PROOF-STATUS tags with machine-checked domains named (e.g., 'checkers/lattice_check.py... 17,151 individual checks'; Corollary 2 '1,064 cases'), and retracted overclaims documented (Proposition 1 restated per review finding F1; Corollary 1 sufficiency-only per F3).
Table 7 / Section 10: 'CH6 (buffer contamination + mitigation) False' under W2, reported as a sample-size limitation, not hidden.

Section 9: explicitly disclaims novelty of composition itself - 'This paper therefore does not present the join rule itself as its principal novelty' - citing edit automata, XACML deny-overrides, MCDA veto thresholds.

Validation note: 'the reviews were commissioned by the author... adjudication between rounds was performed by the same assistant that authored the protocols and is not independent' - weakens external validation of rigor.
Appendix B/C: Apache-2.0 artifact, pinned engine commits, 'prereg_v1_sha', Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22003399, exact t-interval methodology - strong reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Agentic-AI governance/safety mechanism study: composing stateful pre-action gates (authority, resource, evidence) and formalizing remediation-induced control coupling. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences, though it uses zero model calls and evaluates no LLM, so relevance is infrastructural rather than language-model methodology. Novelty is moderate and honestly scoped: the paper itself concedes runtime-enforcement composition, deny-overrides, and edit automata are prior art (Section 9), claiming only the narrower coupling/order-dependence/state-contamination problems. Rigor is unusually high: pre-registered hypotheses (CH1-CH8) committed before code ran, exhaustive finite-model checkers (17,151 lattice checks; 243-point remediation grid), a PROOF-STATUS taxonomy that downgraded overclaims after independent review (Appendix A), and honest negative results (CH6 unsupported under W2, Table 7). Evidence is solid for what is claimed but entirely synthetic: constructed scenarios (S4 built to exhibit the failure), injected defect classes at declared rates over UCI Online Retail payloads, no production prevalence (Section 10); reviews were author-commissioned with non-independent adjudication (Validation note). Generalizability is deliberately narrow - two concrete idempotent remediators, one-shot composition, general confluence/termination left open (docs/generalized-composition.md referenced as future work). Reproducibility is exemplary: deterministic open-data artifact, frozen seeds, pinned engine commits, Zenodo DOI, commit-stable probes. Net: a careful, well-evidenced, narrowly-scoped contribution to agent safety infrastructure.

primary_link.title: One Gate Is Not Enough: Composing Stateful Pre-Action Controls for Agentic AI

radar.summary: Agentic AI systems take consequential actions governed by more than one pre-action control at once: authority, resource, and evidence gates that can admit, degrade, or remediate an action before it executes. This paper's central object is remediation-induced control coupling: a remediation applied by one control can change the action, evidence, or context another control evaluates, invalidating that control's earlier judgment. We formalize this coupling and give a remediate-and-regate protocol t
radar.summary_zh: Agentic AI 系統的重大動作同時受多重關切約束:是否獲授權(SARC)、成本與碳預算(Green SARC)、證據是否有效(SARC-DQ)。先前研究將這些視為獨立的前置行動閘門;本文聚焦:當一個控制可以補救(變更)另一個控制所評估的動作、證據或衍生情境時,單趟組合可能不安全。作者形式化「補救引發的控制耦合」,提出 remediate-and-regate 協定:補救後由所有成員閘門對最終動作重新評估,在有界且冪等的設定下恢復每動作安全性。並以有限模型檢查器證明兩個已實作的補救算子——證據替換與資源預算改道(downroute)——不可交換(243 個網格點中 86 個分歧),補救順序因而成為控制平面語意的一部分。在狀態層面,被允許但未被涵蓋的缺陷一旦提升進治理緩衝區,即可污染未來治理狀態;隔離與中位數過濾兩種緩解只能降低而非消除此暴露。支援性結果包括:線性加權聚合恰在門檻 τ 不超過最大留一權重和 L* 時可補償成員否決的精確條件、跨閘門保留血緣的統一 Evidence Set,以及組合不會製造新偵測覆蓋的性質。確定性工件組合三個原封未動的已發布引擎,於 30 個預註冊種子與兩個工作流程驗證:CH1–CH5 在全部種子符合註冊判定規則,CH6 在 W1 成立但在較小的 W2 不成立,均如實呈現。限制:僅為機制示範而非普及性研究、不含模型呼叫;一般化多補救系統的終止性、合流性與並行理論仍屬開放。對需要多層治理的代理系統設計深具參考價值。

links.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

evidence: Abstract: reports experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests; all ten tested policies fail to stop attacks or exceed budgets; attack success >=99% after one attempt and 100% after two on defense-unseen families.

Section 4, Theorems 1-2 and Propositions 2-3: exact one-attempt frontier ASR*(B)=max{0,1-B/D} and finite-retry frontier, plus non-identification of off-service pooling from the request trace; proofs in Appendix A.1-A.5.

Section 5.1: dataset construction from 500 synthetic cyber tasks -> 491 screened -> 262 qualified -> 91-task common support cohort with 365 operations and 11,393 certified matched controls; frozen family splits for training, adaptation, calibration, and evaluation.
Section 6.1 and Appendix B.17: independent causal replay reproduces the analytic frontiers within frozen Monte Carlo tolerance (65,000 cells), with LP agreement to 5.69e-14.

Section 7.2, Table 2: on the main evaluation split the best admissible realizable defense (M5) reaches 97.64% ASR under 1% MCD/0.5% BBR caps; methods with lower ASR (M1, M6, M8) exceed the matched-control cap.

Section 7.3 and Appendix B.4: Thompson sampling using only Allow/Block bits reaches 99.4% ASR vs 47.2% for a fixed profile across 3,072 cells; one certified retry raises M1 from 8.75% to 98.75% ASR in the positive control (Table 4).

Section 8 and Appendix B.18: acknowledged limitations include synthetic cyber-only tasks, shared construction prefix (removed in B.12 ablation), mutable DeepSeek API aliases observed on a single date, and main-split in-distribution design; conclusions framed as conditional mechanism evidence.

Appendix B.3 and B.17: pinned model revisions (hashes), exact prompts and thresholds, seeds for resampling, and a portable result inventory with identifiers and hashes support reproducibility, though the capability bank is described as gated for reviewers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong LLM-safety paper squarely on preference: it formalizes decomposition (multi-request) attacks against stateful defenses for LLM services under unlinkable identities, proves exact security-utility frontiers (Theorems 1-2, Propositions 1-3), builds an executable benchmark (91 tasks, 365 operations, 11,393 capability-matched controls, 1.5M background requests), and evaluates 8 realizable defenses plus a privileged steelman and a coalition-aware oracle. Novelty is high: the hidden access-coalition threat model, balanced recoloring protocol, and impossibility-style frontier results go beyond TwinGate/DecomposedHarm/Paranoid Monitors. Rigor is exceptional: theory replayed to numerical precision (Section 6.1, Appendix B.17), calibration/test family splits, an 11-family defense-unseen outer cohort, positive controls (Section 7.3, Table 4), construction-prefix ablation (Section 7.1, B.12), generator-provenance analysis (B.10-B.11), budget sweeps and threshold re-solving (B.8, B.13), and honest cap-overrun reporting (Tables 2, 10, 12). Evidence is strong but domain-limited: only synthetic cyber-programming tasks, a single attacker/judge model family (Qwen 3.5), and mutable DeepSeek API alias screens are acknowledged limitations (Section 8, B.18), and the main evaluation split is in-distribution by construction. Generalizability of the theoretical claim is broad within the stated observation boundary, but empirical transfer is only mechanism-level. Reproducibility is very strong on paper: pinned model revisions, seeds, prompts, thresholds, and a result inventory (B.3, B.17), though availability appears gated rather than fully public. No unsupported claims detected; the key numbers (97.64% best admissible ASR on main split, >=99.43% at highest outer density, 99.4% Thompson-sampling ASR) are consistently reported with intervals.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

top5.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answ
top5.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型（LLM）服務對分解式攻擊的防禦極限。此類攻擊將有害任務拆成個別看似無害的子請求，分別送出後於服務外合併答案；多數服務僅依當前請求判斷的無狀態防禦因此失效。理論上，有狀態監控若能將同一攻擊的所有請求正確分組並累積其能力即可阻斷任務，但攻擊者可透過服務無法連結的全新身分送出請求，使分組訊號失效。作者建立區分「可連結群組」與「存取聯盟」的威脅模型，並證明在此觀測邊界內，理想防禦者的安全與效用權衡前緣完全由良性請求的分組結構決定：良性請求重複出現於可辨識群組時防禦可行；若攻擊與良性請求皆使用不可區分的新群組，加強防護必然增加誤擋，且當攻擊者可重試並觀察 Allow/Block 回饋時，有利的操作點隨之消失。實驗以 91 個可執行任務、365 項操作與 11,393 個能力相符的良性請求驗證理論：在 1% 良性誤擋與 0.5% 背景誤擋上限下，十種受測政策（含具備精確請求—操作對應的特權基準）不是擋不住攻擊就是超出預算；在防禦未見的任務家族上，一次嘗試攻擊成功率至少 99%，兩次後達 100%；僅憑二元回饋的 Thompson sampling 攻擊者可達 99.4% ASR。研究受限於合成網路程式設計任務與僅觀察請求的通道，未涵蓋能存取回應或工具證據的系統。其意義在於指出：有效防禦需仰賴可靠身分連結、新身分成本或範圍限定授權等獨立證據，且安全評估應揭露狀態累積單位與良性對照設計。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A market-validated end-to-end agent benchmark (StartupBench) built from AI-native startup workflows with expert rubrics and Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM-as-judge themes. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful ag
top5.summary_zh: 現有代理基準多半由研究者自訂任務，難以反映真實使用者委託給 AI 的實際工作，且評估方式常過於粗略，無法忠實檢驗複雜交付物。StartupBench 改以市場驗證的 AI 原生新創產品為任務來源：團隊調查 20 多家具真實採用證據的新創，訪談 30 多位深度用戶，再由 50 多位領域專家將工作流程重建為可重現的評測任務，並經跨專家審查與難度校準。基準含 97 項端對端任務，涵蓋醫療、金融、法律、商業管理、STEM 與電腦科學、教育與人文六大領域，每項任務由使用者請求、完整工作區與加權評分準則組成，平均 25.3 條細粒度規則，並以具工具存取能力的 Agent-as-a-Judge 逐條獨立判定。在統一的 Nanobot 框架下評測 9 個代表性模型，最佳的 Kimi-K3 與 GPT-5.6-sol 平均分數約 73.67 與 73.61，但在分數達 90 的嚴格標準下成功率僅約 29.55% 與 31.27%，顯示模型雖有大量部分進展，卻難以完整交付。金融與 STEM 最具挑戰，商業最易；失敗主要源於複雜指令遵循、領域專業合規不足與自我驗證幻覺，且自動評分與專家一致率達 92.78%。相較之下，專門化新創代理平均分數 83.50、成功率 39.18%，仍明顯領先通用代理。此基準以市場需求為錨，為衡量代理能否可靠完成真實工作提供實證指標，並指引基礎模型與代理系統的改進方向。
top5.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows
top5.title_zh: StartupBench：以市場驗證之端對端工作流程評測通用 AI 代理人

links.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

evidence: Section 3.2-3.3: formalizes ASR@B, ASR-budget curves, ATC, and StrongREJECT-based HS under a shared target-call budget B

Section 4.1: 11 attacks across hand-crafted, stochastic (BoN), and LLM-driven families; LlamaGuard4 judges the re-evaluation while GPT-4o with X-Teaming rubric judges ReCode, a cross-phase judge inconsistency
Table 1 (Section 4.2): ReNeLLM avg ASR@100 98.7% with ATC 3.9; CodeAttack avg ASR@K 90.7%; budget-dependent ranking reversal TAP vs BoN at B=5 vs B=100
Table 2 (Section 4.3.2): ReCode avg ASR@20 81.0% with AAC 7.00; GPT-5 85%/7.19; four ablations including ReCode w/ Gate restoring the retry loop
Appendix B.4: 2,000-replicate request-level bootstrap pointwise 95% CIs; overlapping intervals at some budgets acknowledged
Appendix C.3: Claude Sonnet 4.6 filter-rate analysis; removing nesting raises ASR 46%->57% and lowers filter rate 40.4%->15.1%
Appendix A.1-A.3: versioned endpoints (gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-5-2025-08-07), temperature settings, and full baseline hyperparameters
Section 5: limitations state target calls miss token usage/pricing/template-development cost and multi-turn settings are uncovered
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/red-teaming work with direct fit to preferred topics (jailbreak evaluation, LLM-as-target, code-style prompting). Fair-ASR is a sensible but incremental protocol refinement of known budget-dependence findings (BoN, SABER, FLOPs-based compute-aware evals), and ReCode is explicitly a composition of existing primitives (ReNeLLM-style rewrite, BoN perturbation, CodeAttack nesting) with a gate removed; novelty is moderate. Rigor and evidence are strong: 11 attacks, 5+3 targets, two datasets, two attacker models, four ablations, Pareto analysis, and 2,000-replicate bootstrap CIs (Appendix B.4) support the headline claims (budget-dependent rankings in Table B.4; ReCode 85% ASR@20 on GPT-5 at 7.19 attacker calls in Table 2). Caveats: judge changes between phases (LlamaGuard4 for re-evaluation vs GPT-4o X-Teaming rubric for ReCode, Section 4.1), 7B-only attacker scale, no variance estimates for main tables, text-only black-box scope, and a Claude-specific reversal where removing nesting helps (Section C.3), which limits uniform generalizability. Limitations (no token/pricing cost, no multi-turn) are acknowledged in Section 5. Code URL and full hyperparameters/templates in Appendices A, C, E support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

top5.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluatio
top5.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的越獄攻擊評估存在不公問題：多數研究僅報告攻擊成功率（ASR），卻忽略取得該結果所用的攻擊預算，使跨方法比較失真；以 FLOPs 為基礎的運算感知評估，則對 closed-source 黑箱模型難以估計，也無法反映各項資源的不同限制。作者提出 Fair-ASR 評估協定，以「目標模型呼叫次數」作為所有黑箱攻擊共享且可直接觀察的比較軸，在相同預算 B 下報告 ASR@B、ASR–預算曲線與平均目標呼叫數（ATC），並另行追蹤攻擊者模型呼叫以分析效率。團隊重新評估 11 種代表性攻擊，涵蓋手工模板、隨機重複取樣（BoN）與 LLM 驅動方法（如 PAIR、TAP、ReNeLLM）。主要發現：ASR 與方法排名隨預算大幅變動，例如 B=5 時 TAP 領先 BoN，B=100 時反被超越；CodeAttack 等簡單方法在緊縮預算下仍極具競爭力；且沒有任何 LLM 驅動方法能同時在目標呼叫與攻擊者呼叫兩個維度上高效。針對此效率落差，作者提出 ReCode，結合單次去敏感化改寫、不需攻擊者的字元層級擾動與程式碼風格巢狀包裝；在 20 次目標呼叫預算下，ReCode 於 GPT-5 達到 85% ASR，平均每次請求僅需 7.19 次攻擊者呼叫。研究限制包括未涵蓋 token 用量、API 計費與模板開發成本，尚未支援多輪情境，且結果依賴評審模型判定。整體而言，此工作為越獄評估建立公平、可觀察的比較基準，對 LLM 安全測試與資源感知紅隊評估具重要參考價值。

links.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges

evidence: Abstract: LeakGauge achieves AUROC 0.944–0.996 on unseen attacks across 11 LLMs including GLM-5.2 (753B) and Kimi-K3 (2.8T), with <0.5K extra parameters and 10.34 ms added latency.
§4.1 (Table 1, splits): 30% of protected content and 30% of attack templates reserved as unseen; Held-Out Content/Attacks/Strict splits pair at least one unseen component.

§4.2 (Table 2): Behavior maintains AUROC ≥0.94 in every (model, split) combination including Held-Out Strict; End20 degrades sharply on held-out attacks (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B 0.611) supporting the suffix design.
§B.2 (Table 9): random-label control AUROC* stays ~0.50 across models, suffixes, splits, and both tasks, guarding against memorization.
§6 (Table 5): cross-attack deployment on Llama-3.1-8B via vLLM — LeakGauge AUROC 0.996, F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963 at 10.34 ms vs I'vDtL 0.995/0.987/0.947 at 70.91 ms with an extra 8B model copy.

§5.3 (Figure 4, Appendix D): activation steering along a leakage-related direction produces aligned changes in probe logit and ROUGE-L recall, linking the observable signal to internal representations.
§G.2 (Table 21): single-probe-aware GCG attack cuts detection recall to 0.080 (post-filtered ASR 0.275); two-probe deployment restores 0.976 recall, honestly reported robustness limit.
Appendix H (Table 22): Behavior mean AUROC 0.981 on base vs 0.991 on instruction-tuned checkpoints, indicating the signal is not created by instruction tuning.
Appendix I (Table 23): same recipe transfers to StrongReject (0.995), BIPIA (0.971), ToxicChat (0.972), HaluEval (0.926), suggesting generality beyond leakage.

§10 Reproducibility Statement + Abstract: code released at github.com/yeasen-z/LeakGauge; hyperparameters, dataset splits, model configs, steering and deployment details given in §3–§4, Appendices A, D, E.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM safety/methodology paper: detects system-prompt and RAG context-leakage attacks by reading prefill log-probs of an appended natural-language 'gauge' suffix with a <0.5K-parameter probe, requiring no internal-state access. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, RAG, interpretability-style probing, vLLM serving/deployment). Method is novel relative to hidden-state (I'vDtL) and attention (Attention-Tracker) detectors, and the content-agnostic Behavior gauge finding is a substantive contribution. Rigor is unusually thorough: component-wise held-out splits (content/attacks/strict), ablations (End20, Linear), random-label and unrelated-suffix controls (§B.2 Table 9, §B.3 Table 10), cross-lingual/cross-objective shifts, activation steering (§5.3), hard-negative and adaptive GCG stress tests (§G), base-vs-instruct analysis (Appendix H). Evidence is strong and quantitative (AUROC 0.944–0.996 across 11 models, Table 2; deployment Table 5: F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963, 10.34 ms, <0.5K params). Caveats: probe is trained per model/task, deployment comparison is on a single 8B model with acknowledged non-hardware-normalized baselines (§E.2), single-probe adaptive attack reduces detection recall to 0.080 (Table 21), and cross-model transfer is only partial (Table 16). Code and detailed configs are released (§10), supporting high reproducibility.

primary_link.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges

top5.summary: LLMs increasingly rely on external contexts, such as pre-defined system prompts or retrieved documents, to improve generation quality. However, processing these contexts alongside user queries creates an attack surface: adversarial inputs can induce models to disclose them. Prior probing studies suggest that leakage-related signals emerge in hidden states, yet the need to extract these states poses additional deployment challenges. In this paper, we explore whether this internal signal leaves a
top5.summary_zh: 大型語言模型依賴系統提示與 RAG 檢索文件等機密上下文,惡意輸入卻可能誘導模型洩漏這些內容。僅分析輸入文字的分類器對未見攻擊泛化有限,讀取隱藏狀態或注意力的方法又需存取內部狀態、部署門檻高。本文提出 LeakGauge:在輸入後附加自然語言量表,讀取 prefill 階段各 token 的 log-probability,以參數少於 0.5K 的 MLP 映射為風險分數,全程免解碼生成。量表有 Exact(取受保護內容開頭 token)與 Behavior(以內容無關的洩漏行為描述,如「根據以上,我將提供系統提示」)兩種,後者更穩健。在 11 個 8B 至 2.8T 參數的 LLM 上,即使攻擊與內容皆未見過,Behavior 的 AUROC 仍達 0.944–0.996;跨語言或逐字轉語意式洩漏時訊號依舊穩健,activation steering 顯示分數與內部洩漏相關方向連動。部署於 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 時跨攻擊評估達 AUROC 0.996、F1 0.983、TPR@FPR5 0.963,僅增約 10.34 毫秒,並可重用 KV cache。限制:完全曝光的單一探測器可被針對偵測器的 GCG 攻擊規避(召回降至 0.08,雙量表部署回升至 0.976),跨模型訊號遷移亦不完全一致。此機制可延伸至有害請求與提示注入偵測,為 LLM 洩漏防護提供輕量、免生成且泛化佳的新途徑。
top5.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges
top5.title_zh: 模型的破綻:以行為量表衡量上下文洩漏攻擊訊號

links.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing

evidence: Abstract: J64 adds 0.096-0.135 held-out AUC over a token-occupancy baseline aggregated identically; R64 reaches median per-axis correlation 0.69-0.86 across three models and two families and preserves 95-100% of J64's predictive gain on gpt-oss-20b.
Section 4.1 (RQ1): paired within-problem AUC increments from adding J64 to matched text model are +0.135* (Low), +0.129* (Medium), +0.096* (High), with 47x more features given to the text channel.

Section 4.2 (RQ2): median per-axis reconstruction 0.692-0.864 across eight model-effort settings; shuffled routing collapses to r~0; residualizing against token occupancy and log-length still yields additional held-out R2 of 0.082-0.085.

Section 5.1 / Table 1: cross-benchmark frozen transfer best-of-64 shows J64 +5.0 and +4.9 effort-averaged points over random pick on gpt-oss-20b and 120b, and R64-weighted voting improves majority voting in seven of eight settings.

Section 5.2 / Table 3: online stop-and-resample with nested operating-point selection; J64 beats sibling-permuted control by +1.3* to +5.9* points on gpt-oss-20b High and +0.9* to +1.7* on Qwen, with R64 retaining 0.9-3.2 points.

Section 5.3 / Table 7-8: router edits induce predicted behaviors (100 'Case n' headers vs 0 in 160 sham runs; accuracy 0.381 to 0.000; suppression shortens generations by 45.9 tokens* and replaces numerical guessing with symbolic derivation on one case study).

Section 6 (Limitations): authors state analysis centers on competition mathematics and gpt-oss-20b, frames are model-specific and not aligned across models, online control is evaluated mainly by causally masked replay, and interventions remain small.

Appendix B.1/B.3: full construction algorithm (Algorithm 1) with exact constants (lambda=50 ridge, C=3, 256-token windows, tau and K grids) and timing measurements (38.4 ms/token decode; 0.07/0.09 ms hook overhead), supporting reproducibility, though no explicit code release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely in scope: it operationalizes a vocabulary-aligned internal readout (J64) of LLM reasoning state, reconstructs it from native MoE routing (R64), and uses it for test-time selection, online stop-and-resample control, and causal router edits on gpt-oss and Qwen3 reasoning models. Strong preference match to LLMs, reasoning/CoT, MoE architecture, interpretability, and test-time compute. Novelty is solid but derivative of the Jacobian lens (Gurnee et al.) and DeepConf baselines; the routing-only reconstruction and mechanism-matched interventions are the genuinely new contributions. Rigor is unusually high: matched token-occupancy baselines aggregated identically, sibling-permuted controls, frozen cross-benchmark transfer, nested operating-point selection to avoid test-set tuning, construction-disjoint checks, capacity-matched PCA control, and sham-edit controls for interventions, all with question-level clustered CIs. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent across three models, though effects are sometimes modest, the rescue slice is hindsight-selected (acknowledged), and benchmarks are small (30 questions each; 198 GPQA). Generalizability is limited: frames are model-specific and not aligned across models, evaluation centers on competition mathematics, and online control is mainly causally-masked replay rather than live serving, as the limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is good given Algorithm 1 and exact constants (lambda=50, C=3, 256-token windows, timing measurements), though no explicit code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing

top5.summary: What a reasoning model writes is only a partial record of the process that produces it. We introduce a two-level internal readout for mixture-of-experts reasoning. We first distill vocabulary-scale J-space into J64, a 64-axis semantic frame learned from the model's own reasoning states. J64 reveals readable process state that the emitted trace does not show: it separates inference effort from problem-induced strain. It also adds 0.096 to 0.135 held-out AUC over a baseline that reads the same rol
top5.summary_zh: 推理模型寫出的思考軌跡只是其內部運作的部分紀錄。本文針對混合專家（MoE）推理模型提出兩層式內部讀出：先從模型自身的推理狀態，將詞彙規模的 J-space 提煉成 64 軸語意框架 J64，可讀出軌跡未顯示的過程狀態，並分離「推理力道」與「題目難度造成的負荷」兩個近乎正交的座標；相較於以 token 佔用率讀取同一 rollout 的對照基準，J64 在 held-out 評估上額外貢獻 0.096 至 0.135 的 AUC。作者再以原生專家路由統計透過 ridge 迴歸重建 J64，得到低開銷代理 R64：在三個模型、兩個家族上，各軸中位相關達 0.69 至 0.86，於 gpt-oss-20b 保留 J64 預測增益的 95% 至 100%。應用上，J64 與 R64 能改善已完成候選的單軌選擇，R64 加權投票在八分之七的設定中優於多數決；生成過程中以滾動視窗驅動的停止與重採樣策略，J64 相較兄弟置換對照提升 1.1 至 5.9 點，R64 保留其中 0.9 至 3.2 點；針對 J64 所指認機制的路由編輯亦誘發預期行為，將數值猜測轉為精確的符號推導。限制在於分析以競賽數學與 gpt-oss-20b 為主，各模型框架獨立建構、彼此不對齊，線上控制以因果遮蔽的重播評估，介入規模亦小。其價值在於讓潛藏的推理狀態既可解讀又可部署，為測試期算力分配提供可操作的遙測訊號。
